izzyondroid:co.adityarajput.fileflow.name: FileFlow
izzyondroid:co.adityarajput.fileflow.description:
FileFlow scans your files periodically and organizes them according to your rules.
 Features: 
 Rules: Use regex to precisely target files.
 Actions: Choose what to do with the files - copy, move, rename, zip, emit, or delete.
 Schedule: Choose when and how often rules run.
 History: Recent executions are stored (locally).
 Shortcuts: Execute groups of rules from your homescreen.
 Private: Fully offline; your data never leaves your device.
 Lightweight: Runs in the background with minimal battery and memory usage.

izzyondroid:com.apk.editor.name: APK Explorer & Editor
izzyondroid:com.apk.editor.summary: An open-source APK explorer/Editor & Split APK/App bundle Installer for Android!
izzyondroid:com.apk.editor.description:
APK Explorer & Editor (AEE) includes a set of open-source tools mainly designed to explore the contents of an installed application on an Android device. Additionally, AEE offers a feature-rich APK/Split APK's/App bundle installer which allows users to pick and install files from device storage. Please Note : This is the full version of AEE. The Google Play version lacks editing capabilities as well as features such as APK/App Bundle signing.
 Features 
 A beautifully designed list view of installed applications.
 Explore an installed application or APK file picked from the device storage and navigate through its contents.
 Export and easily manage (install, share etc.) APK's/Split APK's into device storage.
 Includes a feature-rich APK/Split APK/App bundle installer (easily pick and install files from device storage)
 Easily extract app icons by single-clicking on them.
 Provides basic information about important resource files.
 View graphics, texts, binary XML, and many more.
 Save/Export individual resource files to device storage.
 Edit text/binary XML files using an in-built text editor (still, a bit buggy when working with too huge APK's).
 Delete or replaces resources.
 Assemble modified smali files into new classes (.dex).
 Decode and view the contents of "resources.arsc".
 Create signed APK's/App Bundles after the above-mentioned processes.
 Resign APK's/bundles with AEE custom key.
 Elegantly designed user interface with an auto-dark/light theme.
 A lot more.
 Translations 
 Please help me to translate this application via POEditor . You may also translate after downloading the original language string available GitHub .
 Documentation 
 How-To

izzyondroid:moe.henry_zhr.kill_domain_ve.name: Kill Domain Verification
izzyondroid:moe.henry_zhr.kill_domain_ve.summary: prevent the system from allowing apps to always open supported links
izzyondroid:moe.henry_zhr.kill_domain_ve.description:
Kill Domain Verification is an Xposed module which prevents the system (and also yourself) from allowing apps to always open supported links. It also enables you to open supported links in apps which are not "verified" on Android 12 and above.
 Module function: always ask when opening http / https links, instead of opening directly in the app
 Side effect: Can't open the link directly in the app even if you set it manually; Android 12+ will show the unverified app when you select it
 Theoretical support for Android 6 and later.

izzyondroid:moe.sable.client.name: Sable
izzyondroid:moe.sable.client.summary: A Matrix client with quality-of-life features
izzyondroid:moe.sable.client.description:
Sable is a Matrix client built to enhance the user experience with quality-of-life features, cosmetics, utilities, and sheer usability. It is a fork of Cinny.
 Features:
 End-to-end encrypted messaging, with encrypted push notification previews decrypted on-device
 Push without Google Play Services, through UnifiedPush
 Voice and video calls over MatrixRTC
 Spaces, threads, and forum rooms
 Customisable app icons, themes, and a configurable GIF provider
 Message reporting, forwarding, and read-receipt controls
 Sable is free software licensed under the AGPL-3.0. Crash reporting is opt-in and disabled until you consent.

izzyondroid:nep.timeline.cirno.name: Cirno
izzyondroid:nep.timeline.cirno.summary: app freezer to make background apps completely free of CPU resources
izzyondroid:nep.timeline.cirno.description:
Cirno is an app freezer that runs on Android 12+ platforms, it is used to make background apps completely free of CPU resources to improve the overall smoothness of the device.
 Cirno is currently only supported on cgroup v2 devices, which means your Linux kernel version needs to be greater than or equal to 5.0.
 The app has no GUI. It will freeze apps automatically. By modifying the cfg file, you can specify that the application does not freeze.

izzyondroid:ru.meefik.linuxdeploy.name: Linux Deploy
izzyondroid:ru.meefik.linuxdeploy.summary: install and run GNU/Linux on Android
izzyondroid:ru.meefik.linuxdeploy.description:
This application is open source software for quick and easy installation of the operating system (OS) GNU/Linux on your Android device.
 The application creates a disk image on a flash card, mounts it and installs an OS distribution. Applications of the new system are run in a chroot environment and working together with the Android platform. All changes made on the device are reversible, i.e. the application and components can be removed completely. Installation of a distribution is done by downloading files from official mirrors online over the internet.
 The application requires superuser rights (ROOT).

fdroid:com.eiyooooo.foldswitcher.name: Fold Switcher
fdroid:com.eiyooooo.foldswitcher.summary: Switch between various folding states on foldable devices
fdroid:com.eiyooooo.foldswitcher.description:
This application can switch between various folding states on foldable devices, such as closed mode, half-open mode, tent mode, and fully open mode. Some devices support dual-screen display.
Most devices can switch modes in user mode (out-of-the-box), while a few devices require Shizuku mode for switching.
Getting Started Guide:
1. Install the app
2. If prompted for Shizuku permissions, please download Shizuku and follow the Shizuku manual for configuration instructions.
3. Click on the fold state to switch.
If you are unable to switch fold state normally, please try switching to a different execute mode.
Quick Switch Settings:
1. Long press on the fold state to set it as Quick Switch.
2. For Android 13 and above, a request will appear. For other Android versions, you need manually pull down the status bar and edit the switch.
You can also control the fold state from automation apps like Tasker, MacroDroid, or through ADB commands. See GitHub repository for detailed instructions.

fdroid:com.librespan.name: LibreSpan
fdroid:com.librespan.summary: XMPP messenger with OMEMO, calls and protected local storage.
fdroid:com.librespan.description:
LibreSpan is a modern Android XMPP messenger derived from Conversations through AnotherIM.
It keeps the open, provider-independent XMPP model: sign in with your existing JID and use the services supported by your XMPP server.
Highlights:
• OMEMO end-to-end encrypted messaging
• Audio and video calls over Jingle/WebRTC
• Images, files, voice messages, audio and video
• Group chats and channels (MUC)
• Message Archive Management (MAM)
• HTTP Upload and UnifiedPush support
• Secure Content Store for protected local message and media data
• App Lock and optional High Security protection for supported devices
• Local search and a simplified modern Android interface
LibreSpan does not require a project-specific XMPP provider. Server capabilities are discovered through XMPP.
The project is free and open-source software. LibreSpan is based on the Conversations family and preserves upstream attribution and licensing.

fdroid:com.zoffcc.applications.trifa.name: TRIfA
fdroid:com.zoffcc.applications.trifa.description:
TRIfA - A New Kind of Instant Messaging 
Whether it's corporations or governments, digital surveillance today is widespread.
Tox is easy-to-use software that connects you with friends and family without anyone else listening in.
While other big-name services require you to pay for features, Tox is completely free and comes without advertising — forever.
 Encrypted:

 Distributed:

 Free:

 More Information:

fdroid:de.nulide.findmydevice.name: FMD
fdroid:de.nulide.findmydevice.summary: Locate and control your device remotely
fdroid:de.nulide.findmydevice.description:
I lost my new phone.
And because I don't use Google Services I couldn't locate it and my phone was gone for good.
In the hope that this doesn't happen again, I developed this application, so that I can locate the phone via SMS.
Features:
- Locate the device (using GPS or cellular location)
- Lock the device
- Let the device ring
- Take pictures with the device's camera to see its surroundings
- Factory-reset the device
Usage:
You can control FMD (and thus your phone) either via SMS or via FMD Server.
You send a command to the phone (e.g. "fmd ring") and the phone executes it.
For SMS you can either define a list of trusted contacts (phone numbers) that are allowed to send commands.
Or you can set a PIN to allow anonymous usage.
Then non-trusted phone numbers can also send commands by including the PIN in the message.
This is useful because now if you lose your phone, you can ask a random person for help to wipe your phone remotely.
If you simply text "fmd" to your phone FMD will reply with a text listing the available commands.
With FMD Server you get a web interface to send commands, to view the location of your device on a map,
and to view pictures taken by the device.
You can self-host FMD Server.
For more details, see: https://gitlab.com/fmd-foss/fmd-server
Disclaimer:
This app is provided on a best effort basis.
We hope it is useful, we use it ourselves, but this is a hobby project
and we can't guarantee that it will work when you need it the most.

fdroid:de.obsp.hostlookup.name: HostLookup
fdroid:de.obsp.hostlookup.summary: Explore DNS records and network information across public resolvers
fdroid:de.obsp.hostlookup.description:
HostLookup is a native Android DNS explorer powered by mhost.
Query 25 DNS record types, compare responses from predefined public resolvers,
and inspect individual records. Explore WHOIS, network prefixes, autonomous
system numbers, and location information for discovered IP addresses, including
nameserver and mail-server addresses.
The app uses a Material 3 interface with dynamic color on Android 12 and newer.
Android 8.0 or newer is required.
DNS queries are sent to mhost's predefined public DNS resolvers over UDP, TCP,
DNS-over-TLS, and DNS-over-HTTPS. UDP and TCP queries are unencrypted. Nameserver and mail-server address enrichment also uses the device's
configured DNS resolver. Network and location information is requested from
RIPEstat over HTTPS. Providers can see requests and your public IP address.
The public resolver list and RIPEstat service cannot be replaced in settings.
No ads, analytics SDKs, account, or HostLookup-operated server are used.

fdroid:eu.domob.panoramicon.description:
Panoramicon is an immersive viewer for spherical panorama images (full 360×180° images in equirectangular projection). Simply tilt and rotate your device to naturally explore the panoramic scene around you.
The app provides an intuitive, motion-controlled viewing experience that makes you feel like you're standing inside the photograph.
Features:
• Open panoramas by sharing images or links to the app or using "Open with"
• Natural camera control using device orientation sensors
• Pinch-to-zoom gesture support
• Smooth scrolling with momentum/inertia
• Lightweight and focused on the viewing experience
• Fullscreen immersive mode (tap to toggle system UI)
Perfect for viewing 360° photos from cameras, phones, or any equirectangular panorama image.

fdroid:org.woheller69.gpscockpit.name: GPS Cockpit
fdroid:org.woheller69.gpscockpit.description:
Features: 
GPS Cockpit finds your device's location via GPS and shows most relevant data in a cockpit style.
You can also see the list of visible satellites with their identifiers and signal quality.
Location coordinates can be copied to clipboard, shared, or opened in a maps app, if installed.
Clearing A-GPS aiding data is also supported.
Speed range can be selected by clicking on the speedometer.
A left swipe on the speedometer will show an altimeter instead.
When the START button is pressed travel distance is recorded (horizontal movement and also accumulated up and down movements).
A change is only recognized and added to the distance if the position changes by more than 2x GPS accuracy for horizontal
movement and 3x GPS accuracy for vertical movements and only if accuracy is at least 15m.
A flipped view for use as head-up display is also available.
A tile in quick settings allows you to enable/disable GPS lock.
Required permissions:
 - GPS to access location
 - REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS, WAKE_LOCK, FOREGROUND_SERVICE for keeping GPS active in background if requested by user ("LOCK GPS")
No ads, no trackers.

apple-itunes:6757598853.name: Map Fit : My Country Puzzle
apple-itunes:6757598853.description:
Map Fit is a fun and satisfying geography puzzle game built from real-world city maps. Instead of assembling a picture, you fit map areas surrounded by roads into matching spaces. Drag each piece and complete the map until progress reaches 100%.
If you enjoy map games, geography games, jigsaw puzzles, logic puzzles, or relaxing casual games, Map Fit offers a simple twist: the puzzle itself is a real place.
BUILD REAL CITY MAPS
Each stage is based on a real-world map. The pieces come from areas divided by roads, giving every shape its own outline. Look at curves, corners, nearby roads, and the overall layout to find where each piece belongs.
Unlike a traditional jigsaw puzzle, you are completing the structure of a map. The shape of an area, the direction of a road, and neighboring spaces can all become clues.
SIMPLE DRAG-AND-DROP GAMEPLAY
Pick up a piece and drag it to the matching space. The rules are easy to understand, so you can start playing right away. As more pieces fall into place, the map gradually comes together.
COMPLETE THE MAP
Your goal is clear: fit every piece and bring the map to 100% completion. Some shapes are easy to recognize, while others make you compare several positions before finding the perfect fit.
Each correct placement brings you closer to the finished map. Watching empty spaces disappear piece by piece makes completing a stage satisfying.
EXPLORE CITIES AND REGIONS
Map Fit focuses on maps of cities and local areas rather than abstract puzzle boards. Different streets and neighborhood layouts create a new puzzle pattern each time, so every map has its own character.
Explore places through their shapes and layouts. Even without memorizing names or answering questions, you can notice how areas connect and how a city map is structured.
USE OBSERVATION AND SPATIAL THINKING
Compare borders, positions, surrounding roads, and neighboring areas. A curve in a road, an unusual corner, or the size of an empty space may reveal the answer.
Focus on the shapes and solve the map one piece at a time.
NEED A LITTLE HELP?
When a piece is hard to place, hints can help you find where the next puzzle piece belongs. Use them when you get stuck and keep moving toward 100% completion.
SATISFYING, CASUAL, AND EASY TO PICK UP
Play for a quick puzzle break or keep solving maps for a longer session. The simple drag-and-fit interaction makes Map Fit easy to pick up, while the unique shapes of real map areas keep each stage interesting.
WHY PLAY MAP FIT?
- Real-world city and regional map puzzles
- Simple drag-and-drop controls
- Unique pieces based on road-divided map areas
- Clear 100% completion goal
- Geography-inspired puzzles built around real places
- Observation and spatial puzzle challenges
- Helpful hint feature when you get stuck
- Satisfying piece placement
- Casual gameplay that is easy to start
- Different map layouts to discover
A FRESH WAY TO ENJOY MAPS
Map Fit turns everyday map layouts into interactive puzzles. You do not need to memorize facts or answer geography trivia. Just look at the map, compare the shapes, and figure out where each area fits.
If you like maps, jigsaw puzzles, or finding the one piece that makes everything click, Map Fit brings those ideas together in a simple game.
FIND THE PERFECT FIT
Some pieces stand out immediately. Others may look similar until you compare the edges, roads, and surrounding spaces. Try a position, look again, and keep solving until every area is back where it belongs.
Piece by piece, the map changes from an unfinished board into a complete place. That transformation is the heart of Map Fit.
Whether you are searching for a map puzzle, geography game, city map game, jigsaw game, logic puzzle, shape-matching game, or satisfying casual puzzle, Map Fit gives you a simple way to play with maps.
Drag a piece. Find its place. Reach 100%.
Download Map Fit and start fitting maps together, one satisfying puzzle at a time!

apple-macos:1388020431.name: DevCleaner for Xcode
apple-macos:1388020431.description:
If you want to reclaim tens of gigabytes of your storage used for various Xcode caches - this tool is for you!
Xcode could store tens of gigabytes in ~/Library/Developer folder. Most of those cached files & symbols are not reclaimed over time and could consume a large amount of your storage, which is especially important if you have relatively small SSD drive.

flathub:com.infinipaint.infinipaint.description:

flathub:moe.nomm.Nomm.name: Nomm
flathub:moe.nomm.Nomm.description:
NOMM is a stupid simple, super clean "native" (as in it runs on Linux without having to use
 translation tools...) mod manager for Linux. The goal here is to keep the setup really simple for
 users like me who don't need the super advanced/complex features. Just a few clicks on a clean,
 modern interface, and you're done :)
 Don't expect NOMM to manage mods for something like Skyrim. There are specific tools for that
 (see NaK or Jackify).
 Instead, think of NOMM as more of a general purpose tool for most games that just need you to
 point to a directory and extract some mod archives.

flathub:org.entangle_photo.Manager.name: Entangle
flathub:org.entangle_photo.Manager.description:
Entangle is a program used to control digital cameras
 that are connected to the computer via USB.
 Entangle can trigger the camera shutter to capture new images.
 When supported by the camera, a continuously updating preview
 of the scene can be displayed prior to capture. Images will be
 downloaded and displayed as they are captured by the camera.
 Entangle also allows the settings of the camera to be changed
 from the computer.
 Entangle is compatible with most DSLR cameras from Nikon and
 Canon, some of their compact camera models, and a variety of
 cameras from other manufacturers.

 As commander, it's your job to assemble your crack team of hedgehog soldiers and bring the war

 Hilarious and strategic turn based combat for up to 8 players
 Singleplayer mode with two campaigns and many scenarios and challenges

fedora-packages:dola-transformer/dola-tr.description: Dola Transformer is an extension for Apache Maven 4 that enables dynamic, in-memory transformation of project models (POMs) without modifying them on disk. fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.name: flexmark-java-ext-zzzzzz
fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.description: Flexmark-java is a Java CommonMark (spec 0.28) parser using the blocks first, inlines after Markdown parsing architecture. Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. This package contains an extension that supports zzzzzz syntax.

fedora-packages:gap-pkg-normalizinterfac.name: gap-pkg-normalizinterface
fedora-packages:gap-pkg-normalizinterfac.description: Normaliz is software for computations with rational cones and affine monoids. It pursues two main computational goals: finding the Hilbert basis, a minimal generating system of the monoid of lattice points of a cone; and counting elements degree-wise in a generating function, the Hilbert series. As a recent extension, Normaliz can handle unbounded polyhedra. The Hilbert basis computation can be considered as solving a linear diophantine system of inhomogeneous equations, inequalities and congruences. This package allows creating libnormaliz cone objects from within GAP, and gives access to it in the GAP environment. In this way GAP can be used as an interactive interface to libnormaliz.

fedora-packages:gap-pkg-scscp/gap-pkg-sc.name: gap-pkg-scscp

fedora-packages:gap-pkg-scscp/gap-pkg-sc.description: This package implements the Symbolic Computation Software Composability Protocol (SCSCP) for the GAP system in accordance with the SCSCP specification, described at https://openmath.org/standard/scscp/, and OpenMath dictionaries scscp1 and scscp2.

fedora-packages:ghc-HsYAML/ghc-HsYAML.name: ghc-HsYAML
fedora-packages:ghc-HsYAML/ghc-HsYAML.description: 'HsYAML' is a [YAML 1.2](http://yaml.org/spec/1.2/spec.html) processor, i.e. a library for parsing and serializing YAML documents. Features of 'HsYAML' include: * Pure Haskell implementation with small dependency footprint and emphasis on strict compliance with the <http://yaml.org/spec/1.2/spec.html>. * Direct decoding to native Haskell types via ('aeson'-inspired) typeclass-based API (see "Data.YAML"). * Allows round-tripping while preserving ordering, anchors, and comments at Event-level. * Support for constructing custom YAML node graph representation (including support for cyclic YAML data structures). * Support for the standard (untyped) /Failsafe/, (strict) /JSON/, and (flexible) /Core/ "schemas" providing implicit typing rules as defined in the YAML 1.2 specification (including support for user-defined custom schemas). * Support for emitting YAML using /Failsafe/, (strict) /JSON/, and (flexible) /Core/ "schemas" (including support for user-defined custom encoding schemas * Event-based API resembling LibYAML's Event-based API (see "Data.YAML.Event"). * Low-level API access to lexical token-based scanner (see "Data.YAML.Token").

firefox-addons:3048243.description:
🔐 SHARE LOGINS WITHOUT PASSWORDS
Session Share lets you capture, save, and share website login sessions (cookies) securely with friends — without sharing passwords.
HOW IT WORKS:
 Open any logged-in website (Netflix, Spotify, GitHub, etc.)
 Click the Session Share icon → "Save Session"
 Your login is encrypted and saved locally
 Click "Share" to send an encrypted token to your friend
 Your friend pastes the token → instantly logged in!
SECURITY FIRST:
• AES-GCM-256 Encryption — All saved sessions encrypted with per-user master key
• PIN Protection — Optional 4-8 digit PIN (PBKDF2, 100k iterations)
• Token Expiry — Share tokens that expire in 1h, 24h, 7d, or never
• No Server — Your data never leaves your device
• Open Source — Every line auditable
FEATURES:
✅ Direct Save — Click "Save Session" and cookies captured automatically
✅ Website Favicons — Each saved session shows the site's logo
✅ Custom Names — Rename any session (click title or pencil icon)
✅ Session Preview — See cookie breakdown before applying
✅ Share via — Clipboard / WhatsApp / Telegram / QR Code
✅ Export/Import — Encrypted backup to JSON file
✅ Auto-Cleanup — Sessions unused 90+ days auto-removed
✅ Dark Mode — Beautiful dark theme
✅ Search & Sort — Filter by domain/name; sort 5 ways
✅ Usage Stats — See how many times each session used
✅ Keyboard Shortcuts — Ctrl+Shift+C (copy), Ctrl+Shift+V (paste)
CROSS-BROWSER:
Works on Chrome, Edge, Brave, and Firefox. Share sessions between browsers seamlessly.
NO TRACKING. NO ANALYTICS. NO SERVERS. YOUR PRIVACY IS RESPECTED.
⚠ DISCLAIMER: Use responsibly and only with people you trust. Sharing login sessions may violate some websites' terms of service.
👨💻 Made by Sandeep Kumar

firefox-addons:2999445.name: Quetta Video Downloader
firefox-addons:2999445.summary: One-click video downloads. Supports HLS, M3U8, MP4, WebM, and more.
firefox-addons:2999445.description:
Quetta Video Downloader helps you detect and save supported videos directly from web pages. It supports YouTube, MP4, WebM, HLS (M3U8), live streams and multiple video quality options.
Key features
- YouTube support on Firefox. Download supported YouTube videos and choose from the formats and quality options available for each video.
- One-click video detection. Open a supported page, play the video and click the Quetta icon to view the available media.
- HLS (M3U8) support. Detect and download compatible HLS streams, then merge the video segments into a single file.
- MP4 and WebM downloads. Save videos in popular formats directly to your device.
- Multiple quality options. Choose from the resolutions detected on the source page, including HD and 4K when available.
- Live stream downloads. Save supported live streams for offline viewing.
- Clear download management. Review detected media, select what you want to save and control simultaneous downloads.
- Free and ad-free. The core download features require no account or payment.
How to use
1. Open a supported page and play the video.
2. Click the Quetta icon to view the detected media.
3. Choose a format or quality and start the download.
Privacy
The core download features do not require data collection.
If you choose to allow optional technical and interaction data, that information is used only as described in the privacy policy. Quetta does not sell user data or use it for purposes unrelated to the extension’s functionality.
Important
- DRM-protected content is not supported.
- Available formats and video quality depend on the source video.
- Website compatibility may change when websites update their technology.

firefox-addons:3126210.name: Impulse Buy Blocker – Shopping Cooldown
firefox-addons:3126210.summary: Pauses buy and checkout buttons on big shops and starts a 24-hour cooldown. Counts what you saved. Pro: 72h, any shop, streaks.
firefox-addons:3126210.description:
Impulse Buy Blocker puts a pause between you and the checkout. When you press add to cart or a checkout button on a big online store, it stops the click and asks you to wait 24 hours. The item goes on your cooldown list with its name and price. When the time is up, you decide again with a clear head.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Browse as usual. Nothing changes until you press a purchase button.
2. Choose "Start 24h cooldown". The item lands on your list in the toolbar popup.
3. When the countdown ends, the icon shows a number. Get it or skip it.
FREE, NO LIMIT
• A 24-hour pause on purchase, cart and checkout buttons of major stores.
• A list with the time left for every item you are waiting on.
• A saved counter: every skipped item adds its price.
• "Buy anyway" stays possible after a 5 second wait, so you are never locked out.
PRO, ONE-TIME $5.99
• Cooldowns of 12, 24, 48 or 72 hours.
• Any shop: add the site you are on with one click.
• A no-buy streak with your best run and the last 14 days.
PRIVACY
Your list, counters and settings stay in your browser. The extension reads a store page only to recognize purchase buttons and the item name and price. Nothing about your shopping is sent anywhere. Only when you unlock Pro, your email address is checked against the payment record.
Support: scanlystudio.support@proton.me 
Not affiliated with any retailer.

firefox-addons:1018280.name: PDF Tools - Convert, Resize & Merge
firefox-addons:1018280.summary: Manipulate PDF documents via Ghostscript interpreter right in your browser.
firefox-addons:1018280.description:
PDF Tools , is a simple and very lite add-on which allows you to easily manipulate (convert, resize, merge, etc.) PDF documents right in your browser. 
It uses an open-source software called Ghostscript. Ghostscript is an engine for interpreting portable document formats (PDF) and postscript (PS). In order to get more info about Ghostscript please read this Wikipedia page. To download and install Ghostscript on your machine, please visit this page.
This add-on uses nativeMessaging technology to communicate with Ghostscript software on your machine. Before using this add-on, you need to install Ghostscript on your machine. You also need the native client patch in order to build the communication between Ghostscript and your browser.
Please visit this GitHub repo and download the related patch for your machine. Follow the instruction in the above GitHub page in order to install the patch in your system. After installing, the "PDF Tools" add-on in your browser can communicate with Ghostscript client on your machine (Window, Linux or Mac).
If you have a feature request, or found a bug to report, please fill the bug report form in the add-on's homepage .

firefox-addons:2830093.name: GX Theme Styles
firefox-addons:2830093.summary: Personalize your browser with our preset GX themes or choose your favorite colors and give your browser your personal style.
firefox-addons:2830093.description:
This add-on give you the ability to change your theme for one of our preset themes inspired in the GX style, compatible with light and dark color schemes; this add-on give you too the ability to change the 'Colors' of your browser to make it all yours, you will be able to change:
 ( Frame ) The background color of your tabs.
 ( Selected tab ) The background color of your selected tab.
 ( Toolbar ) The background color of the toolbar.
 ( Accent color ) The color that give your selected tab a stronger/gentle border color to distinguish it.
 ( Top separator ) The separator line between tabs and toolbar.
 ( Icons ) The color of the icons so that they have good contrast.
 ( Urlbar ) The color of the URL field.
 ( Panels ) The background color of the arrow-panels (popup panel).
 ( Button hover ) The color for your buttons when you :hover on them.
 ( Button active ) The color for your buttons when you click on them.
You have too the possibility to change some font colors:
 ( Unselected tabs ) The color of your unselected tabs.
 ( Selected tab ) The color of your selected tab.
 ( Toolbar ) The color of the toolbar (url) and bookmarks.
 ( Panels ) The color of the letters into your arrow-panels (popup panels).
 ( New tab ) The color of the letters of your NewTab page.
 ( Sidebar ) The color of the letters of Firefox Sidebar.
 REQUIRED for dark theme: Set * svg.context-properties.content.enabled * to true in about:config page to fix various icons colors of this extension. How to do this .
 Known Limitations 
 Partial support for theme with images, in some of them the image will disappear if you try to apply the change of colors.
 If you use the ' system theme - automatic ' you are going to experience various problems, to resolve it you must first choose another theme, other than the automatic one, on the 'about:addons' page.
 For a complete customization you could try the theme ahead: Firefox-GX .

bluejetty:00138675:ios.description:
On Demand Calgary Transit is one of the ways we provide transit to communities that don’t have fixed route bus service yet. The service allows customers to book travel as needed, on their schedule.
It’s easy to get started:
1. Create an account.
Download the On Demand Calgary Transit app and follow the simple signup steps.
2. Book a ride.
Enter your pick-up and drop-off address. Choose the proposal that works for you by tapping Book This Ride.
3. Meet your driver.
Check the app to see your designated pickup point. It may be a short walk away, but it helps to cut down on detours and make your journey faster.
The route for each trip is planned based on the needs of customers on that vehicle – your trip may be different each time, but will always be planned to get you where you need to go quickly.
Our On Demand service welcomes strollers, kids, pets (in a small carrier), service dogs, luggage and/or groceries or other belongings (as long as they fit).
If you need a wheelchair accessible vehicle, let us know when you book your ride by tapping your profile picture or image at the top of the app menu and tapping the Wheelchair Accessibility toggle to turn it on.

bluejetty:00095251:android.description:
Chronology Squad Open for Recruitment!
Dive into the world of Girls' Frontline: Fire Control to command characters inspired by various firearm models and experience revolutionary 5v5 strategic gunplay in a third-person view. The combat is fast-paced yet easy to pick up. Get ready to unleash hero skills and turn the tide in team matches, securing first blood and even a pentakill!
The flames of war rages across higher-dimensional battlefields, and the fabric of the world lines is on the verge of collapse. With annihilation drawing near, the goddess Lunasia turns to Griffin's finest tactical Dolls to assemble a team capable of facing the ultimate crisis.
These elite agents are thrust into a relentless training program where past battles are reborn in virtual arenas. Each mission challenges their limits as they navigate randomized battlefields, testing their combat cores and sharpening their skills through unyielding trials. The countdown to a cataclysmic storm has begun—will they be ready to face the chaos beyond dimensions?
Girls' Frontline: Fire Control is a third-person shooter game for mobile devices, offering you:
【Immersive Third-Person Shooting Experience】
Command characters inspired by various firearm models and engage in combats on dynamic and complex battlefields. Adapt to diverse enemy types by selecting suitable weapons and upgrading chips to craft unique combat experience.
【Auto-Aim for Effortless Shooting】
An intuitive auto-aim system ensures that even beginners can quickly lock onto enemies and enjoy smooth, exhilarating shooting action.
【Diverse Tactical Chip System for Strategic Builds】
Explore a roguelike-inspired tactical chip system that allows you to craft unique builds for each battle. Equip chips to modify abilities, such as unleashing splitting projectiles, setting devastating area traps, or amplifying critical hits, enabling flexible strategies and rewarding experimentation.
【Multiple Game Modes Anytime, Anywhere】
Choose from a variety of gameplay modes: team up with friends to eliminate enemy forces or dive into thrilling 5v5 matches for competitive multiplayer action.
【Follow Us】

Discord: https://discord.gg/PB538m63SD

TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@gflfirecontrol

bluejetty:00045307:ios.description:
Locally Grown: The #1 App in the USA for Shopping from Farms & Homesteads
Discover the freshest produce, meat, dairy, and more from local farms in your area with Locally Grown. Skip the long lines at farmers markets and enjoy the convenience of flexible ordering at great prices. With Locally Grown, you can connect directly with your favorite farms, place orders, and schedule convenient delivery or pickup.
Why Choose Locally Grown?
 • Farm-Fresh Quality: Enjoy the best seasonal produce and farm products, guaranteed fresh or your money back.
 • Vetted Farmers: We carefully vet all our farm partners to ensure you receive only the highest quality products.
 • Support Local Farmers: Every purchase supports small farms and sustainable agriculture in your community.
 • Easy Ordering: A seamless shopping experience that lets you browse, order, and chat with farmers directly from your phone.
How It Works:
 1. Enter Your Location: Find farms near you with just a tap.
 2. Shop Local Farms: Browse a wide selection of fresh produce, meats, dairy, and artisanal goods.
 3. Schedule Your Delivery or Pickup: Choose a convenient time for your order to be delivered or pick it up from the farm.
 4. Chat with Farmers: Have questions or need to make last-minute changes? Easily communicate with farmers in real-time.
 5. Relax and Enjoy: Sit back as your order is prepared and get notified about order updates.
 6. Savor the Freshness: Taste the difference of farm-fresh food, delivered just for you.
Get Started Today!
Download Locally Grown now and start enjoying the freshest local food your area has to offer.
Farmers, Join Us!
Interested in selling your products on Locally Grown? Look for Locally Grown for Farmers on the App Store and join our growing community of local farmers today.

bluejetty:00175538:ios.summary:
Tired of replaying a conversation in your head, then freezing when it happens?
Vocal Image is an AI communication and soft skills coach. Every day it builds you a short personalized plan that mixes practice with an AI that talks back, voic
bluejetty:00175538:ios.description:
Tired of replaying a conversation in your head, then freezing when it happens?
Vocal Image is an AI communication and soft skills coach. Every day it builds you a short personalized plan that mixes practice with an AI that talks back, voice training, and quick lessons, so you sound confident when it counts.
YOUR DAILY PLAN
* AI roleplay. Practice a real conversation with an AI that plays the other person, your manager, your partner, your teenager, and pushes back the way they might. Afterward you see what worked, what did not, where filler words crept in, and better ways to say it.
* Voice training with instant voice analysis and vocal warm ups
* Breathing exercises for your vocal base
* Short videos with practical communication tips
* Mini podcasts on real conversations
* Tongue twisters and diction drills for clear speech, with instant Clarity and Speed scores
WHAT PEOPLE COME HERE TO PRACTICE
Prepare for the tough talk: rehearse difficult conversations with AI before they happen for real.
* How to ask for a raise and negotiate salary
* Mock job interviews and performance reviews: practice interview questions out loud, "tell me about yourself"
* Saying no at work, standing up for yourself, holding your no
* How to give honest feedback and take criticism without getting defensive
* Conflict at work: passive aggressive people, difficult coworkers, a micromanaging boss
* Delivering bad news, firing someone with dignity
* Client calls: onboarding a new client, complaints, holding your price
* Setting boundaries with family and parents
* Parenting talks: when your child will not listen, the screen time standoff, the puberty talk, telling kids about divorce, reconnecting after you yelled
* Confronting a friend, a noisy neighbor, calming an angry person
* Conversation starters, small talk, networking
* Presentation skills, public speaking and stage fright: pitching an idea, being concise, holding the room, facing a heckler, recovering when your mind goes blank
* Video calls and remote meetings: speaking up, being heard, sounding professional
14 SKILLS ACROSS 7 AREAS OF LIFE
Communication skills you can train: emotional regulation, active listening, hard conversations, boundaries, feedback, interpersonal and social skills, and more. Each skill is trained across parenting, career, business, romance, friendship, family of origin, and your relationship with yourself.
TESTS
The viral accent test, plus speech, voice, archetype and voice age tests.
EXPLORE
The full training library, including complete American and British accent reduction and English pronunciation courses.
VOICE ARENA
Share a voice recording, real people rate it and leave feedback: how you come across, not only what the AI thinks.
WHY IT WORKS
Hard conversations are hard because you have never said them out loud under pressure. Short daily reps fix that, and rehearsal lowers the emotional charge and builds the confidence to say it for real. It is the same behavioral rehearsal used for social anxiety.
Not a course. Not a lecture. Practice that talks back.
4 million people train with Vocal Image.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
After you download the app, you can start a free trial.
Unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial, you'll be automatically charged the price shown on the payment screen for your chosen subscription period. We'll send a reminder before your trial ends.
Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each period (weekly, monthly, every 3 months, yearly, or as selected) until you cancel. Canceling stops future renewals; you'll retain access to all features for the remainder of your current period.
Terms of Service: https://www.vocalimage.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.vocalimage.app/privacy
Questions? Contact us: support@vocalimage.app

Telegram: https://t.me/vocalimage

Take laundry day off your plate! Drop & Dash Laundry Service is Chicagoland's premium laundry pickup and delivery service. We collect your laundry at your door, wash and fold it with professional care, and return it fresh, wrapped, and ready to put away.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose a pickup window that fits your day, seven days a week.
2. Leave your laundry at the door in any bag.
3. We wash, dry, and fold your laundry to your preferences.
4. Your clothes come back fresh, wrapped, and ready to put away.
SIMPLE, HONEST PRICING
See current laundry-by-the-pound rates, flat-rate comforter pricing, order minimums, and delivery fees in the app before you book. No contracts or memberships required.
LOCALLY OWNED AND OPERATED
Drop & Dash Laundry Service is locally owned and operated, right here in Chicago. Your clothes are picked up and cleaned by our own team, with professional care one every order.
YOUR LAUNDRY, YOUR WAY

TRACK YOUR DRIVER
Track your driver in real time and stay informed about your pickup and delivery.
NOT HOME? NO PROBLEM

REAL HUMANS, LOCAL SUPPORT
Questions about our service or your order? Call our support team at (773) 436-1994. A real person is ready to help, every day from 7am to 7pm Central Time.
MORE CONVENIENCE IN THE APP
Same-day pickup is available subject to scheduling and service-area availability. Pay securely in the app and access digital receipts for your orders.

We serve Chicago and the surrounding suburbs. Enter your address in the app to confirm coverage and see available pickup windows.

Discover a world of relaxation and self-expression with Lake, the award-winning coloring app loved by millions.
Explore hand-drawn illustrations by independent artists and dive into a friendship of colors and brushstrokes right on your trusty iPad or iPhone. Unleash your creativity, nurture your artistic side, and discover the incredible impact coloring can have on your overall well being!
Start your free trial today and make a difference by supporting artists from all corners of the world.
SPARK YOUR CREATIVITY
- Get creative with the ultimate coloring tool set featuring a selection of artistic brushes. They're like magic wands but better!
- Explore our Rainbow with over 700 color shades. Who knew there were so many hues to choose from?
- Discover a variety of palettes as diverse as our drawings. From skin tones to hand-picked palettes, the choice is yours.
- Access any color you can imagine with the Color Picker. Your perfect shade is always just a tap and a glide away.
- A manageable number of coloring surfaces. You'll never feel overwhelmed!
- Color inside or outside the lines. The power is in your hands.
- Import a drawing from your device or snap a photo of it, then make it your own with color.
- Draw and color freely on a blank canvas and turn your own line art or sketches into coloring pages.
- Color with a reference and recreate drawings colored by artists.
- Learn all about Lake with video tutorials. From tools to techniques - everything you need to color with ease.
TAKE CARE OF YOUR WELLBEING
- Color drawings with a mood palette based on your current vibes.
- Need to vent or reflect? Jot down your thoughts in a coloring journal while creating beautiful masterpieces.
- Immerse yourself in the soothing sounds of brushes with our ASMR feature.
- Break out of your comfort zone with our curated Book of the Week and challenge yourself to reach new artistic horizons.
SUPPORT THE ARTISTIC COMMUNITY
- Take your pick from over 1500 exclusive drawings, carefully crafted to ignite your imagination.
- Explore artworks by over 100 independent artists, personally selected by Lake's editorial team.
- Revel in the magic of coloring hand-drawn illustrations
- Celebrate new drawings landing in Lake at least once a month with a 12-page coloring book exclusively designed for Lake.
LOVED BY APPLE AND OUR COMMUNITY
- Apple Design Award 2017
- "Lake offers a rewarding and relaxing coloring book experience for all ages. It brings together local and renowned artists with their fans through high-quality curated illustrations. Prepare to create a masterpiece!"- Apple, Inc.
- "If you're a supporter of working artists, you simply can't miss this coloring book app. It's bursting with incredible illustrations and gets updated all the time!" - Lory Gil from iMore
- “I love this coloring app and it has been so helpful for my mental health, especially during the difficult days.” - K. Davis, Lake user
In case you were wondering, Lake works offline and syncs seamlessly with your iCloud. No more worries about losing your precious colorings or journal entries. We've got your back!
For an even better experience, we recommend using an Apple Pencil. It's like a magic wand that enhances your journey through Lake's colorful universe.
So what are you waiting for? Grab your iPads or iPhones and get ready for a colorful adventure in Lake!
Got any suggestions or comments? Drop us a line or a DM at:
Email: info@lakecoloring.com
Instagram: @lakecoloring
TikTok: @lakecoloringapp

bluejetty:00064947:ios.description:
Save, spend, and invest anywhere in the world.
Shyft is the award winning retail forex, investments and payments app that gives you more for less, 24/7. Buy, store, send & invest the cheapest forex with Shyft – no matter where you bank! Shyft will save you time and money with fast transactions, flat rates and no commission fees. With our new-and-improved digital sign-up process, you can complete the entire onboarding process from the convenience of your smartphone. 
Shop
Shop locally and use your ZAR card to make purchases by swiping, or tap and go securely. You can also shop for the latest brands from around the globe using a Shyft virtual forex card. You can also use your virtual card for managing international subscriptions, booking flights or paying for hotels in foreign currency.
Travel
Order Multi-currency Shyft Mastercard debit cards to use while travelling overseas. Apart from the four currencies currently available on Shyft, you can use your physical Shyft forex card to withdraw local currency from any Mastercard supported ATM in the country you’re visiting (conversion fees may apply). Buy a souvenir or two with your physical card, and top up your cards anytime, anywhere, right from the app. Travelling to the Far East? We also offer a Union Pay International Card accepted throughout China, order one via the app today.
Invest
Shyft Shares allows you to invest in the top U.S. stocks and ETFs directly from your phone and desktop, so now you can also own a share in the world’s best companies. See the most popular shares and how they have been tracking over the last 30 days and create a watchlist to keep your eye on. All you’ll need to start trading is your tax number.

The Shyft Global Wallet provides you with a safe and secure way to purchase and hold foreign currencies at the best rates. You can also easily and conveniently send forex to an offshore bank account by creating an offshore beneficiary and transferring funds as and when required. Payments to the US, UK and Europe can take less than a day to settle.
Get your money moving
So, you’ve got the app and your cards, you’ve bought forex, but what else does the Shyft app offer you? This should give you an idea: You can send money to Shyft users, for free, or pay international beneficiaries, charged at a flat rate. You can now also access and fund an offshore account with the help of our integrated partners.

ZAR

bluejetty:00080794:ios.description:
The leading review of the arts and intellectual life. Download for a FREE sample issue. The New Criterion is a monthly review of culture and the arts edited by Roger Kimball. Founded in 1982 by the art critic Hilton Kramer and the pianist and music critic Samuel Lipman, The New Criterion began as an experiment in critical audacity, a publication devoted to engaging, in Matthew Arnold's famous phrase, with "the best that has been thought and said." Harry Mount in the Daily Telegraph of London has called The New Criterion "America's leading review of the arts and intellectual life" Julian Symons, in the Times Literary Supplement, writes that "As a critical periodical, The New Criterion is probably more consistently worth reading than any other magazine in English." Published monthly from September through June, The New Criterion brings together a wide range of young and established critics whose common aim is to bring you the most incisive criticism being written today. bluejetty:00174662:ios.description:
WHAT IS VIRTUAL REGATTA ?
Virtual Regatta is a free sailing game, an offshore racing simulation. Virtual Regatta is not like simple sailing games, by playing Virtual Regatta you become the skipper of your boat/sailboat against the "winds of the globes".
Race against hundreds of thousands of rivals in real time and compete against Vendée Globe skippers like Jérémie Beyou, Sam Davies and Alex Thomson from your computer, smartphone or tablet.
ENDLESS POSSIBILITIES ON VIRTUAL REGATTA!
An incomparable fleet of sailing boats: you will have more choice than in a boat rental! Indeed Virtual Regatta allows you to sail on many boats such as Class 40, Imoca, Figaro, Imoca, Ocean 50, Offshore Racer, mini 6,50, Super Maxi 100, Tara, Ultim, Caravelle...
In addition, several formats of offshore races are available to delight all e-sailors.
AS CLOSE TO REALITY AS POSSIBLE!
Virtual Regatta innovates day after day in order to bring e-sailors closer to the real conditions experienced by skippers on their boats at sea with features such as
• Energy management: Learn how to manage your energy like a strategist to stand out from your competitors, because depending on your state of fatigue, your manoeuvres are more or less fast as in reality.
• The one-minute engine: The position of your boat is now calculated every minute!
JOIN THE VIRTUAL REGATTA COMMUNITY!
Virtual Regatta is the biggest sailing community in the world and counts more than 1 million active e-skippers.
Virtual Regatta is an official partner of the FFVoile, the World Sailing Federation (World Sailing) and the Olympic Games with whom Virtual Regatta co-organizes all existing official eSailing events. Sail with the best !
Virtual Regatta is the official sailing simulation game of the biggest sailing races: Vendée Globe, Route du Rhum, Transat Jacques Vabre, Solitaire Le Figaro, and the Olympic Virtual Series. Take the helm of your boat and compete with the biggest names in offshore racing in Virtual Regatta!
HOW TO PLAY VIRTUAL REGATTA ?
• Give your boat a name.
• Start at the same time as the real skippers on your virtual boat.
• Use the real weather as a tactician.
• Adapt your sails to the weather conditions.
• Adjust your course according to the weather conditions.
• Follow your boat on your mobile or tablet.
• Track the position of other competitors.
• Plan a course change.
VIRTUAL REGATTA VIP MEMBERSHIP
• The VIP membership is available for a period of 3, 6 or 12 months (automatically renewable).
• The VIP membership gives access to bonus features of the game.
• The payment will be debited from the iTunes account when the purchase is confirmed.
• Subscription renews automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• The account will be billed for the renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, and identifies the cost of the renewal.
• Subscriptions can be managed by the user and automatic renewal can be disabled by accessing the user's account settings after purchase.
TERMS OF USE
https://click.virtualregatta.com/?li=4952
PRIVACY POLICY https://static.virtualregatta.com/ressources/PrivacyPolicyVRApps.htm?v=201807• If the subscription is cancelled, the package will still be available until the end of the paid period

DistroTV™ is a free streaming service with over 300 free channels featuring the best free shows and free movies from the US, Canada, UK and all around the world. Watch live shows, live sports, live news, music, movies, and entertainment anytime and anywhere – always for free.
Watch DistroTV directly on the web and across a wide variety of connected TV platforms such as Android TV, Amazon Fire TV, Roku, Google TV, Apple TV, Samsung TV, LG TV, Sony TV, iOS, & Android.
DistroTV’s line-up includes a diverse roster of premium content, all in one easy to view place:
• ENTERTAINMENT – Entertaining channels & TV shows for every mood: From popular dramas on Electric Now, real-life courtroom drama on Law and Crime and California eye-candy on Kaloopy
• MOVIES – Over a dozen free movie channels with favorites to savor or discover for the first-time including CineLife by Magnolia Pictures; movies curated for diverse audiences on KweliTV & Movie Kingdom; prepare to be scared by FrightFlix, Horror Machine & Watch It Scream; Movimex and the comic book crowd on ConTV & Galxy.
• SPORTS – Free live sports for every fan including Stadium, Unbeaten, Whistle TV, the ACC conference with College Basketball and Football, Pro Football Focus, 8 MMA channels, Motor Sports, World Poker Tour, Outside TV and much more. 
• NEWS & BUSINESS – Get informed with free News, Business and Opinion for all points of view: Newsy, Euronews, Bloomberg, Bloomberg Quicktake, Law & Crime, The Street, The First and OAN
• CELEBRITY & REALITY – Lifestyle and celebrity gossip from People TV, US Weekly and Young Hollywood. Reality programs such as Maury Povich & Jerry Springer on the Nosey Channel, Operation Repo & Right Now TV.
• DESI: INDIAN & SOUTH ASIAN – Watch the latest live and on-demand popular Desi South-Asian channels from News (Republic World, WION, Mirror Now), Music (Mastiii TV, BritAsia), Entertainment (Zoom, Arre) & Lifestyle (Swar Shree, Channel S, Akaal Channel, Garv Punjab)
• SPANISH LANGUAGE – Watch your favorite live streaming Spanish-language channels for sports, news, reality, movies, music, shows & telenovelas. Choose from diverse channels such as Euronews Español; Wapp TV, Latido Music, Moovimex, Canela TV and much more!
• DOCUMENTARIES – World class documentaries from Magellan TV, Docurama, True History, Titanic Channel, Military Times and Sword and Shield.
• MUSIC – Major music channels with live concerts from the Grand Ole Opry on Circle, Qello Concerts, music videos for any taste from LoopTV and even free Karaoke!
• CLASSIC SHOWS & MOVIES – TV you grew up on such as Bonanza, I Love Lucy, The Beverly Hillbillies on retro TV channels like Buzzr (classic game shows), Ace TV, Classic Reruns TV. Watch your favorite classic Cary Grant & Audrey Hepburn movie on Bowery Classics, The Film Detective and The Lone Star Channel.
• FUN & GAMES – Amuse yourself with Chive TV; get your video gaming fix with VENN TV, Dot Esports, & Arcade Cloud and sharpen your cue stick with Billiard TV. 
• Plus eclectic channels for every taste, cooking with Cooking Panda and even a 24/7 Fish Tank!
Download the FREE DistroTV app today and explore a world of free TV!

bluejetty:00095228:ios.description:
**Run. Rank. Repeat.**
Runify is the first-ranked running app that transforms your runs into a competitive experience. Earn XP, unlock new tiers, and climb the leaderboard while tracking your progress and challenging friends. Whether you're running solo or side by side with others, every step counts.
Gamified Running Tracker | XP | Ranks | Leaderboards | Clubs | Streaks
**Level Up Your Running:**
Advance through competitive ranks like Bronze, Diamond, and Iridescent based on your distance, consistency, and pace. Runify rewards your performance with XP and a visual rank system designed to keep you motivated.
- Earn XP after every run
- Progress through a ranked tier system
- Lose rank if you go inactive
- Unlock a visual identity that evolves with you
**Compete With Friends:**
Running is better with rivals. Compare times, chase leaderboard spots, and see how you stack up against your crew or the world.
- Friends, global, country, and club leaderboards
- Race across 1K, 5K, 10K, and more
- Watch your rivals rise or fall in real time
**Compete by Country & Run Club:**
Take your rank past your friends list. See where you stand among runners across your country, or build a private club for your crew, team, workplace, or school and race on your own leaderboard.
- Country leaderboards for regional competition
- Private, invite-only run club leaderboards
- Create a run club and invite members with a link
- Top-three podium and full ranked standings
- See your own rank even when you're outside the top list
- New Countries & Clubs section in the Ranks tab
**Share Your Grind:**
Create post-run visuals that showcase your stats with style. Customize your templates and post them straight to your story.
- Auto-filled template editor
- Includes time, distance, and pace
- Export directly to Instagram
**Track Your Progress:**
Every run earns data. Visualize your effort with XP graphs, streak history, and run breakdowns. Runify doesn't just track; it reflects your journey.
- Weekly summaries and lifetime stats
- XP over time and recent runs
- Personal progression and rank trends
Download Runify today and earn your place on the leaderboard.
Consistency isn't optional—it's ranked.
Privacy Policy: https://runifyprivacy.carrd.co/
Terms of Service: https://runifytermsandconditions.carrd.co/

Features Include:
* Real-time marine weather buoy data
* 6-hour historical wave height trend reports
* 5-day National Weather Service marine forecast
Real-time Data Includes:
 - Significant wave height, period and direction
 - Wind speed, gust and direction
 - Air temperature
 - Water temperature
 - Pressure
6-hour History Data Includes:
 - Significant wave height, period, direction
5-day NWS Marine Forecast
 - Text summary, spot specific forecast
 - Weather, sky, wind, waves
Simply tap anywhere on the map and view NOAA's spot specific point (and zone) marine forecast.
It's so simple and fast to use, that there is no need for saving favorites. However, the app will automatically save your most recently viewed forecast for future viewing.

Enjoy.

bluejetty:00185511:ios.name: Food Fantasy
bluejetty:00185511:ios.summary: Food Fantasy is a “Food Personified” RPG adventure management game. Inspired by hundreds of recipes from around the world, a group of world renowned artists and voice actors have brought food to life. Giving them unique personalities, stori
bluejetty:00185511:ios.description:
Food Fantasy is a “Food Personified” RPG adventure management game. Inspired by hundreds of recipes from around the world, a group of world renowned artists and voice actors have brought food to life. Giving them unique personalities, stories, looks and designs. In game, you’ll be able to engage in combat with your Food Souls, collect ingredients, develop recipes and create your very own world-class restaurant! 
Food Personified – Collect Food Souls
Collect Food Souls from around the world with unique personalities, traits& looks. Tiramisu, Boston Lobster, Spaghetti, Coffee and Red Win and many more waiting for you to encounter on your adventure! 
DIY Management – Create your unique restaurant 
Real restaurant simulator with hundreds of recipes for you to discover. Customize and decorate your restaurant with different furniture and designs. Complete take-out orders and prevent dine & dash customers. 
Build your very own 5-star restaurant! 
Amazing Voiceovers – Voice of Food Souls
Voiceovers done by a cast of world renowned Japanese Voice Actors! Miyuki Sawashiro, NatsukiHanae, Takuya Eguchi, Ayane Sakura, AyumuMurase,Kenshō Ono, Ayako Kawasumi,Aoi Yūki and many more talented actors using their voice to bring life to the Food Souls! 
Food Combos – Hundreds of Food Pairings
Tiramisu & Chocolate, Coffee & Milk, Steak & Red Wine and various otherpowerful and “delicious” combos for you to turn the tides of battle. Unique “Talents” and an everchanging “weather” system brings uncertainty and excitement during combat. 
Foodies, it’s time to put your skills to the test! 
PLEASE NOTE! Food Fantasy is free to download and play, however some game items can also be purchased for real money. If you do not want to use this feature, please set up password protection for purchases in the settings of your AppStore. Also, under our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, you must be at least 13 years of age to play or download Food Fantasy.
Have any questions or issues with the game from Elex Tech? 
Reach us at: foodfantasy.help@gmail.com
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/foodfantasygame/

Did you ever go to the store, buy a DVD only to discover at home that you already own it? With our app this will not ever h
bluejetty:00028718:ios.description:
The Movie Tracker & DVD Inventory app lets you create a movie and series database quickly and manage it seamlessly!
Did you ever go to the store, buy a DVD only to discover at home that you already own it? With our app this will not ever happen again. Our amazingly designed movie lab app allows you to keep track of all the DVDs as well as organize your watchlist. You can also share a film or series shelf with friends and maintain them together. Thus, this movie organizer is very useful if you live together in the same household and share your DVDs. Though buying DVDs is a past thing; if you are still into the game, then this movie diary app is here to help.
Whether you are searching for an app to organize your movie library or a movie recommendation app to get to know all about new and amazing movies, the Movie Tracker & DVD Inventory app is here to help.
Download one of the best movie collection tracker apps and organize your movie library according to your will.
This Movie Organizer Allows You To
- Create a virtual shelf and add your movies or series so you can keep track of your collection seamlessly.
- Maintain your movie library easily from different devices.
- Cloud Storage: Each backup of data in case you change your phone.
- Also, works as a movie tracker. Track watched movies. Multiple entries for the same movie are possible if another person has also seen the movie.
- Use it as a dvd tracker and keep record of which DVDs you owned or borrowed.
- Put all the movies and series in the wish list to watch later.
- Discover new movies or series from different categories.
You can get movie recommendations as well as discover movies that are trending and latest.
KEY FEATURES
DVD Barcode Scanner:
Add movies or series via online search or scanning of the barcode in my movie collection app. The EAN number is compared to a huge database to get you the most accurate results including cover photos. With this dvd tracker, keep track of all dvds you have borrowed. Create a movie bucket list and enjoy!
Customize & Share Movie Collection:
If you are looking for a movie tracker or collection tracker app that allows you to customize the functions, then this app is here for you. Create multiple shelfs and customize them. Add movies or series via scanning their barcodes or use the online search functionality. Sort your movies by title, release date, date added, etc. and use filters to display movies containing a specific keyword such as, unseen movies, lent movies, etc. Using this movie organizer, you can add a note to each movie and track who has already seen it. Maintain a wish list for all movies or series that you are willing to buy.
Add friends in this movie checklist app and share your movie collection. You can also maintain the same shelf with your friends or family.
Whether you are looking for movie recommendation apps or movie organizers to keep track of your movie database, trying this movie library will be worth the effort. Customize movie list, track dvd list, discover movies, share the same shelf with friends and family and enjoy together.
Install the Movie Tracker & DVD Inventory app on your device, use it as your movie diary and track everything effortlessly. 
Disclaimer:
For copyright reasons the Screenshots only show fictitious movies. Inside the app it is of course possible to find and add real movies and series. All film-related metadata used inside the app is supplied by The Movie Database (https://www.themoviedb.org/). While this app uses the TMDb API it is not endorsed or certified by TMDb.
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00146528:ios.name: Idle Clans
bluejetty:00146528:ios.summary: Idle Clans aims to provide the classic MMORPG experience in a casual way. Everything you would expect from an MMORPG, but at your own pace. You don't need to quit your day job to keep up with others. If you only have a moment, that's still
bluejetty:00146528:ios.description:
Idle Clans aims to provide the classic MMORPG experience in a casual way. Everything you would expect from an MMORPG, but at your own pace. You don't need to quit your day job to keep up with others. If you only have a moment, that's still enough to keep your character progressing.
CLANS
The game's title might give it away, but a central part of the game is its clan system. Create a clan or join an existing one to collaborate with others and speed up your own progression. Clans can unlock clan-specific upgrades, clan events, clan bosses and clan quests.
Some clans are very casual, some coordinate at levels our government agencies could take notes from. The clan recruitment centre makes it easy to find the right clan for you.
PLAYER-DRIVEN ECONOMY
Every item you purchase on the player market has been obtained or crafted by another player.
SKILLS & COMBAT
Deep, interconnected skilling, crafting and combat systems are the core of the game. There are dozens of skills to level up along with an ever-growing collection of items, upgrades and modifiers. Content varies from lowly turkeys that are incapable of doing harm to end-game bosses and raids that'll put your game knowledge to the test.
Completing every achievement grants you the Grandmaster rank. That's a journey lasting years, and we might be biased here, but what a journey it is!
FREE-TO-PLAY
Idle Clans is free-to-play with optional in-app purchases. These provide tokens that can be claimed for permanent ranks. The tokens are tradeable, meaning anything in the game shop can also be bought with in-game gold, as many players opt to do.
COMMUNITY
Idle Clans has been actively developed since its launch in 2023, and our amazing community has played a massive part in shaping the game. With 10k+ players in our Discord server, there's no shortage of ideas and discussion.

bluejetty:00062763:ios.description:
Finally, a planner that works the way your brain does. 400,000+ people use TimeFinder to build flexible, color-coded plans that bend—not break—when life happens.
The #1 time blocking app on the App Store—refined over 8 years of user feedback. Whether you have ADHD, a packed schedule, or just a brain that resists plans, this is planning that finally clicks.
"This app allows me to brain dump all my tasks into a list and then decide each day which ones to slide into my schedule. It's reduced my stress because I frequently overfill my day. Now I can realistically see what I can do." — LynnProgrammer
SEE YOUR DAY. SHAPE YOUR DAY.
- Drag & Drop: Pull tasks from your lists into your schedule—or back again
- Flexible Time Blocks: Plan in 5, 10, 15, 30, or 60-minute chunks
- Color-Coded Clarity: Every task gets a color so your day makes sense at a glance
- Multiple Views: Day, week, month*, and agenda*—see your schedule your way
PLANS CHANGE. THAT'S THE POINT.
- Schedule Shift: Running late? Shift your tasks earlier or later with a single tap
- Task Rollover*: Roll unfinished tasks into available time slots—nothing gets lost
- Task Bucket*: Commit tasks to a date without locking them to a specific time
- Zero Friction: Stretch, shrink, and rearrange by dragging—no menus needed
"PRECISELY what I have been looking for, as if it were tailored for me! For ADHD persons—it is just so dang helpful!" — Summitmarlene
LISTS. SCHEDULE. FOCUS.
- Split View: See your lists and schedule side by side—drag between them
- Focus Mode: A guided timer that helps you work through your plan, task by task
- Apple Watch: See your upcoming schedule on your wrist with complications
- Subtasks: Break big tasks into steps and track progress as you go
SYNCS WITH YOUR LIFE
- Calendar Sync*: Import events from Apple Calendar, Google, and Outlook—and export your TimeFinder schedule back
- Reminders Sync*: Two-way sync with Apple Reminders—changes update in both apps
- Widgets: Home Screen, Lock Screen, and Live Activities
- iPhone, iPad, Mac & Apple Watch: Your schedule stays in sync across all your devices
"I 'touch' my todo items just once—to put them on a time block to execute. These tasks aren't 'living' with me anymore. They're actually getting done." — Kurt4i
MAKE IT YOURS
- Color Palettes: Choose from dozens of presets—or build your own in the Palette Editor*
- Schedule Templates*: Save your best routines and reapply them in one tap
- Custom Intervals: Break up your day however works for you
BUILT OVER 8 YEARS. SHAPED BY REAL USERS.
TimeFinder started as one developer's answer to his own ADHD and procrastination. 8 years and 400,000+ downloads later, it's still independently built and personally supported by its founder, Luke—no faceless corporation, no VC playbook. Every update reflects real feedback from real people.
- Direct support from the developer
- Share ideas at feedback.timefinder.app
- Regular updates driven by your feedback
Eligible new subscribers can try TimeFinder Premium free for 7 days and discover why so many say it's the planner they've been looking for.
* Full access to features marked with an asterisk requires TimeFinder Premium, available through an in-app subscription or lifetime purchase.

bluejetty:00177878:ios.description:
Christmas ringtones provides you a great selection of Christmas music and ringtones for your mobile phone.
Christmas ringtones is an app, which provides you a great selection of Christmas music and ringtones for your mobile phone.
We have created an app with all kinds of free Christmas songs, so you can use them quickly and easily. If you are looking for free, high-quality ringtones, you’re in the right place.
Use it to wish “Merry Christmas” with some carols full of love and happiness.
With Christmas ringtones app, you can:
- Set any Xmas ringtones as your default ringtone.
- Use them as your notification ringtones.
- Set any Christmas sounds you wish as your smartphone alarm tone.
- Install the ringtone for a specific contact in your phone.
How do I use the “Christmas ringtones” app?
It’s very user friendly, you just have to follow these steps:
1. Download Christmas ringtones and install the app.
2. Sounds are classified into 2 categories, so you have to choose one category to proceed.
3. Listen to the sounds until you find the one you like.
4. Once you’ve found the ringtone you like, tap on the right arrow to set it as your call, notification or alarm tone.
Main features:
- Lots of ringtones for your mobile phone, classified into categories, which makes it easier to find the type of sound you are looking for. You can choose Christmas notifications as well as Christmas carols and songs, and set them as your ringtones for this very special time of the year.
- Once you’ve chosen a category, you’ll find lots of free ringtones and you can listen to them directly from the app.
- You can set any sound in the app as your smartphone ringtone or your notification sound, or even set it exclusively for one of your contacts or as your alarm tone.
- If you set the ringtone as your notification sound, you can use it as your message or SMS ringtone, as your email sound or for any type of notification from your installed apps (social networks, messaging apps, etc.).
- The app has a favorite system, and you can save any ringtones you wish as favorites and use or play them on your smartphone whenever you want to.
- This app is constantly updated. New sounds and music are added, so you can keep enjoying new and fun Christmas tunes and ringtones.
Unlock the Premium version to enjoy even more festive features:
- Exclusive Tones: Unlock access to premium and exclusive Christmas ringtones.
- Favorites Section: Premium users can save and manage their favorite ringtones for quick access.
- Ad-Free Experience: Enjoy browsing the app without interruptions from ads.
We hope you like this free ringtone app. If that’s the case, please give us a positive rating and leave a comment, so that we can keep updating it and adding new sounds and improvements. All the positive ratings and suggestions encourage us to keep optimizing it.
Legal note:
This app uses sound clips under public domain license. When the sound or melody is under a Creative Commons license, there’s a section in the app where the relevant credits are listed. If you have any questions, please contact us at: reticode@gmail.com
Privacy Policy: https://reticode.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://reticode.com/terms/terms-of-service-christmas-ringtones.html

bluejetty:00061055:ios.summary:
Live flight tracker for Dallas/Fort Worth Airport (DFW). Free.

bluejetty:00061055:ios.description:
Live flight tracker for Dallas/Fort Worth Airport (DFW). Free.
Arrivals, departures and flight status — on time, delayed, diverted, cancelled or landed. Gate numbers, baggage carousels and terminals, live. And keep the rest of your trip in the same app: boarding passes, where you parked, packing lists, tickets and bookings.
Perfect for travellers, frequent flyers, taxi drivers, airport staff and anyone meeting or seeing off passengers at Dallas/Fort Worth Airport.
FLIGHTS
• Live arrivals and departures board, refreshed with one tap
• Search by flight number, airline, city, airport, terminal, gate or baggage belt
• Status at a glance: on time, delayed, diverted, cancelled, landed
• Codeshare flight matching
• Domestic and international filters
• Favourite flights
• Weather and local time at both ends of a flight, with a 3-day forecast
• Flights-per-hour report and status sharing
• Dark mode, 12- or 24-hour time, °C or °F
• Available in 61 languages
MY TRIP — YOUR TRAVEL ESSENTIALS
• Boarding passes: snap a photo, the barcode is read and shown full-screen at the gate
• My car: photos, a note and (optionally) the location of your spot, with walking directions back
• Checklists: packing lists to tick off, with a starter list
• Bag tags: tag number, airline and a photo of your bag
• Receipts: snap a receipt and the total is read for you
• Tickets: train, bus, ferry and event tickets, barcode shown large
• Bookings: hotel, car hire and insurance, with tap-to-call, maps and the confirmation attached
• Links and notes: save links from other apps and keep trip notes
• Trip dates with a countdown
• Backup to a file, with an optional password
Everything stays on your phone. No account needed.
PRO SUBSCRIPTION
• Add and edit everything in My trip
• Both ends of every flight: times, terminal, gate and baggage
• Flight details: taxi-out, air time, taxi-in and delays at each end
• Aircraft type and registration (tail number)
• Security and customs queue wait times (supported airports)
• PDF export of your trip and receipts
• No ads
Download now and always know exactly where every DFW flight stands.
—
This app is not an official airport app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Dallas/Fort Worth Airport or any airline. For definitive flight times, please check the official airport or airline website. The developer accepts no liability for incidents resulting from use of the data shown.
Terms of Use (EULA)
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Deep in the heart of the forest lies the Moonlight Tunnel, a place steeped in mystery and legend. Many have dared to enter its depths, but few have returned to tell the tale. It is said that those who do venture into the tunnel are approached by dark forces, spirits and strange cults who lurk in the shadows.
In 1915, a young girl named May and her family lived nearby, but tragedy struck when they were brutally murdered. May, along with her doll, managed to escape into the tunnels, but was never seen again. Some say her spirit still haunts the tunnel.
Outside the tunnel rumors circulate of a powerful artifact, and cults vying for its possession. It is said that a dark force, an ancient demon, has been unleashed and now possesses the spirit of one of the victims. The fate of the artifact and the trapped spirit remains unknown.
Will you dare to enter the Moonlight Tunnel?

bluejetty:00133175:ios.summary:
