Help the Magical Kingdom battle against forces of evil, co
bluejetty:00133175:ios.description:
A wholesome twist on a beloved fairytales, “Merge Magic Princess” combines beloved characters from storybooks and cartoons in one Merge 3 game. Are you ready to collect them all?
Help the Magical Kingdom battle against forces of evil, corrupting the beautiful royal garden. Merge various items to heal the land! Explore the flying island, unlock new locations by clearing the clouds and match everything. What can this item turn into? Let your Princesses help you and get tons of rewards
Find a playstyle for you! Build and develop your home camp, or complete levels and quest on the world map… or both. Train your brain with challenging time-limited puzzles, where every move counts, or relax and destress in the Camp Garden, managing your little Princesses. Switch things up! 
Let the princesses decide their own destinies! They are no longer passive figures from old stories; in the world of “Merge Magic Princess”, heroines show their wisdom and strength, becoming masters of their own destinies. Red Riding Hood cured her Grandmother with a Magic Potion, Show White trapped the Evil Queen in the Mirror, Cinderella aids the prince in kingdom affairs post-marriage, while the Little Mermaid, despite becoming human and facing trials, achieves true love… 
Be a maker of your own destiny too! Design, organize and build your own dream island. Manage different items, clean up dragon bones, grass and dried up trees to clear up some space. Once your spirit helpers get to work, you will be overflowing with resources. Can you sort and match everything? Use logic and strategize. Should you merge it right away or wait and try to merge 5 of the same item to get some extra? Complete quests, collect stars and unlock new buildings and decor for your home camp. 
Arrange plants, flowers and trees, move castles and shrines, place beautiful statues of cute animals and magnificent goddesses… Create a true royal castle garden!
Come and play Merge Magic Princess now! Experience a different kind of fairy tale story!
– Merge –
Match three objects to evolve it
Combine Five or more items to get a bonus
Unlock more than 300 different items
Get rewards for completing your journal
– Explore –
Safe Princesses and unlock new Land
Find new curiosities… ancient dragon statues, giant skeletons and baskets full of spirit eggs
Travel the kingdom from level to level, visiting one fantasy island after another
– Collect –
Find Spirit Eggs all across the realm to hatch princesses
Meet beloved characters and discover new heroines from different cultures
Enjoy cute anime art-style, from adorable chibi baby versions to breathtaking full art of the evolved princess!
–Even more! –
Perfect way to destress!
Suitable for any age, fun for both little ones and adults!
Easy & simple controls!
Play on the go or enjoy a long cozy session!
Other than 1000 levels to beat, the fun is never ending!
Organize, customize and build your dream Island of Magic in “Merge Magic Princess”

ONE CLUE CROSSWORD is a new kind of crossword puzzle. Instead of a list of written clues, each puzzle includes a single p
bluejetty:00120426:ios.description:
Exercise your brain every day with picture crosswords!
* Now with 1000+ puzzles, including over 200 Bonus puzzles! *
ONE CLUE CROSSWORD is a new kind of crossword puzzle. Instead of a list of written clues, each puzzle includes a single picture. Every word in each puzzle can be deduced from the picture.
In some of the puzzles you'll just need to say what you see - but in others you'll need to think a little more laterally. It's easy to play, but with 100s of unique puzzles, you might find it hard to put down!
■ A whole new way to play crosswords
■ 800+ puzzles over 58 chapters (with more to come)
■ 230+ all-new bonus puzzles to discover as you play
■ NEW - 'Mix-Up' mode!
■ End-of-chapter Guardian Puzzles will test your word skills
■ Hundreds of beautiful photos - people, places, animals and more
■ Use instant hints to remove unused letters or reveal the next letter in a clue
SUPPORT
Please select the HELP option from the Options menu (the gear icon in the bottom left of the game screen) if you require assistance.
If you still have questions about the game or require further assistance, please email: support@puzzling.com
One Clue Crossword is free to play, but contains optional paid items to unlock puzzles more quickly. You can disable in-app purchase functionality in your device's settings if you do not want to use this feature.
www.puzzling.com

bluejetty:00159095:ios.name: Slatable - Self Tape Yourself
bluejetty:00159095:ios.summary: Since 2016, Slatable has helped actors create self tape auditions, even without a reader. We pioneered the ability to record professional auditions completely solo, eliminating the need to rely on others for a truly independent workflow. Bu
bluejetty:00159095:ios.description:
Since 2016, Slatable has helped actors create self tape auditions, even without a reader. We pioneered the ability to record professional auditions completely solo, eliminating the need to rely on others for a truly independent workflow. Built specifically for actors, the app combines recording, editing, and industry standards in one streamlined workflow. Whether you're at home, traveling, or on set, Slatable lets you concentrate on your craft, not the technical details of a self tape audition.
Our SceneAudio feature allows you to self tape without a reader and with Premium's SceneAudio AI you can now convert your voice to sound like you're reading with another actor. Our innovative teleprompter lets you use PDFs, text or even scanned pages in camera or with a beam splitter teleprompter setup. 
Created in collaboration with industry-leading casting directors and industry professionals, Slatable is the go-to app for aspiring and working actors around the world.
SAY GOODBYE TO EXPENSIVE SELF TAPE STUDIOS. SAY HELLO TO SLATABLE.
Set the Industry Standard
From file naming to file size, we ensure you always maintain a professional edge when you send your self tapes using Slatable.
Streamlined Self Taping
No more juggling between multiple apps. Slatable simplifies the process, enabling you to record, edit, and share your auditions, all within one convenient app.
Fast. Easy. Efficient.
Designed for actors by actors. Slatable lets you focus on your audition, producing exceptional self-tapes in just a few taps.
No Reader? No Problem!
Recording self tapes without a reader? It happens. With Slatable, you can capture audio for the other characters and play them back when you record a takes. With Slatable Premium you can change your voice with SceneAudio AI voice changer.
---Slatable Premium Features:
SceneAudio AI
Record the other characters’ lines and change it to a voice of your choice. Sounds like another actor is in the room!
Record SceneAudio Line by Line
Made a mistake? Just re-record that line. Rearrange lines or convert them with SceneAudio AI for precise control over your audition.
Track and Manage
Slatable simplifies audition management. Keep tabs on the casting directors you've submitted to and the creation dates of your auditions.
Your Audition Assistant
Save notes with each audition ensuring you remember every detail from self tape to the set. 
Detailed Search
Filter auditions by title, character name, casting director, or your notes so you can reference past self tapes and jobs.
Stay on Cue with the Teleprompter
Slatable Premium's teleprompter, tailored for actors like you, seamlessly handles scripts in any format. Import PDFs as text, PDFs with markup, or even scanned scripts. Alternatively, copy, paste, and write your own. You can practice before you film in the stand-alone teleprompter that also has beam-splitter support. 
Portrait Mode Recording
Shoot and import in portrait. Add scene audio for TikTok-style auditions or full-body slates.
Control Your Performance
Start and stop scene audio and the teleprompter roll with a Bluetooth media controller.
Flexible Video Import
Easily import portrait and landscape videos shot on your device.
Tailor Your Presentation
Customize the placement of title cards and transitions or remove them altogether.
Media Galleries
Effortlessly store headshots and slates to enhance your title cards and submissions.
Multiple Scenes and Takes
Take your time to perfect your scene with unlimited scenes, scene audio and Takes.
Save Individual Takes
Skip the hassle of compiling large videos and save individual takes to your device.
Photo‑to‑Video
Import photos to create a 5‑second video clip to add to your audition tape.
Screen Mirror to your Mac
Use the back camera and mirror to your Mac for perfect framing.

bluejetty:00120752:ios.name: ZX81
bluejetty:00120752:ios.summary:
Welcome to a taste of early 1980s home computing.

bluejetty:00120752:ios.description:
Welcome to a taste of early 1980s home computing.
This app focuses on the Sinclair ZX81 experience and is loaded with example software. A streamlined watchOS app is included, offering saved session syncing with the iOS app on the paired iPhone.
Background:
In 1980 the British company Science of Cambridge (later renamed Sinclair Research) released the Sinclair ZX80 home computer. The computer was developed with another technology company, Nine Tiles, and manufactured in a Timex Corporation factory in Dundee, Scotland. Followed in March 1981 by the even more popular successor, the Sinclair ZX81, both models had a profound impact on home and hobbyist computing in the UK and many other countries. Timex Corporation and Sinclair Research continued their joint venture and released the Timex Sinclair 1000 (TS1000) and 1500 (TS1500) variants of the ZX81 for the US market in July 1982 and July 1983 respectively.
Meanwhile, another iconic British home computer, the Sinclair ZX Spectrum, was under development and hit the market in April 1982... but that's another story.
Special thanks to Nine Tiles for granting permission to include the ROM code, to which they retain the intellectual property rights after all these years.
Additionally, many thanks to all the developers of the loaded ZX81 software who have all granted permission to include their titles in the app. We hope this list of software will continue to grow in future updates.

bluejetty:00040717:ios.description:
SafePass is a secure authenticator app for two-factor authentication (2FA). Get one-time codes (TOTP) for Login.gov, Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Coinbase and any service that supports authenticator apps, protected by Face ID. SafePass Premium adds encrypted backups with iCloud sync, quick transfer to a new iPhone, Password AutoFill and Password Health checks for weak, reused and breached passwords.
Designed to meet the growing demand for reliable two-factor authentication (2FA), SafePass generates Time-based One-Time Passwords (TOTP) to help secure your accounts on platforms like Login.gov, SAP Concur, Epic Games, Crypto.com, Discord, Shopify, Stripe, Binance, and more.
Whether you’re protecting your gaming profiles, crypto wallets, eCommerce dashboards, or government logins, SafePass helps you stay secure with a seamless multi-factor authentication experience.
Core Features of SafePass Authenticator App:
 • Generate and store TOTP 2FA codes for platforms like Login.gov, SAP, Crypto.com, Epic Games, Shopify, and Binance.
 • Protect access with Face ID, Touch ID, or password.
 • Secure iCloud sync (disabled by default, user-enabled).
 • Built-in Password Manager with provider logo recognition to help you easily identify your logins.
 • Strong password generator for creating complex, secure credentials.
 • Integrated Private Browser to surf privately with no logs or history.
 • Full Apple Watch support for quick access to your 2FA codes.
 • Built-in VPN client to encrypt your online connection.
 • Smart AI Assistant to guide you with setup and security best practices.
SafePass is ideal for users managing crypto exchanges like Binance, online business platforms like Stripe, Shopify, and Concur, or personal apps like Discord, Epic Games, and secure government portals like Login.gov.
Subscription Options:
Unlock the full suite of security features with our flexible monthly or yearly plans (includes a 3-day free trial). Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Charges are applied to your Apple ID upon confirmation.
Need help? Contact us at: support@gitu.us
Privacy Policy: https://www.gitu.us/authenticator-privacy/

bluejetty:00168687:ios.name: Plume Home
bluejetty:00168687:ios.summary: The Plume Home app brings together WiFi intelligence, security and easy management of your network and household to enhance your connectivity experience. Unlike other mesh WiFi systems, Plume automatically fine-tunes your network for peak p
bluejetty:00168687:ios.description:
The Plume Home app brings together WiFi intelligence, security and easy management of your network and household to enhance your connectivity experience. Unlike other mesh WiFi systems, Plume automatically fine-tunes your network for peak performance—blocking interference, allocating bandwidth appropriately to all your connected devices, and prioritizing speed to live apps like video conferencing and streaming. All managed through a single mobile app.
- Simple setup
In a matter of minutes you will be able to add all your connected devices and ensure extenders are properly placed around the home for optimal coverage. 
- Profiles and groups
Create user profiles for each member of the household to assign devices to them or even assign devices to groups like ‘light bulbs’ or ‘living room’ to easily manage them. Use profiles and device groups to set security policies, schedule Focus time, apply internet Timeouts, and optimize bandwidth with Traffic Boosts—giving you better control over online time and network performance.
- Traffic Boost
Prioritize your network how you want to. Choose to make sure specific applications, profiles, devices, or whole app categories are first in line for bandwidth. Feel confident that your video meeting, live TV stream, or gaming session has what it needs. Want Plume to handle it? Plume Home’s default Automatic Mode will prioritize any live traffic that needs it.
- Home security
Protect your devices from cyber threats like malware and phishing. No one home? Prioritize the network for security devices and applications like smart locks and cameras, and get instant alerts for any unusual activity. Use Motion to detect any movement when the home should be empty.
- Parental controls
Set predefined access profiles for kids, teens, or adults to automatically filter restricted content. Schedule Focus time to pause connectivity for specific profiles, devices, app categories, or the entire network. Need a quick break? Instantly restrict internet access from the home dashboard with a Timeout. Want to see where your bandwidth is going? See detailed usage graphs for all profiles and devices down to individual apps.

Spider Solitaire: Web of Cards stands out as a top choice for classic solitaire enthusiasts looking for a free solitaire card game that captures the essence of classic solitaire. Get ready to embark on a journey of card-stacking delight with Spider Solitaire: Web of Cards, the ultimate destination for classic solitaire lovers seeking the best free solitaire card game experience!

bluejetty:00169919:ios.description:
Stay connected to Sacramento with the KCRA 3 News app!
Be the first to know about breaking news, weather updates, and top stories in Sacramento and the surrounding area. With the KCRA 3 News app, you’ll have real-time news, sports highlights, traffic alerts, and entertainment updates – all at your fingertips. Download for free today and experience news, like never before.
Over 300,000 Sacramento residents trust the KCRA 3 News app for breaking news, weather alerts, and local updates. Download today and join the community!
LIVE NEWS
 - Get instant push notifications for breaking news.
 - Launch full live newscasts using the Nowcast bar.
 - Catch up on the latest newscast with On Demand playback.
REAL-TIME WEATHER
 - Stay updated with current weather conditions and hourly forecasts.
 - Plan ahead with a detailed 10-day outlook and weekend forecast.
 - Zoom in to street-level detail with an interactive radar.
 - Receive critical weather warnings and expert videocasts.
COMMUNITY FOCUSED

 - Share stories easily via email, text, or social media.
 - Discover live traffic incidents, local articles, and crime reports with the interactive Happening Near You map.
 - Stay informed with in-depth coverage of local stories and events that matter to your community.
 - Keep up with the Kings, 49ers, River Cats, Sacramento Republic FC, and your local college and high school teams with the latest coverage and highlights.
STAY AHEAD WITH KCRA 3 NEWS
Whether it's breaking news, live weather updates, or the latest from the world of sports and entertainment, the KCRA 3 News app delivers the information that matters most to you.
DOWNLOAD NOW AND STAY CONNECTED TO YOUR COMMUNITY.
Although Hearst Television believes the majority of its news content is appropriate for a variety of ages, it is intended for individuals 18 and older.

Incredible adventures of best friends in Chaosville. A game in which everything depends on your choice! Use your IQ and think outside the box. Choose the correct option to help the boys defeat monsters and continue their journey.
This city was called Joyville. But one day it was covered by the dome of darkness. Now it's Chaosville - the city of horror. The darkness turned this place into an anomalous zone and transformed the residents into terrible monsters. Abandoned buildings, ugly beasts, and other creepy stuff on your way. Your mission is to return the sun to the city and destroy the dome of darkness. How? - Be creative to find magic artifacts and collect gems of kindness.
Features:
Popular Internet Monsters 
Siren Head, Bridge Worm, Evil Clown, Cartoon Cat, Plague Doctor, and many more!
Feel The Vibes of Immersive Gameplay
Creepy and hilarious? - This is definitely about our game!

Use imagination and boost your brain
Magic Artifacts
Each artifact contains a piece of dark power. Find them all to defeat evil!
Gems of Kindness
These gems are the key to decoding a spell and activating the Book of Artifacts
The Book of Artifacts
Found artifacts are held in this magic book. On its pages, you'll find information about enchanted objects and characters
Download the app and join the thrilling adventure through Chaosville. A place, where your nightmares come true
Share your impressions in the comments. We read every review and appreciate any feedback;)

bluejetty:00156573:ios.name: Grooved: Turntable Calibration
bluejetty:00156573:ios.summary:
Grooved lets you calibrate the speed of your turntable by simply playing a record.
Maybe you're the lucky owner of one of those turntables with the little strobe thingie that already lets you calibrate the speed visually. I'm not gonna lie
bluejetty:00156573:ios.description:
Grooved lets you calibrate the speed of your turntable by simply playing a record.
Maybe you're the lucky owner of one of those turntables with the little strobe thingie that already lets you calibrate the speed visually. I'm not gonna lie to you, if that's your situation then maybe Grooved isn't going to be super helpful but hey, who knows maybe you want to double check. On the other hand if, like me, you didn't think you'd ever need that feature and now realized how strangely complicated it is to get the right RPM set up without it, then this app is for you.
It truly is that simple: pick a song, play it out loud, tap the button. Grooved tells you if your turntable is running fast, slow, or perfectly. It uses your device's built-in microphone, so you don't need any additional equipment. 
If your turntable isn't running at the right speed, simply follow the manufacturer's instructions to adjust the speed, then check again with Grooved until just right. It's free, without ads nor limits, so you can keep checking and tweaking as long as you want to.
I wish I had more to say about it, but the truth is that Grooved is a very simple app that does one thing, and it does it very well. I hope you enjoy using it as much as I enjoyed making it for you.

bluejetty:00065174:ios.description:
Slut dig til vores 300.000 brugere, som allerede bruger OK-appen til at tanke, vaske, parkere og oplade bilen i hele Danmark.
Uanset om du vil betale med MobilePay, Apple Pay, Dankort, Visa/MasterCard eller dit OK Kort, har du altid betalingen lige ved hånden med OK-appen.
TANK I NÆRHEDEN
Åbn standeren og betal for din tankning i OK-appen eller med Apple CarPlay. Du får en kvittering efter hver tankning, som bliver gemt direkte i appen. Du kan altid finde den nærmeste OK-tankstation og selv vælge, hvilken klub eller forening du vil støtte, når du tanker benzin og diesel.
BILVASK
Det har aldrig været nemmere at have en ren bil. Start vasken direkte i appen, og bliv siddende i bilen, mens den bliver vasket. Uanset om du køber en enkelt vask eller har vores OK Fri Vask-abonnement, er det hurtigt og ligetil.
PARKERING
Med OK’s app kan du finde parkeringspladser i nærheden og nemt starte, forlænge og afslutte din parkering. Når du først har tilføjet din nummerplade i appen og valgt betalingsmiddel, er det lige til at komme i gang. Du kan også parkere med Apple CarPlay.
Det bedste er, at du kan klare det hele fra dit forsæde eller på caféen, hvis du lige får lyst til en ekstra muffin til caffé latten – så slipper du for at stå i kø til parkeringsautomaten. Vi giver dig også gerne en påmindelse, hvis din parkering er ved at udløbe.
Som Coop-medlem optjener du også bonus fra Coop, når du parkerer med appen. Tilknyt dit Coop-medlemsnummer til OK-appen, så kommer din bonus fra Coop automatisk ind på din medlemskonto.
Derudover kan du også tilføje noter til dine kvitteringer og gratis sende din kvittering til din e-mail.
Du kan parkere med OK-appen i København, Frederiksberg, Aarhus, Aalborg, Odense, Vejle, Skagen og mange andre byer i hele landet.
OPLADNING
Når du er på farten, kan OK's app navigere dig til en ledig OK-ladestander. I appen kan du se hastighed, priser og stiktyper samt starte, stoppe og betale en opladning.
Med en ladeboks fra OK kan du se elprisen og udskyde din opladning til det billigste tidspunkt. Du kan også følge med i dit forbrug for din elbil og plugin hybrid i appen.
Sæt bare stikket i bilen og start opladningen – så klarer vi resten.

Derudover kan du også tilføje noter til dine kvitteringer og gratis sende din kvittering til din e-mail.

Du kan parkere med OK-appen i København, Frederiksberg, Aarhus, Aalborg, Odense, Vejle, Skagen og mange andre byer i hele landet.

Når du er på farten, kan OK's app navigere dig til en ledig OK-ladestander. I appen kan du se hastighed, priser og stiktyper samt starte, stoppe og betale en opladning.

Med en ladeboks fra OK kan du se elprisen og udskyde din opladning til det billigste tidspunkt. Du kan også følge med i dit forbrug for din elbil og plugin hybrid i appen.

Sæt bare stikket i bilen og start opladningen – så klarer vi resten.

bluejetty:00062638:ios.description:
Newly updated for 2026, including new FAA questions and topics. 
This app will prepare you for the FAA drone exam by testing your knowledge with over 500 questions, including actual FAA questions and questions covering all of the new regulations relating to night operations, Remote ID, and operations over people. 
This app does not include any training content, but does provide explanations for all answers. We offer two apps to prepare for the FAA drone exam:
◗ Remote Pilot Test Prep (this app) - Practice questions to prepare for the exam 
◗ Remote Pilot Ground School - A complete training course plus practice questions
While it is possible to learn the material tested on the exam by "getting the answers wrong," and memorizing the correct answer, if you are new to drone flying, we recommend our Remote Pilot Ground School app, which includes a complete course covering every area tested on the exam.
If you are undecided on which app is the right app for your needs, you can purchase this app and later upgrade to the complete Ground School via in-app purchase for the price difference.
Your purchase of this app also provides you with free access via the web so you can prepare for the exam on any device. 
◖◖CONFIGURE CUSTOM SESSIONS◗◗
Use Study Mode to create question sessions based on topics, session size, and your overall mastery. Filters allow you to include or exclude questions based on mastery and other question characteristics. 
Use Exam Mode to take simulated FAA drone exams administered in a timed environment under the same rules as the real FAA drone exam. Unlike other test prep apps, our exams present the correct proportion of questions from each knowledge area per the ACS.
◖◖REPORTS AND STATISTICS◗◗
Gauge your progress and readiness to take the drone exam. Create and send reports of your exam history to anyone. 
◖◖OTHER FEATURES◗◗
Drone subject matter is categorized into discrete topics, enabling focused study sessions and better insight into weak areas. 
View definitions of key terms and acronyms in answer explanations
Explanations consisting of text, graphic, applicable regulation, or a combination thereof.
Multi-tasking support allows you to use FlightReady side by side with any FAA drone references.
Proficiency is tracked using a proprietary algorithm that assigns a mastery level to each question. Know when you are ready for the drone exam when most questions reach the highest mastery level.
Figures and charts are presented in the same screen so that you can view both the question and the figure. We use the actual figures in the FAA's knowledge test supplement for the remote pilot exam. 
Quickly create new sessions from missed questions, or review missed questions and explanations. 
Swipe left in the question view to reveal question list showing progress, marked questions, and more.
◖◖ SUBJECT MATTER COVERED◗◗
▸ Airspace
▸ Emergency Procedures
▸ Human Factors
▸ Loading
▸ Drone Maintenance
▸ Drone Operations
▸ Drone Performance
▸ Drone Pilot Certification
▸ Drone Regulations
▸ Night Operations
▸ Operations Over People
▸ Operations Near Airports
▸ Remote ID
▸ Weather Services
▸ Weather Theory
An FAA remote pilot license is required to operate drones commercially. FlightReady has trained tens of thousands of drone pilots, and offers the most complete drone subject matter coverage. Our test prep and training courses are the key to success on the FAA drone exam.

Meet the funniest and a little bit scary giants you've ever seen… and outplay them in style!

Scary? Funny? Definitely both. And you’re the Master!
Tap, slap, smash and bounce your way through the goofiest battles ever. This isn’t just a casual game - it’s your very own comedy-action arena.

• Simple but addictive action shooter gameplay
• A variety of quirky weapons to unlock
• Huge cartoon giants in every level
Upgrade your tools and become the ultimate master of fun
Feeling tense? Tap it out. Feeling bored? Get silly. Feeling awesome? Show off your style.
This isn’t just a game. It’s your punchy, playful escape, a hero’s quest full of energy, laughs, and colorful action.
Relax & unwind or beat them all! Download and play this 3D simulator game. Kill your spare time and have fun!

bluejetty:00077550:ios.description:
Unlock a world of laughter with Prank App, the ultimate hub for hilarious pranks and meme-worthy moments! Whether you're looking to spice up social gatherings, lighten the mood, or prank your friends for a good chuckle, this app has you covered.
Key Features:
1.Prank and Meme Soundboard:
Dive into a collection of prank sounds and meme-worthy audio clips. From funny prank sounds to famous internet memes. Bring happiness to your friends and family at any time.
2.Simulator:
Experience the thrill of realistic prank simulator! Choose from a variety of simulated sounds, including guns, hair clippers, electric shocks, police car and whips. Fool your friends into believing the unexpected!
3.Fake Calls:
Master the art of surprise with our prank call feature. Select a prank call scenario, set the perfect timing, and watch as your friends react to amusing and unexpected situations.
4.Funny Stickers:
Express your humor with a collection of funny stickers. Whether you're chatting with friends or adding a playful touch to your photos, these stickers are guaranteed to bring smiles.
Highlights:
● Endless Laughter: Keep the good times rolling with an extensive library of funny sounds and pranks.
●Realistic Prank Calls: Make your friends believe in the unexpected with cleverly crafted prank call scenarios.
●Social Fun: Elevate your social gatherings with spontaneous moments and shared laughs.
● Express Yourself: Use hilarious stickers to add a touch of humor to your messages and photos.
Subscription：
In this app, we offer the following subscription option. You can choose to subscribe for unlimited access to all features, including hundreds of prank sound effects, fake call and stickers.
Premium Membership offers subscription service at $2.99 per week with a 3-day free trial or $14.99 per year.
End of trial and subscription renewal
This price is for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence. Payment will be charged to Apple Store Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscription may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Apple Store Account Settings after purchase.
Subscription is not a must in our app
Users can choose whether to subscribe to our app or not. Except for elements offered in the Subscription option, users who do not make a subscription will still have access to the basic elements in our app.
Subscription Cancellation
If you would like to cancel your subscription, go to ‘Settings’ on your iOS device --> ‘iTunes & App Store’ --> tap ‘Apple ID’ and then ‘View Apple ID’. Enter ‘Account Settings’, tap ‘Subscriptions’ --> ‘Manage’, and select the subscription for ‘Archero’ to cancel it.
Privacy Statement

Our patented audio fingerprinting technology uses machine learning to stop your phone from ringing with annoying, unwanted calls. You can live life spam-call-free® and never miss a legitimate phone call again.
But wait – there's more: Robokiller doesn't just block robocallers and spammers, we annoy the hell out of them, too. With Robokiller, you can finally get that oh-so-sweet revenge on robocallers.
OTHER SPAM-ELIMINATING ROBOKILLER FEATURES:
PREDICTIVE CALL-BLOCKING POWER
With Advanced Call Blocking, Robokiller analyzes all unrecognized calls using AI-powered audio fingerprinting technology.
24/7 UP-TO-DATE PROTECTION
New spammers are continuously added to our global spam radar every MINUTE so your phone never rings from unwanted calls.
KEEP YOUR PERSONAL INFO PRIVATE
Robokiller’s new personal data protection feature scans the web to help you find and remove your private info from public search sites where it's sold and used for spam calls, identity theft and more. Take your info off the market and use our ongoing monitoring to notify you of any new exposures. 
GET REVENGE ON ROBOCALLERS
Fight bots with bots. Answer Bots deliver payback in hilarious fashion, sending spammers to clever recordings that you can listen to later, driving them crazy and giving you the last laugh.

With over 11 Million downloads in the United States, Robokiller is a trusted source of powerful spam call and text protection. But, don’t take our word for it. Robokiller has been featured on The New York Times, NBC Nightly News, Good Morning America, Fox News, and many other publications. Robokiller has also been featured by Apple as a 2019 App of The Day, and won the 2020 Webby Award for Technical Achievement.
HERE’S WHAT LIFE IS LIKE WITH ROBOKILLER:
• A life without robocalls. Up to 99% of unwanted calls are eliminated within 7 days of signing up
• Get the last laugh on robocallers and scammers with Robokiller’s Answer Bots. You may even WANT to get spam calls
• Help out the community by reporting spammers and providing feedback directly from within the app
• Track emerging scam trends and Robokiller’s efforts to stop them in your area with Robokiller’s NEW Radar feature
• Save an average of $1400/year by preventing phone scams from ever reaching you. Source: FTC

bluejetty:00047703:ios.name: Freecell 2026
bluejetty:00047703:ios.summary:
FreeCell is one of the best-known solitaire card games. All the cards are dealt face up from the start, so you can plan every move.
Features:
- Two difficulty levels
- Standard cards, simplified standard cards with larger symbols, and Span
bluejetty:00047703:ios.description:
FreeCell is one of the best-known solitaire card games. All the cards are dealt face up from the start, so you can plan every move.
Features:
- Two difficulty levels
- Standard cards, simplified standard cards with larger symbols, and Spanish cards (48-card Baraja Española)
- Three table backgrounds
- Three animation speeds
- Hints and undo
- Drag a card, or tap it to move it automatically
- Assisted moves: select a card and then its destination, or choose from a list of possible moves
- Timer and gem score, both optional
- Game Center leaderboards and achievements
- Portrait and landscape orientation
- Full support for VoiceOver and Switch Control
- The current game is saved automatically
- Stickers for iMessage
How to play:
The goal is to move all the cards to the four foundations, one for each suit, from Ace to King.
The cards are dealt into 8 columns (7 with Spanish cards). In the columns you can place a card on another one that is one rank higher and of the opposite color, for example a red 5 on a black 6. With Spanish cards, cups and coins count as red, swords and clubs as black.
Each of the four free cells can hold one card. Any card can go to an empty column. You can move several cards together if there are enough free cells and empty columns.
The gem score starts at 500. It goes down with time, moves and undos, and goes up by 10 for every card placed on a foundation.

bluejetty:00118966:ios.description:
DriverDash brings the same convenience and control of your fleet card with the power of mobile payment at the pump or charging station!
Why should I use DriverDash?
• It provides a faster and easier payment experience
• You can enter odometer readings from the comfort of your vehicle
• Receipts are captured electronically
• Mobile payment offers greater protection against fraud
• Use thumbprint or facial recognition to activate the pump or charging station and never have to remember your Driver ID
How do I start using DriverDash?
Before you can download and use DriverDash, you must first receive an invitation from the manager of your fleet card account. Once invited, you will receive an email with a link to create a username and password, which you will then use to log in to the DriverDash app. 
Please note: If any other method is used to install DriverDash, the app WILL NOT work at the pump or charging station. If you need to receive an invitation, please contact the manager of your fleet card account. 
How do I use DriverDash to pay at the pump or charging station?
1. Before fueling, launch the DriverDash app on your phone
2. Tap Activate Station and select your pump or charging station
3. When your account prompt appears, you can activate the pump or charging station by entering your Driver ID, scanning your fingerprint, or using your facial recognition 
For more information about DriverDash, visit fleetdriverdash.com

Youstar has the safest and smoothest voice group chat r
bluejetty:00081947:ios.description:
Youstar is a free multiplayer voice chat and entertainment community, chat with people nearby or around the world, and play a variety of interesting social games.
Free voice chat room
Youstar has the safest and smoothest voice group chat room. No matter where you are, you can chat safely with Arab friends all over the world for free. Supports enjoying real-time voice chat using 3G, 4G, LTE or WI-FI networks.
Free online party
You can hold free parties for birthdays, National Day, and Eid al-Fitr, or watch football matches in the room with like-minded friends for real-time commentary, or discuss the zodiac explanation to answer the zodiac password for you.
Cool virtual gifts
In the chat room you can exchange cool gifts with your friends. There are stunning animated special effects to suit your needs.
Wonderful game
Although life is busy with trivial matters, Youstar will bring you a one-stop entertainment experience. In this app, you can play various exciting and fun mini-games such as Ludo, UMO, Crush, Lucky wheel, Fruit Party... and unlock endless gaming fun. From casual elimination to strategic competition, whether you are a newbie or an expert, you can find a game world that belongs to you.
Watch rich video content
In addition to games, YouStar can also enables you to watch various music MVs and video content from Youtube. Welcome to enjoy music from all over the world anytime and anywhere. Whether it is a popular hit or a retro classic, there is always a song that will suit your mood. The rich video content covers various fields such as comedy, food, tourism, technology, culture, etc., allowing you to travel around the world and experience different wonderful lives in just a few minutes.
Community accessibility
Youstar is not only entertainment, but also a warm social circle. Here, you can meet like-minded friends and share the joy of entertainment and life with each other. Adding friends, instant chat, and interactive comments all reflect the warmth of friendship and the power of care. You can also show your talents here, share your mood text, and share the beauty of life with everyone.
Personalized recommendation
We have carefully designed a personalized push function to recommend more entertainment content and social activities that suit your tastes based on your interests and usage habits. Whether you are a warrior who likes to challenge yourself, or an artistic youth who enjoys tranquility, YouStar can find the most suitable content for you, allowing you to find a sense of belonging and resonance here.
Live video
At the same time, our live broadcast function will also give you an immersive viewing experience. Watch the wonderful live broadcast, interact with everyone, become a member of the fan circle, and feel the real and beautiful emotional resonance.
Join Youstar now! Here, you will no longer be alone, because there is always a group of people in the world waiting to meet you and explore unlimited joy and passion together. Let us create our own new era of entertainment and social interaction together!

bluejetty:00160397:ios.description:
THE ULTIMATE FLAPPY EXPERIENCE
Play in this crazy flappy universe where you control dragons with special abilities and travel around exotic worlds with unique gimmicks. Devour royals, find treasure chests, collect crowns, hatch dragon eggs, use powerups and... above all, avoid the towers in this magical flappy adventure!
EXPLORE BEAUTIFUL WORLDS
Travel and collect crowns from the Ronoka Mountains to the misterious Arehma Desert, or even the depths of the Scales Road Sea and so many more! Each world has its unique gimmicks, characters and secrets to unfold.
HATCH THEM ALL!
Collect different dragons with unique skills, fly stats and control schemes. Find eggs and hatch them to unlock and level up your dragons, there is more than 65 species to discover! Will you collect them all and unleash their powerful abilities?
USE AMAZING POWERUPS
Have fun finding extraordinary powerups to go faster, spit fire, destroy towers, or even slow the flow of time!
UNLEASH POWERFUL ABILITIES
Each dragon has a unique special skill (active or passive) that you can use and that will define and enhance your gameplay strategy. Level up your dragons to make their skills even better!
UNIQUE CONTROLS
TAP, HOLD, or FOLLOW and its reverse variants! Each dragon has its own control scheme, will you be able to "control" them all?
BECOME A FLAPPY MASTER
Rank up your dragon's mastery and earn rewards to showcase your skill level.

Whether you sell at a market, boutique, pop-up shop, event, or on the go, PayPOS makes it easy to accept payments quickly and securely.
ACCEPT PAYMENTS WORLDWIDE
Accept payments from customers in 195+ countries and 135+ currencies.
Choose the payment method that works best for your business, whether you're accepting payments in person or remotely.
TAP TO PAY ON IPHONE
Turn your iPhone into a contactless payment terminal—no card reader required.
Tap to Pay on iPhone is supported in:
United States, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Canada, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Malaysia, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Singapore, Sweden, Switzerland, United Kingdom, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Estonia, Gibraltar, Hungary, Japan, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Mexico, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain.
If your country isn’t listed above, don’t worry. You can still accept payments by scanning or manually entering your customer’s card details, or by sending a secure payment link.
SCAN OR ENTER CARD DETAILS
Accept payments by scanning supported card information or entering card details manually.
Process payments quickly and securely without a traditional card terminal.
SEND PAYMENT LINKS
Create a secure payment link and send it by text, email, or messaging app.
Customers can pay remotely—even when they're not with you.
MANAGE YOUR BUSINESS FROM ONE APP
Track transactions, payouts, payment links, and payment activity directly in PayPOS.
Stay on top of your payments and manage your business wherever you are.
SECURE PAYMENT PROCESSING
PayPOS uses encryption, PCI-compliant payment processing, and built-in fraud protection technology to help keep your payments secure.
PayPOS partners with Stripe for payment processing, providing a secure and reliable way to process credit and debit card payments.
Learn more about our partnership:
https://stripe.partners/directory/paypos
QUICK AND EASY SETUP
Create your account in minutes and start accepting payments without complicated hardware.
TIPS, TAXES, FEES & PRODUCT CATALOG
Make checkout more flexible with built-in options for:
Tips
Taxes
Service fees
Product catalog
Create and manage your products directly in PayPOS for faster, easier checkout.
FAST PAYMENTS & FLEXIBLE PAYOUTS
Access your funds quickly with flexible payout schedules.
Choose daily, weekly, monthly, or manual payouts to fit the way you run your business.
SIMPLE, TRANSPARENT PRICING
PayPOS charges a 1.1% transaction fee, plus standard payment processing fees.
View the fee breakdown for every transaction directly in the app.
No monthly fees. No setup fees. No hidden costs.
24/7 SUPPORT
Get in-app support anytime, anywhere.
Our team is here to help whenever you need us.
PRIVACY & DATA PROTECTION
Your privacy matters to us.

bluejetty:00180289:ios.description:
Have you struggled with diet plans in the past? Are you looking for a diet plan solution that works? 
This app contains bunch of healthy balanced and nutritious calorie controlled diet plans that helps to keep your motivation alive, stay committed and lose weight fast!
If you are looking to lose weight, maintain your weight, or simply embrace a healthy way of eating and living, this is the application you need.
This app takes care of all the calculations for you, so you will be able to see how many calories you should consume to achieve the weight loss you want and how you can make changes to your current diet to achieve that weight loss.
DIET
This app allows you to explore hundreds of diet plans and tells you how much you lose on each diet. 
From healthy diets to detox, to low carb diets to low cholesterol diets, this app cover almost every category of diet plan that exists.
We allow you to explore a diet plan first, and then decide if it is right for you. We do this by providing a diet plan overview, complete meal plan on day basis, and a complete shopping list for each and every diet plan.
WEIGHT TRACKER
Weight Tracker allows you to check-in weight so you can see your improvement like how much weight you have already lost and what’s remaining in fancy way. Self-motivate and share it with your friends. 
It also calculates body mass index (BMI) for you based on your physical profile.
Moreover, it tells you the state of your physical profile, like if you’re underweight, normal, overweight or obese based on BMI.
HEALTH REMINDERS :
Healthy reminders helps you find your inner motivation, it helps you stay on track, make healthy lifestyle changes, avoid exercise laziness and other weight loss difficulties.
You can add preset & activity reminders or build custom reminders.
It helps you make small, healthy lifestyle changes - Now you'll never forget to drink water again! 
General Features:
- Healthy choices of diet plan in 18 different categories.
- Takes the guesswork out of dieting.
- Dedicated checkable shopping list per each diet plan
- Weight tracker, weight logbook and BMI calculator
- Quick & Easy Weight Adding: Record your weight once a day, quick & easy
- Weight History: Look up your weight for any given date.
- Daily Reminders
- Chart that shows your overall weight loss progress over time
- Meal Remainders for each meal so you never skip any meal.
- Pre calculated weight loss estimation based on physical profile for each diet plan.
- Compatible with iPhone, iPod and iPad.
Upgrade to Premium and enjoy all premium diets with shopping list and meal reminders.

Terms of Use : https://pixsterstudio.com/terms-of-use.html

• LEADERBOARD - compete with others and socialize

Enjoy!

bluejetty:00186512:ios.description:
Introducing the ultimate Korean language learning app for travelers!
Whether you're planning a trip to Korea or just want to learn the basics of the language, Learn Korean - Phrasebook has everything you need to get started. It also works without an internet connection! See the most popular Korean phrases for any scenario. Listen to audio recordings and learn pronunciation from native speakers. Save your favorite phrases to easily access them whenever you need. Learning the Korean vocabulary can be overwhelming for beginners, use our app to simplify the process!
FEATURES:
-------------
• A comprehensive library of essential Korean phrases for travel and other common scenarios
• Audio recordings by native speakers for accurate pronunciation
• No internet needed!
• Browse categories to see popular words and phrases
• Search any phrase you need to quickly find the translation
• Save your favorite phrases to access them anytime
• Playback audio at slower speeds to better hear tricky pronunciations
• Highlighted important words with tips allow you to memorize your lessons easily
• Access 200+ words & phrases for free - upgrade to premium to unlock 1,000+
USE WITHOUT INTERNET
Find all of the words and phrases without an internet connection. If you’re traveling to Korea and will be without internet access, Learn Korean - Phrasebook will make sure you can always communicate with those around you.
HEAR NATIVE SPEAKING PRONUNCIATIONS
For every word and phrase in the phrasebook you can see how it’s spelled in English and in Hangul, and hear authentic pronunciations recorded by real native speakers.
BROWSE BY CATEGORY
The app's library of popular Korean phrases is organized by different scenario categories with a heavy focus on travel situations. Whether you're ordering food at a restaurant, asking for directions, or shopping, it has you covered.
FREE CATEGORIES:
• Greetings
• General Conversation
PREMIUM CATEGORIES:
• Numbers
• Time and Date
• Directions & Places
• Transportation
• Accommodation
• Eating Out
• Shopping
• Colours & Prints
• Cities & Provinces
• Countries
• Tourist Attractions
• Family
• Dating
• Emergency
• Feeling Sick
• Tongue Twisters
• Body Parts
• Occasion Phrases
• Sports
• Action Words
Traveling to Korea? Looking to brush up on your Korean to better communicate with native speakers? Learn Korean - Phrasebook is the perfect app for you, try it out for free!
Privacy Policy: https://www.webronsoftware.co.uk/mobile-apps/learn-language/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.webronsoftware.co.uk/mobile-apps/learn-language/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00041169:ios.description:
The Enhance Pro app lets you control your hearing aids directly from your mobile device. You can change programs, and make simple or more advanced sound adjustments and save them as favorites. The app helps you learn what you can do and how to do it. It can even help you find your hearing aids if you lose them. Last, but not least, you can have your hearing care professional update your hearing aid programs and send you new hearing aid software without taking a trip to the clinic.
Enhance Pro device compatibility:
Please consult the Enhance Pro app website for up-to-date compatibility information: www.jabra.com/supportpages/jabra-enhance-pro-compatibility 
Use the Enhance Pro app to: 
• Enjoy optimization anywhere with online services: Request help with your hearing aid settings from your hearing care professional and receive new settings and software updates. 
• Adjust volume settings on your hearing aids
• Mute your hearing aids
• Adjust volume of your streaming accessories
• Adjust speech focus as well as noise and wind-noise levels with Sound Enhancer (feature availability depends on your hearing aid model and the fitting by your hearing care professional)
• Change manual and streamer programs
• Edit and personalize program names 
• Adjust treble, middle and bass tones to your preferences
• Save your preferred settings as a Favorite – you can even tag to a location
• Monitor the battery status of your rechargeable hearing aids
• Help locate lost or misplaced hearing aids
• Tinnitus manager: Adjust sound variation and frequency of the Tinnitus Sound Generator. Select Nature Sounds (feature availability depends on your hearing aid model and the fitting by your hearing care professional)
For more information please visit the support website via the link in the app store.

bluejetty:00087615:ios.description:
See videos at: https://www.timperlabs.com/keyscore
KeyScore is a full-featured digital sheet music app and is an amazing tool for any musician from novice students to professionals. The app provides a wealth of features to let you scan, import, annotate, organize and play all your music from your iPad. With KeyScore's intelligent features you get amazing functionality including a music-aware camera-based scanner and automatic page turning for piano music. KeyScore comes with some music scores built in so you can instantly try it out! And then, easily add your own music using the camera scanner or importing PDFs or images you already have!
*** Camera Scanner ***
KeyScore has a camera scanner that is optimized for sheet music. It can straighten curved pages, de-skew and image and correct shadows. With KeyScore, you can quickly scan and import all your sheet music!
*** Automatic Page Turning ***
Automatic page turning and tracking is an amazing feature, and works well for piano music. KeyScore can read the music, listen to you play and turn the page for you. This cutting edge technology is continually evolving and improving to work with more instruments. 
*** Markup ***
KeyScore lets you quickly make markings on your score. Use this to add fingering or make notes to your self. There is a wealth of markup tools to use!
*** Music Tools ***
KeyScore has built in tools, including: Virtual keyboard, metronome, tuner, tone generator, and audio recorder.

Using WeFish you can:

￭ Get the best FISHING FORECASTS thanks to FishGuru: the definitive tool to know where and when to fish. We base all our predictions on real data. ▶ With more than 500,000 catches registered in WeFish ◀we have been able to analyze them and extract behavior patterns of each species. Fishing is not a bunch of mathematical algorithms that come out of nowhere, fishing is knowing each species and their habitat.

- Wind
- Solunar phase
- Tides
- Waves
- Temperatures
- Atmospheric pressure
In addition you can create alarms and markers to not miss out on the best fishing days. You can predict the best fishing times with our calendar, tide times and meteorological information.

Catches must be shown in a natural environment, with no mistreatment and respecting sizes. The perfect pic? One that shows only one catch with landscape in the background, where we can enjoy the beauty of this sport. And of course, we also promote CATCH AND RELEASE of species, specially the freshwater ones.

bluejetty:00079360:ios.description:
TITLE is your space for thoughtful, taste-driven style - a place where guidance meets clarity and getting dressed feels calm, confident, and intentional.
With the support of real stylists, TITLE helps you gain a quiet sense of confidence - knowing what suits you, why it works, and how to build outfits that feel right for your life.
TITLE isn’t about chasing trends. It’s about ease, trust in your choices, and the feeling of being put together without overthinking.
3 reasons to install TITLE:
1. 28-day personalised style plan
Feel guided, not overwhelmed. Daily micro-lessons, curated outfits, and clear guidance to help you understand what suits you - and why. By the end, you’ll feel confident in your choices and have a capsule wardrobe that supports your real life.
2. Ready-to-wear outfits
Feel inspired by complete looks made for you. Fully styled outfits based on your taste, color palette, and body type help you see new combinations and get dressed with confidence.
3. 1-on-1 styling sessions
Feel supported and understood. Work with stylists who consider your body, lifestyle, and preferences, offering practical guidance you can apply immediately — with no pressure, no guessing, just clarity.
How can TITLE support your style?
- Follow a 28-day personalised style plan that brings more clarity and cohesion to your wardrobe.
- Work 1-on-1 with stylists who tailor every recommendation to your body, lifestyle, and preferences.
- Explore and purchase ready-to-wear outfits curated for your color palette, proportions, and personal taste.
- Learn simple techniques that make mixing, matching, and accessorizing feel effortless.
- Build a wardrobe that reflects your identity and supports you in every part of your life — from busy workdays to meaningful occasions.
TITLE has supported 500,000+ women in discovering a way to dress that finally feels like them — download the app and discover your own sense of style.
--

Coin Identifier: Coin Scanner
Identify Coins, Discover Their Value, and Build Your Collection Instantly!
Have a coin you can’t recognize? Want to know its history, origin, or market value? Coin Identifier: Coin Scanner is your smart companion for identifying coins and managing your collection - all with just a photo.
Powered by advanced AI and an extensive global database, the app helps you explore the fascinating world of coins quickly and accurately.
Key Features:
Identify Foreign Coins
Take a photo of any coin, and the app will instantly recognize coins from over 100+ countries, both modern and historical.
Smart Coin Scanner
Use your phone's camera or upload an image from your gallery. The app analyzes and identifies coins within seconds using advanced image recognition.
Get Coin Value
Find out the estimated market value of your coin based on its type, rarity, and condition. A helpful feature for collectors, buyers, and sellers alike.
Create and Manage Your Coin Collection
Organize your personal collection digitally. Add photos, notes, and categorize coins by country, year, or type—accessible anytime, anywhere.
Discover Coin Information
Get detailed data for each coin: country of origin, year of minting, denomination, material, and more.
Search Global Coin Catalog
Browse a massive catalog of coins from different eras and regions. Search by keyword, year, country, or characteristics.
Learn Fun Coin Facts
Explore interesting historical and cultural facts behind the design and use of different coins.
Whether you're a beginner looking to learn or a serious collector maintaining a valuable archive, Coin Identifier: Coin Scanner is the must-have tool for anyone passionate about coins.
Download now and start your coin journey today!

bluejetty:00121191:ios.name: Dog World Premium - My Puppy
bluejetty:00121191:ios.summary: The absolute cuddle alarm for your iPad or iPhone: Tivola brings the next installment of its 3D animal game series with DogWorld 3D’s cute Dalmatian, Labrador, Shepherd, Rottweiler and Beagle puppies. You’ll have little, faithful companions
bluejetty:00121191:ios.description:
The absolute cuddle alarm for your iPad or iPhone: Tivola brings the next installment of its 3D animal game series with DogWorld 3D’s cute Dalmatian, Labrador, Shepherd, Rottweiler and Beagle puppies. You’ll have little, faithful companions by your side to share all kinds of crazy adventures with.
UNENDING GAME FUN 
The little puppies are always with you and are always delighted when you take care of them, give them treats, or just simply cuddle them. Each puppy reacts to your touch, and you will be amazed by the incredibly adorable animations in amazing 3D graphics. With your finger, you can nudge your new friend slowly out of his dreams so that he happily jumps on the screen or begs on command with a wagging tail. While doing this he is always ready to cuddle or play and he's always in an intoxicatingly good mood. It only takes one look in his faithful little button eyes for you to fall under his spell and to give him attention, which he adores.
CLUMSY DANCING
You thought that you can't really rock out with dogs? You thought wrong: Pump up the stereo system together with your little Dalmatian, Labrador, and Beagle, and you can marvel at their clumsy dance moves. Depending on the mood, you can choose from different songs and decide which funny moves the puppies perform to the rhythm. A good mood is guaranteed!
FUNNY CLOTHING
The little puppies love it when you search for funny accessories in the wardrobe room so that you can dress them up. Hats, shoes, bows and other things are ready so that you can get started with costuming right away. Your fantasies have no limits; decorate your darling according to your imagination. If you are happy with the result, then you can create a photographic memory of the experience. Let your dog pose for the camera and create unforgettable snapshots.
COLLECT STARS TO ENSURE THAT YOU RECEIVE SURPRISES
You collect stars with every mission. Once you've reached a certain amount, a cool surprise waits for you each time. Cool dog accessories such as treats and toys are hidden in the gift packets for unending game fun with your new friend.
Play DogWorld 3D now and care for your own cute puppy dogs!
Tivola’s premium games offer players endless gaming fun with their favorite animals, without any in-app purchases, annoying ads, or external links. This is why premium games are perfectly suited for even our littlest animal fans. For a set price, you can get all the content and all the objects in the game from the start – just waiting to be played with! What are you waiting for? Let’s start playing!
REVIEWS
"If your kids are begging for a puppy after watching 101 Dalmatians, you might want to get them this app for fun. [...] Cute and funny! [...] The dog itself and his environment are very realistically presented through 3D animations." (smartappsforkids.com)

The absolute cuddle alarm for your iPad or iPhone: Tivola brings the next installment of its 3D animal game series with DogWorld 3D’s cute Dalmatian, Labrador, Shepherd, Rottweiler and Beagle puppies. You’ll have little, faithful companions by your side to share all kinds of crazy adventures with.


UNENDING GAME FUN 

The little puppies are always with you and are always delighted when you take care of them, give them treats, or just simply cuddle them. Each puppy reacts to your touch, and you will be amazed by the incredibly adorable animations in amazing 3D graphics. With your finger, you can nudge your new friend slowly out of his dreams so that he happily jumps on the screen or begs on command with a wagging tail. While doing this he is always ready to cuddle or play and he's always in an intoxicatingly good mood. It only takes one look in his faithful little button eyes for you to fall under his spell and to give him attention, which he adores.


CLUMSY DANCING

You thought that you can't really rock out with dogs? You thought wrong: Pump up the stereo system together with your little Dalmatian, Labrador, and Beagle, and you can marvel at their clumsy dance moves. Depending on the mood, you can choose from different songs and decide which funny moves the puppies perform to the rhythm. A good mood is guaranteed!


FUNNY CLOTHING

The little puppies love it when you search for funny accessories in the wardrobe room so that you can dress them up. Hats, shoes, bows and other things are ready so that you can get started with costuming right away. Your fantasies have no limits; decorate your darling according to your imagination. If you are happy with the result, then you can create a photographic memory of the experience. Let your dog pose for the camera and create unforgettable snapshots.


COLLECT STARS TO ENSURE THAT YOU RECEIVE SURPRISES

You collect stars with every mission. Once you've reached a certain amount, a cool surprise waits for you each time. Cool dog accessories such as treats and toys are hidden in the gift packets for unending game fun with your new friend.

Play DogWorld 3D now and care for your own cute puppy dogs!

Tivola’s premium games offer players endless gaming fun with their favorite animals, without any in-app purchases, annoying ads, or external links. This is why premium games are perfectly suited for even our littlest animal fans. For a set price, you can get all the content and all the objects in the game from the start – just waiting to be played with! What are you waiting for? Let’s start playing!

REVIEWS

"If your kids are begging for a puppy after watching 101 Dalmatians, you might want to get them this app for fun. [...] Cute and funny! [...] The dog itself and his environment are very realistically presented through 3D animations." (smartappsforkids.com)

bluejetty:00187271:ios.summary:
The perfect app for solar sales-teams and installers who wish to do remote-roof surveys before visiting site to confirm roof dimensions and angles.
Use Apple or Google maps and satellite imagery to easily locate and measure a potential roo
bluejetty:00187271:ios.description:
The perfect app for solar sales-teams and installers who wish to do remote-roof surveys before visiting site to confirm roof dimensions and angles.
Use Apple or Google maps and satellite imagery to easily locate and measure a potential roof for suitability of a solar-PV or thermal installation.
Use zip/postcode or address to locate the desired roof. 
Quickly identify the roof to be measured. 
Easily indicate the surrounding rectangle of the roof. 
Enter the roof's pitch.
Instantly get the roof width, ridge-to-gutter distance, azimuth and surface area.
Using latest satellite technology, it is easy to 'box' a roof with simple drag-and-drop techniques. By maximising the available imagery available, it is possible to measure a roof with surprising accuracy.
If you have any problem or question with RoofSnoop, please contact us via the website below. We will always answer your question and help you use RoofSnoop to its maximum capacity.
________________________________________________________________________________ 
*RoofSnoop is fully featured and free to download and use but is restricted in the following ways:
- Maximum measurement size is restricted to 4m x 4m. 
The 'RoofSnoop Professional Subscription' unlocks these restrictions and is available through an auto-renewing subscription.
The subscription options are as follows: (Local markets will vary)
- 1 Month subscription: £3.99 (Comes with first 7 days subscription free!)
- 1 Year subscription: £39.99
Please note the following:
Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your AppStore account. 
Your subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. 
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current subscription. Subscription costs are as above.
You will not be able to cancel a subscription during the active period. You can manage your subscriptions in your Account Settings after purchase. 
Any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered), will be forfeited when you purchase any 'RoofSnoop Professional Subscription'.
________________________________________________________________________________
RoofSnoop website: https://isolarapps.com
Privacy policy: https://isolarapps.com/privacy.html
Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
User support: https://isolarapps.com/support.html

bluejetty:00069233:ios.description:
Welcome to Club Bitcoin: Solitaire. Play Classic Solitaire with a beautiful new look and win free bitcoin. You will love this new bitcoin game! Cashing out is simple and quick - anyone can do it.
Club Bitcoin: Solitaire is the best free-to-play, play-to-earn classic solitaire game, with free bitcoin rewards. The task is simple: solve each hand by transferring cards from their starting position to the card foundation piles.
The rewards are sweet: free bitcoin!
- HOW TO PLAY -
Draw cards (either in 1 or 3 card draw modes) from the deck, and play them into position to build up each foundation, in sequence and in suit, from the ace through the king. Build the whole card pack onto the foundations, and if done successfully, the Solitaire game is won and the free bitcoin is rightfully yours!
Want to reminisce to the good old days of playing the classic Windows 95 Solitaire card game for hours? Then download Club Bitcoin: Solitaire now. It’s the best Bitcoin game on the planet! Enjoy the Classic Solitaire like the olden days, but this time collect as much free bitcoin as possible with THNDR Games!
- TICKETS -
As you progress throughout the hand, you will receive tickets for moving cards to the foundation. These tickets will be automatically entered into a raffle to win free bitcoin! Try to collect as many tickets as possible for more chances to win free bitcoin. 
- POINTS -
You will also collect points for each round. The more cards you move to the foundation, the higher your score. Hint: if you postpone moving all cards to the foundation for as long as possible, you will get a higher score!
After a few rounds, you’ll find a good Solitaire strategy and start winning free bitcoin in this brain teaser classic Solitaire game!
- THNDR GAMES -
Follow THNDR’s on social media for events, sudden jackpots, and esports tournaments and more chances to win free bitcoin. THNDR is the world’s leader in bitcoin games! Come check out all our titles.

bluejetty:00164247:ios.description:
OKMath数学思维旨在以独特的游戏化教学方法，降低孩子对数学思维的认知门槛，提升孩子的理解能力。引导孩子独立思考，探索过程、理解本源，实现会思考，会迁移，终学会独立解决问题，建立终身受益的自信心。
 OKMath数学思维将生活中所需的基本数据概念和常见的逻辑思维游戏，以更科学和智能的方式展现给孩子，帮助孩子在轻松快乐的练习活动中，探索知识、培养自信，成为独立自主的学习者！
 OKMath数学思维提供不同难度的水平等级，满足不同年龄和能力的孩子进行符合自身水平的练习。
【产品特色】
全面：内容包括从“简单认识数字”到“快速乘除法入门”、“图形认知”到“空间几何”等常用数学概念
有趣：丰富多彩的游戏玩法，花样百出的挑战模式，传统枯燥的思维练习也可以很快乐
【产品内容】
OKMath数学思维涵盖了生活所需的基础数学内容
基数和计数：包括数字临摹、数数和计数等
数字运算：包括加减法、乘除法入门，以及生活应用等
逻辑推理：包括图案识别，规律排序，记忆与矩阵等
几何图形：包括认识图形、图形描摹，空间方位等
时间和货币：包括认识时间、认识货币
国际象棋、简笔画、科学实验、少儿编程、纪录片等
【关于我们】
橙旭园团队由一群多年从事儿童教育研究的老师及互联网技术人员组成，我们运用儿童关键期，儿童心理学，儿童认知等理论，对标国内外思维培养经验，匠心研发了一套符合孩子认知的培养体系及方法。专注培养孩子的思维能力与学习习惯。
关注我们，第一时间获得最新发布的福利活动和更新通知！
Always Be Creative

bluejetty:00185156:ios.description:
Mills board game by LITE Games: Play the popular game of Mills on iPhone and iPad with online multiplayer now for free.
Mills is a hugely popular game throughout the world, characterized by the fact it is so easy to learn – and it’s even older than chess. Nowadays the game that's also well known as Nine Men's Morris, The Mill Game, or Cowboy Checkers is a national pastime in many countries. Variations of the game include Morabaraba (South Africa), Char Bar (India), or Tapatan (Philippines). The aim of the game is to hit as many enemy stones as possible by forming so-called Mills (3 stones in a row). However, you can also block your opponent by cleverly moving your own stones around, rendering them unable to make a move.
If you think that you're a master of strategy: try to win against the strongest players of the LITE Games community!
Features:
- Completely free and in English 
- Unlock amazing achievements 
- Climb to the top of the online highscore leaderboard 
- Singleplayer and multiplayer 
- Can be played online and offline 
- Customizable rules to suit your individual needs 
Mills is a real classic travel game – it is perfect for fans of Backgammon, Draughts or Othello and offers a strategic challenge for beginners as well as experienced veterans.
Join in and get yourself a top spot in the Mills player community. The 10 best players will be proudly displayed each week on https://www.lite.games/games/mills/.
The Top 3 of the month will also appear on the Mills Facebook Page here: https://www.facebook.com/LGMillsCommunity/.
The mobile Mills board game is offered in high quality localization in the following languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch, Swedish, Turkish, Russian, Polish, Mandarin Chinese and Japanese.
"Mills - The Board Game" is an advertiser funded app, i.e. ads are presented within the app. If you prefer to use the app without ads we do offer a "no ads" setting as auto-renewable subscription. You have the choice between the following options:
- 1 month for $0.99 or equivalent (subscription renews after 1 month)
- 3 months for $1.99 or equivalent (subscription renews after 3 months)

bluejetty:00016815:ios.description:
From the creators of My Town comes a new dollhouse adventure called My Little Princess! 
Imagine a castle where your child can interact with just about everything. Making dinner and dressing up, decorating the terrance and throwing a party in the ballroom just for fun. It's like a digital dollhouse where you child can play, create and imagine a different adventure each time he plays.
Little Princess Castle comes with 12 rooms, lots of characters and a ton of clothing, accessories and props. All rooms are highly interactive and offer a variety of hotspots and activities that are both fun and creative.
Why Do Parents Like Our Games.
Little princess dollhouse game has everything kids love. First we don't have any rules in the game, what kid likes rules? The game is pure imaginative fun, your kids will have a blast playing with this amazing digital dollhouse set. Dressup the little princess and her family with lots of different clothing and costumes,Enjoy artistic and creative play elements. Guaranteed hours and hours of pure fun.
Game Features:
- Play alone or play together with friends and family on the same ipad, multitouch is supported!
- Meet the little princess family and friends. From king dad and queen mom to the guards, the cook and even the witch.
- Huge castle with lots of rooms to explore and secrets to discover. Try tapping both unicorns at the castle's entrance. 
- Visit the kitchen and check out all the amazing foods you can make.
- Whats the use in having a ballroom if you can't throw a costume party for the royal family. Dressup, makeup and get ready for some fun!
- Check out the stained windows in the ballroom and royal bathroom. 
- Try digging for precious crystals, did you know you can turn it into magic potions?!
- 3rd Party Ads Free, No IAP, Free Updates and upgrades coming soon!
Recommended Age Group
This game is suitable for all ages, especially for 3-12 years old. Older kids can play alone while you, as a parent, can play along with your 3-5 years old child. Game supports multitouch for your convenience.
We Make Games That Kids Want To Play
As you probably know, we read each and every email, message or tweet you guys are sending us. Keep proposing ideas, helping us with bugs you find or just connect to say hello.Please don't forget to rate the games.
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
Website: http://www.my-town.com
Twitter: https://twitter.com/mytowngames

bluejetty:00082756:ios.summary:
Build an interval workout around the way you train.
Cero is a flexible interval timer for HIIT, Tabata, circuit training, WODs and HYROX preparation. Set up a quick work/rest timer or program each interval in detail. Distinct colors, large
bluejetty:00082756:ios.description:
Build an interval workout around the way you train.
Cero is a flexible interval timer for HIIT, Tabata, circuit training, WODs and HYROX preparation. Set up a quick work/rest timer or program each interval in detail. Distinct colors, large controls and reliable cues keep you focused on the session instead of the clock.
BUILD YOUR SESSION
• Set work, recovery, sets, warm-up and cool-down.
• Create advanced workouts with custom intervals, colors, icons and intensity levels.
• Save, duplicate and reorder timers.
• Share timers by file or QR code.
• Review completed sessions in workout history.
STAY IN THE WORKOUT
• Follow compatible sessions with Live Activities and Dynamic Island.
• Start saved or recent timers from Home Screen widgets.
• Use Siri and Shortcuts to start, pause, resume and stop a timer.
• Put Gym Display on a larger screen or mirrored TV.
• Choose a default song or assign music to individual intervals.
• Customize sounds, voice cues, vibrations and background alerts.
TRAIN BY HEART RATE
Adaptive HR can extend recovery until you reach your target heart rate, then guide hard efforts with low and high alerts. Pair a Bluetooth heart-rate monitor with iPhone or train with heart-rate data from Apple Watch.
COUNTDOWN AND STOPWATCH
The built-in countdown and lap stopwatch cover warm-ups, station changes, rest periods and race-day practice. Stopwatch sessions continue after you close and reopen the app.
ON APPLE WATCH
Run saved workouts from your wrist, follow heart rate and use the standalone countdown and stopwatch.
Cero can save completed workouts and estimated calories to Apple Health. Automatic iCloud backups help protect saved timers and custom intervals.
Useful for HIIT, Tabata, circuits, EMOM-style workouts, boxing rounds, strength and conditioning, indoor cycling, running intervals and hybrid race preparation.
Feedback and suggestions: hi@flawless.studio
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00061988:ios.description:
Entertain your baby for hours with "Baby Games - Piano, Baby Phone, First Words", a fun, simple, colorful, and FREE educational phone game designed with kids and toddlers in mind!
Learning is fun with Baby Games, and there are plenty of mini-games and educational activities here to keep babies interested. It starts with pictures of animals, children can match to the sounds they make. There are also balloon popping games, musical learning modes, fun activities, and more. It's the perfect baby phone game to keep the little ones entertained.
Baby Games has a lively and easy to use interface that's perfect for kids between six and twelve months old. One and two year old toddlers or even kindergarteners will have fun with it, too! While playing, children of all ages will laugh and giggle as they explore all the fun activities at their fingertips, helping to develop attention and observational skills along with memory and fine motor control.
Baby Games also features fun nursery rhymes, baby songs, and rhyming games for kids and toddlers in an easy to use child-safe interface. bluejetty:00036892:ios.description:
The Green Gazette – Two News Apps in One
The Green Gazette app gives you two apps in one simple download. You can read the full daily digital newspaper and also follow live local news that updates all day long.
This is a 2-in-1 app. You can choose which experience you prefer and switch back and forth anytime.
One option is the daily digital newspaper, also called the eEdition. It looks like the printed paper and is easy to read on your phone or tablet.
The other option is live news from thegazette.com. Stories update in real time as news happens.
You can set your preference to open the app in the experience you like most, or change between the two whenever you want.
Read the Daily Digital Newspaper
• View every page of the daily paper
• Zoom in to make words and photos larger
• Download the paper to read later, even without internet
Get Live News Updates
• Breaking news as it happens
• Local news, sports, weather, and community stories
• New articles added throughout the day
Easy to Read and Easy to Use
• Make text bigger for comfortable reading
• Listen to articles read out loud
• Translate stories into other languages
• Share stories by email with family and friends
Whether you prefer reading the daily paper or keeping up with live news as it happens, The Green Gazette app lets you do both — all in one place.
Download once. Choose your experience. Stay connected to Eastern Iowa every day.
