bluejetty:00114913:ios.description:
Math Clash: Discover the smart way to enjoy numbers.
Ready for a fresh, challenging take on number puzzles? Math Clash blends the brain-teasing fun of cross-style puzzles with classic math operations to create an experience that’s stimulating, rewarding, and deeply satisfying. Challenge opponents in exciting mathematical crossword competitions where speed and accuracy determine the winner. If you enjoy thinking through problems and want to sharpen your math and logic skills, Math Clash is your perfect daily companion. Each puzzle is carefully designed to make you think, not guess — and every win feels earned.
Features
- Cross-style Math Challenges Each level looks like a classic crossword — but instead of words, you’re solving math equations. Every number you place must make mathematical sense both horizontally and vertically.
- Daily Tasks Quick, rewarding puzzles that give you a reason to return every day. Build your streak, keep your brain sharp, and unlock daily rewards just for showing up and solving.
- Monthly Challenge Explore themed puzzle packs every month with increasing difficulty and unique trophies. Complete the monthly calendar to earn special collectibles.
- Unlock the Painting Collection As you solve, you collect pieces of hidden artworks. Put together each painting, level by level — your progress becomes a visual gallery of your achievement.
- Quick Solve Duels: Prove Your Math Mastery Step into a fast-paced challenge where every second counts. Compete directly against other players in back-to-back math puzzles to see how your skills compare. Race against opponents to complete mathematical crosswords faster while maintaining accuracy. It’s not just speed — it’s smart thinking under pressure.
- Hints When You Need Them Stuck? Smart hints give you guidance without spoiling the solution. Learn, improve, and try again — it’s all part of the fun.
- Track Your Progress Monitor your puzzle stats over time. Watch your accuracy, speed, and consistency improve as you advance through hundreds of handcrafted puzzles.
Who Will Love Math Clash?
- Students looking to practice mental math in an interactive way
- Adults seeking meaningful brain training without distractions
- Puzzle lovers who enjoy logical thinking and number challenges
- Competitive players who thrive on challenging friends and strangers in math duels
- Anyone who prefers thoughtful problem-solving over mindless tapping
Whether you’re new to math puzzles or a long-time fan, Math Clash offers a space to think clearly, learn something new, and enjoy the rewarding feeling of solving a tough challenge.
Start solving today — and let numbers surprise you. With fresh puzzles, collectible art, and exciting head-to-head math competitions against real players, Math Clash is more than just a game. It’s your daily destination for mental clarity and fun. Download Math Clash now and turn numbers into your favorite daily ritual!

bluejetty:00186153:ios.description:
Minimalist drawing app. Supports Apple Pencil (new & old), widgets, both portrait & landscape, iPad multitasking, standard iOS share, the latest devices. Pick up & use. Like a white board or scratch paper.
~~ Features ~~
• Widget to show case the latest or favorite drawing on the home screen
• Apple Pencil gesture support
• Multi-window and multitasking support on iPadOS
• Original Apple Pencil support
• Grid background and lined background
• Draw on top of another picture
• Save square images for Instagram submission
• Draw in either landscape or portrait
• Undo and redo
• Standard iOS share/action button (copy, save, send to other messaging/social apps)
~~ Perfect for ~~
• Jotting down notes
• Illustrate something to friends/coworkers through drawing
• Draw/sketch something casually
• Tell stories to kids with quick illustrations
• Play quick random games with friends (e.g. draw and guess, or any simple board game you just invented)
• Practice some basic drawing skills (drawing straight line, parallel lines, circles, faces, etc)
~~ Draw for a better world ~~
Super Simple Draw started as a way to reduce the use of papers because we believe that the current environmental degradation and the climate change are pressing issues that demand urgent actions. Now we took a step further: for every ~2000 lines you draw, we plant a tree through a partnership with Trees for the Future. More than ten thousand trees have been planted so far. Learn more at https://trees.theiosapp.com

bluejetty:00120622:ios.name: Baby Panda's Supermarket
bluejetty:00120622:ios.summary: In Baby Panda's Supermarket, you can not only enjoy kids' shopping games and simulate a real supermarket experience but also play as a supermarket cashier and check out items! Apart from that, there are also many fun events for you to join
bluejetty:00120622:ios.description:
In Baby Panda's Supermarket, you can not only enjoy kids' shopping games and simulate a real supermarket experience but also play as a supermarket cashier and check out items! Apart from that, there are also many fun events for you to join in the supermarket. Shop in the Supermarket Game with your shopping list now!
A WIDE VARIETY OF GOODS 
The supermarket has a wide variety of goods, including over 300 kinds of goods such as food, toys, children's clothing, fruits, cosmetics, and everyday items. You can buy almost anything you want here! Look carefully, on which shelf are the items you want to buy?
BUY WHAT YOU NEED
Go to the supermarket and shop for Daddy Panda's birthday party! Birthday cake, ice cream, some flowers, birthday presents, and more! Next, let's buy some new school supplies for the upcoming school season! Remember to check your shopping list to make sure you've bought everything you need!
SUPERMARKET EVENTS
If you like to cook delicious food and make crafts, then don't miss out on the supermarket's DIY activities! You can cook any popular gourmet food and make any items you like, such as cupcakes, chicken burgers, and festival masks. The supermarket also offers art walls, claw machines, capsule toy machines, DIY clothing counters, and other facilities for you to try!
SHOPPING RULES
While shopping in the supermarket, you may also encounter bad behavior such as climbing shelves, running around with carts and jumping the queue. Through the vivid scene interpretation and correct guidance, you will learn the shopping rules in the supermarket, stay out of danger, and shop in a civilized way!
CASHIER GAMES
Want to use a cash register and try scanning and checking out items? In the supermarket game for kids, you can become a cashier, learn the checkout process, and get to know payment methods like cash and credit cards! Learn numbers and improve your math skills while making the shopping experience more fun!
New stories happen in Baby Panda's Supermarket Game every day. Come play as a customer, cashier, supermarket boss, or anyone you want, and have a great shopping time!
FEATURES:
- A two-storied supermarket: a supermarket game especially designed for kids;
- Restores the real scene: 40+ counters and 300+ kinds of goods;
- Enjoy shopping: food, toys, clothes, fruits, electrical appliances, and more;
- Fun family games: grabbing toys from the claw machine, applying makeup, dress-up, food DIY, and more;
- Featured holiday decorations to create a lively atmosphere in the supermarket；
- While shopping in the supermarket, you'll learn the rules of safe shopping;
- Trial services: playing with toys, trying a sample, etc.; 
- Cashier service: Become a cashier and manage cash or credit card payments;
- A fun cognitive and life simulation game for kids: helps kids learn about everyday items!
About BabyBus
—————
At BabyBus, we dedicate ourselves to sparking kids' creativity, imagination and curiosity,and designing our products through the kids' perspective to help them explore the world on their own.
Now BabyBus offers a wide variety of products, videos and other educational content for over 600 million fans from ages 0-8 around the world! We have released over 200 children's apps, over 2500 episodes of nursery rhymes and animations, over 9000 stories of various themes spanning the Health, Language, Society, Science, Art and other fields.
—————
Contact us: ser@babybus.com
Visit us: https://app.babybus.com

Create Stunning Social Media Content with Temply
Temply is the ultimate video editing app for creating short-form content, perfectly designed for social media platforms. Whether you're a content creator, business owner, marketing professional, or personal user, Temply offers a comprehensive toolkit to bring your vision to life.
Why you'll love using Temply:
A smarter way to make videos with AI Creator:
• Pick your photos and clips, add a prompt, or choose from pre-made business prompt ideas, then fine tune it with template filters for style, audience, or purpose. In seconds, you'll have a beautifully crafted, effective video with music, designed to boost your brand’s performance.
Templates that Inspire:
• 600+ Templates: Choose from a diverse range of templates tailored for Reels, TikTok, Stories, and more.
• AI-Powered "Created For You": Instantly generate engaging, trendy videos using your personal media.
• Beat-Synced Templates: Effortlessly create videos synchronized to music beats.
Tools to Enhance Your Content:
• Royalty-Free Music: Access 600+ soundtracks for social media and commercial use.
• Fonts & Text Tools: Customize with 100+ fonts, shadows, strokes, and color picking.
• Stickers & Filters: Use 800+ trendy stickers and 50+ filters to elevate your content.
• Transitions & Effects: Add dynamic transitions and effects for professional-quality results.
User-Friendly Interface:
• Quick Learning Curve: Ideal for newcomers in the world of social media content creation.
• 4K Export: Ensure high-quality video output for all your projects.
• Direct Sharing: Share your creations directly to social media platforms.
Features for Your Brand:
• Personalization: Import your brand’s logo, fonts, and colors to maintain brand consistency.
• Commercial Templates: Utilize templates designed specifically for business promotions.
All-In-One Editing Capabilities:
• Trim & Mix: Easily edit music and video clips.
• Slow Motion & Speed Up: Adjust the speed of your media.
• AI Background Remover: Quickly remove backgrounds from your videos.
• Live Photos to Videos: Transform live photos into stunning videos.
• Stock Footage Library: Access unlimited stock footage for your projects.
• Multi-Language Auto Captions: Automatically generate captions in multiple languages.
Subscribe now to enjoy all the features described above.

• The cost of renewal will be charged to your account in the 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
• When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.

ANY MODEL, ONE TAP AW
bluejetty:00040814:ios.description:
Invisioned: The Ultimate AI Companion
The world's top AI models, together in one simple app. Chat with GPT-6, Claude, Grok, Gemini and Kimi, create images and videos, and research anything with sources you can check.
ANY MODEL, ONE TAP AWAY
Pick the model that fits the task and switch whenever you like.
• GPT-6 Luna for fast, everyday answers
• GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Astra for deep reasoning and hard problems
• Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable 5.1 for careful writing, code, and analysis
• Grok 4.7, Gemini 3.8 Flash and Kimi K3 for quick, wide-ranging help
Every reply shows which model wrote it.
THINK FAST OR THINK DEEP
Slide from Instant to Ultra to choose how hard the AI thinks. Watch it work in real time: its reasoning steps, the searches it runs and the pages it reads.
CREATE IMAGES AND VIDEO
Describe what you want and watch it appear right in your chat. Then ask for changes, like "make the sky darker" or "add a title".
• Images with GPT Image, Nano Banana Pro and Grok Imagine
• Short videos with Veo 3 and Grok Imagine
The same slider sets image quality, from quick drafts to our finest detail.
ANSWERS YOU CAN CHECK
Turn on web search for up-to-date answers with every source linked. Use Deep research for a full report on any topic, or ask Perplexity for live answers from the web.
SNAP, ATTACH, ASK
Take a photo or attach an image or file and ask about it: summarize a document, explain a chart, solve a problem from your notes or identify what's in a picture.
BUILT FOR REAL WORK
Write emails and essays, plan trips, study for exams, get help with math and code, translate, brainstorm ideas and more. Answers are clear and well organized, with headings, lists, tables and code when they help.
Terms of Service: https://invisioned.io/tos
Privacy Policy: https://invisioned.io/privacy

bluejetty:00034934:ios.description:
WELCOME TO TATA CLIQ FASHION 
A place where style meets substance, and every click is a step towards defining your narrative. TATA CLiQ Fashion is more than just a fashion shopping app - we are enablers of style for consumers who crave authenticity, expression, individuality, and impact. 
From curated collections from over 4000+ brands and the hottest trends to cutting-edge features, everything is designed to celebrate YOU. 
Download TATA CLiQ Fashion App to: 
Discover Your Style 
Explore curated edits for women, men, and kids, with collections that are on-trend for every occasion. From new season launches to exclusive collaborations, find pieces that are as unique as you are. Choose from smart casual wear by brands like U.S. Polo Assn., Jack & Jones, and ONLY, or browse occasion-ready ethnic wear from Fabindia, Biba, and Westside. Complete the look with stylish and trendy footwear from top brands like PUMA and ADIDAS that blend comfort with contemporary flair. 
Shop Smart 
Navigate our expert curation of brands chosen for their commitment to quality, authenticity, and innovation. Whether it’s casual wear for men and women or standout pieces for special occasions, we’ve got styles that speak to you. Use intuitive filtering options to discover looks that reflect your vibe. With our app, you can also find beautiful home decor online that adds warmth and character to your space. 
Buy Effortlessly, Every Time 
We guarantee 100% original products, hassle-free returns, secure payments, and EMI options. Browse across categories, from fashion and beauty to footwear, and earn NeuCoins as you shop! 
Dress With Purpose 
We believe in the power of individuality, the beauty of diversity, the foundation of tradition, and the necessity of sustainability. Our vision is an inclusive future where fashion is not just worn but lived, and enable that with expert-approved curations tailored for every occasion and season. Through expert curation and deep industry insight, TATA CLiQ Fashion brings this vision to life - championing makers, materials, and stories that truly matter. 
Experience Innovation 
Tailored to your taste, our personalised updates make shopping effortless and interactive, offering a customer journey that’s seamless and suited for you. 
Stay Ahead of Trends 
Receive updates on the latest arrivals, exclusive drops, and must-have pieces in real-time. From trend playbooks to access to style insiders, our app keeps you connected to the latest in fashion. Stay clued in on everything from streetwear and timeless men’s shirts by Arrow, Van Heusen, and Allen Solly to women’s must-haves like chic dresses and effortless tops from global brands like Calvin Klein Jeans and Guess. Browse this season’s most-wanted handbags online, that are both functional and on-trend. 
Get Inspired 
Join a community of fashion fans. Whether you’re building a look for today or finding inspiration for tomorrow, the TATA CLiQ Fashion app brings you closer to your style goals. 
Step Into The Future 
Backed by a legacy of excellence, we come from the TATA Group, renowned for its dedication to quality, integrity, and innovation. Our foundation is strong, our ambitions boundless. With decades of expertise, culture-defining successes, and a forward-thinking approach, we blend tradition with the cutting-edge to offer you the best of both worlds. And with TATA CLiQ Fashion as the official online shopping destination for Westside, your favourite pieces from the trusted high-street favourite are now just a click away. 
Your Wardrobe, Redefined 
Download the TATA CLiQ Fashion app and redefine what style means to you. From everyday staples to statement pieces, this shopping app makes style simple. Each click is more than a choice - it’s a step toward expressing who you are.

bluejetty:00034377:ios.summary: Join "Mystical Riddles: Haunted Portraits", an exhilarating blend of a detective story and FBI games that will keep you on the edge of your seat! With your extraordinary camera in hand, attend the exhibition of the mysterious and suddenly c
bluejetty:00034377:ios.description:
Join "Mystical Riddles: Haunted Portraits", an exhilarating blend of a detective story and FBI games that will keep you on the edge of your seat! With your extraordinary camera in hand, attend the exhibition of the mysterious and suddenly celebrated photographer Oliver Cook. His lifelike portraits and the whispers of people disappearing in his gallery present an enigma that only you can solve. Step into this world of shadows, seek and find hidden objects, and solve crimes and mysteries to uncover the truth. Perfect for fans of intriguing games, clue mysteries, and those who love to play detective, this game will challenge you to solve the mystery behind Oliver Cook’s haunting success!
You may not be a photographer, but you have the most extraordinary camera in your use, so you might as well learn something helpful by attending one of the exhibitions of the outstanding photographer Oliver Cook. It's quite strange since nobody had ever heard of this name before and suddenly the man became a true genius. The characters in his work really look so alive, as if they are about to step out of the frame and share a few secrets with you. Discover the secret of his unbelievable success and don't let it fade away with the appearance of ugly rumors about people disappearing in his celebrated gallery.
Realistic and Haunting Artwork!
Armed with an extraordinary camera, delve into the chilling exhibitions of the enigmatic photographer Oliver Cook. As night falls, the gallery transforms into a realm of shadows and whispers, challenging you to solve the mystery within its depths!
Diverse Array of Puzzles and Mini-Games!
Engage in a variety of intriguing games that challenge your logical thinking and problem-solving skills. From jigsaw puzzles to code-breaking tasks hidden within haunted portraits, each piece is crucial to solving the mystery!
Impactful Decision-Making!
Your choices directly impact the narrative, leading to multiple endings based on how you interact with the game’s characters and seek and find hidden objects. Choose wisely to solve crimes and mysteries while protecting your humanity!
Achievements and Rewards!
Earn achievements as you progress through hidden object games — each one commemorating your successes and the challenges you've overcome. These accolades not only mark your achievements but also enhance replayability and reward your curiosity and bravery!
Step into the shadows, solve crimes and mysteries, and let the intriguing games of Mystical Riddles: Haunted Portraits take you on an unforgettable detective story journey!

bluejetty:00134277:ios.description:
Number Match is a colorful, addictive, and entertaining number block merge game.
Number Match exciting gameplay and simple mechanics, this great merge number puzzle offers an exciting and entertaining experience for players of all ages. Number Match is a new number matching game inspired by the addictive 2048 puzzle mechanics.
The main objective of the game is to follow and match higher numbers by connecting same numbered blocks. The main motivation is to reach the new number checkpoint such as 2048 puzzle mechanics. Starting with the number two, you can increase your score by going from number to number, and multiply your score with each block move.
Merge all the blocks and beat your own best score. Beyond matching numbers, it's about using your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to make more combos and win more points.
The game's sliding and smooth controls make it easy and enjoyable to play, allowing players to merge more numbers and win more combos with each move. You'll need to use your wits to make smart moves and reach the highest score in a single merge from the whole board. But good news for you there is no time limit, so take your time and make the right decisions with every match.
With the auto-save feature, you can play wherever you want without the need for an Internet connection and continue to match.
As you progress, you'll need to match greater numbers at each step, challenging your memory, concentration levels, and reflexes. But the colorful graphics and simple controls will keep you engaged and entertained as you train your brain with excellent mechanics.
With its addictive gameplay, colorful graphics, and challenging levels, it is sure to become your new favorite puzzle game. So start to matching now and collect the scores.
Game Features
- Easy to learn
- Simple controls
- No time limits
- Colorful & shiny graphic design
- Automatic save game

bluejetty:00015834:ios.description:
Discover the Backbone of American Democracy
Constitutional Companion puts the full text of the 1789 United States Constitution in your hands. This app offers a comprehensive, user-friendly platform to explore, study, and understand the foundational document that defines the nation’s government and protects its citizens’ rights.
Whether you are a student, educator, lawyer, or engaged citizen, this app simplifies access to crucial legal texts and historical documents. It empowers you with knowledge about your rights, government structure, and the laws that continue to shape the country today.
1. Extensive Content Library
Complete U.S. Constitution
Read the Preamble, Articles, and all 27 Amendments. Navigate quickly and understand clearly.
2.Executive Orders from the 42nd President
Access important executive orders that shaped national policy.
3. Federal Rules of Civil Procedure
Study the procedural rules governing civil court cases across the United States.
4. Landmark Civil Rights Documents
Includes the Emancipation Proclamation, Civil Rights Act of 1964, and Voting Rights Act of 1965.
5. Constitutional Companion Podcast
Listen to short episodes that break down constitutional concepts, amendments, and major rulings. Ideal for learners on the go.
6. Powerful Tools for Study and Reference
Advanced Search
Find specific clauses, keywords, or phrases in seconds.
7. Interactive Navigation
Browse by section, article, or amendment. Use bookmarks to save important passages.
8. Educational Summaries
Understand complex sections with plain-language explanations.
9. Offline Access
Use the app anytime, anywhere, no internet needed.
10. Accessibility Options
Adjustable font sizes and a clean interface for all users.
11. Regular Updates
Get notified about anniversaries, new rulings, or proposed amendments.
12. Why Use Constitutional Companion?
For Students
A reliable, accessible study aid for civics and history courses.
13. Now Includes: Constitutional Companion Podcast
Stay informed on the go with our official podcast, available directly in the app. Episodes will cover:
What the Constitution says about free speech
The history and impact of key amendments
Supreme Court decisions that shaped constitutional law
The Civil Rights Act explained in plain English
The balance of powers between Congress and the President
How executive orders work and why they matter
Key legal terms and what they mean for you
New episodes added regularly. Each one is short, focused, and designed to deepen your understanding.
For Educators
Enhance classroom teaching with accurate legal texts and simplified summaries.
For Legal Professionals
Quick access to legal texts and procedural rules. Ideal for reference and research.
For Engaged Citizens
Know your rights. Stay informed. Participate with understanding.
How This App Adds Value
Consolidates essential legal documents in one place
Promotes legal literacy and civic understanding
Makes complex texts easy to access and explore
Includes a podcast for easy learning and engagement
Commitment to Accuracy and Transparency

bluejetty:00151937:ios.description:
Meet Focado — a cozy focus timer where your concentration turns into handmade progress.
When you focus, Avo — your tiny knitting avocado — starts knitting warm little beanies and gloves.
Every stitch represents your focus. But if you interrupt the timer, Avo immediately drops the needles.
Finish your session and Avo will trade the beanies and gloves they knitted for beautiful decorations to upgrade their room.
The more you focus, the more Avo knits — and the cozier their world becomes.
Now, you can also personalize your experience with a variety of Avocado skins.
Unlock and choose your favorite Avo, and enjoy focusing with a character that fits your style.
Focado is designed for students, workers, creators, and anyone who wants a calm, motivating way to stay consistent.
Focus → Knit → Trade → Decorate.
Simple, relaxing, and deeply rewarding.
Why You’ll Love Focado
Knitting Mechanic: Avo knits beanies and gloves as you stay focused
Avocado Skins: Unlock and use different Avo styles to match your vibe
Decoration Exchange: Completed sessions allow Avo to trade knitted items for new decorations
Multiple Rooms: Decorate both Avo’s Study Room and Living Room to create your own cozy space
Deep Focus Mode: Block distracting apps to protect your concentration and maximize Avo’s knitting
Pomodoro Breaks: Give yourself a calm, refreshing break
Live Activity: Track your timer progress right from the Lock Screen
Room Themes: Cozy, Nature, Farmhouse, and more
Focus Tags: Tag each session (Study, Work, Custom, and more) to understand what you focus on
Detailed Stats: Track your focus time daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly
Progress System: Strong focus = more knitting = more decorations
How It Works
Start a focus session
Choose or create a Focus Tag for what you're working on
Avo begins knitting beanies and gloves
Stay focused while Avo keeps creating
At the end, Avo trades knitted items for decorations
Use decorations to customize both the Study Room and Living Room
Review your stats and see how much you focused over time — and on what
Personalize Avo with skins and grow their cozy world
Privacy First
All processing happens locally on your device.
No data is uploaded, stored, or shared externally.
Terms & Support
Terms of Service: https://focadoapp.com/termsandconditions
Privacy Policy: https://focadoapp.com/privacypolicy
Support: support@focadoapp.com
Start Your Cozy Focus Journey
Build better focus habits, stay consistent, and grow Avo’s world one stitch at a time.
Download Focado today — Avo is already holding the yarn.

bluejetty:00032498:ios.description:
NKJV Bible with audio narration, AI Bible Chat, daily verses, study plans, devotionals, and full offline reading.
Published by Thomas Nelson in 1982, the New King James Version updates the beloved King James Bible into clear, modern English while keeping its trusted, word-for-word style. Loved by Protestant and Evangelical readers worldwide.
Read, listen, highlight, study, and pray every day — no account needed, with full offline access to all 66 books.
WHAT YOU WILL FIND INSIDE
• COMPLETE NKJV BIBLE — Read all 66 books of the Old and New Testament in clear, modern English.
• AUDIO BIBLE — Listen to Bible chapters with natural narration at home, in the car, while walking, or whenever you want to hear God's Word.
• AI BIBLE CHAT — Ask questions about Scripture, passages, themes, faith, or Christian life and receive easy-to-understand answers grounded in the Bible.
• DAILY VERSE — Begin your day with an inspiring Bible verse and guided prayer.
• VERSE MARKING — Highlight verses, add bookmarks, and save personal notes as you study.
• OFFLINE READING — Access the complete Bible without an internet connection and without creating an account.
• READING & STUDY PLANS — Build a consistent Bible habit with guided study plans and reading journeys.
• HOME SCREEN WIDGET — Keep Scripture visible throughout your day directly from your Home Screen.
• DAILY DEVOTIONAL — Grow in faith with short devotional readings and reflections.
• POWERFUL BIBLE SEARCH — Quickly find verses, words, passages, and topics across Scripture.
GROW IN GOD'S WORD
Whether you want to understand a difficult passage, learn more about a biblical topic, strengthen your faith, or simply build a daily Bible habit, NKJV Bible gives you tools to read, listen, study, and reflect.
Use AI Bible Chat when you have questions, follow guided study plans when you want to go deeper, or simply open the Bible and continue reading wherever you left off.
EVERY SEASON, EVERY MOMENT
• CHRISTMAS — Walk through the birth of Jesus with special readings and prayers.
• EASTER — Follow the resurrection story through Scripture.
• GOOD FRIDAY — Pause and reflect on the sacrifice of Jesus on the cross.
• LENT — Journey through a season of reflection, renewal, prayer, and fasting.
FOR EVERYONE
Whether you are opening the Bible for the first time, returning after years away, studying with your family, or serving in church ministry, NKJV Bible is designed to make daily Scripture reading simple and meaningful.
Simple enough for beginners and powerful enough for deeper Bible study.
PREMIUM STUDY — OPTIONAL
Unlock additional premium features to enhance your Bible study experience.
Premium access may include:

• Ad-free experience
• Premium study features
Premium access is currently available through one-time purchase options. Pay once for the selected access — no recurring subscription is required.
AI features may use a credit-based system depending on the selected purchase option.

bluejetty:00039508:ios.description:
تطبيق "نمبربوك الخليج" 
هو رفيقك المثالي لاستكشاف الاماكن وارقام الخدمات التي تهمك والتمتع بأفضل الخدمات في دول الخليج بكل سهولة. 
احصل على تجربة فريدة من نوعها في البحث عن ارقام ومواقع المطاعم الشهية، والفنادق الراقية، ومحطات الوقود بأسلوب عصري معتمدين على الذكاء الاصطناعي.
### مميزات نمبربوك الخليج:
1. البحث الفوري:
اكتشف ارقام و المواقع القريبة منك بسرعة عبر نظام بحث فعّال وذكي.
2. دليل شامل:
تصفح قاعدة بيانات ضخمة تشمل معلومات دقيقة حول المطاعم، والفنادق، ومحطات الوقود، مع تقييمات المستخدمين.
3. معلومات محدثة:
احصل على تفاصيل دقيقة مثل أوقات العمل، وأرقام الاتصال، وتوجيهات الوصول لتجنب أي عناء غير ضروري.
4. حفظ المفضلات:
سجل الأماكن المحبوبة لديك واستمتع بالوصول السريع إليها في أي وقت.
5. واجهة مستخدم بديهية:
استمتع بتجربة مستخدم سهلة وممتعة من خلال واجهة بسيطة وجذابة.
قم بتحميل تطبيق "نمبربوك الخليج" اليوم واستفد من أفضل الخدمات بين يديك بسهولة وراحة.
تطبيق نمبربوك الخليج :-
 يدعم الدول التالية:-
• دول الخليج
 (السعودية ، الإمارات العربية المتحدة ، الكويت ، قطر ، عمان ، البحرين)
 • الدول العربية
 (مصر ، فلسطين ، اليمن ، الأردن ، ليبيا ، الجزائر ، السودان ، المغرب ، تونس ، لبنان ، العراق)
 - متخصص للبحث عن الارقام والاسماء 
- يدعم جميع أرقام الجوال
- يدعم جميع أرقام الهواتف الثابتة
- يدعم جميع أرقام الخدمة مثل: 800 و 92
- يدعم جميع أرقام دول الخليج
- يدعم جميع ارقام الدول العربية

bluejetty:00069571:ios.description:
Condé Nast Traveller brings you the world at your fingertips. Inside every issue, the world’s best travel writers and specialists share their secrets and offer new and authentic experiences. Features on new destinations, or well-loved classics and ideas for achieving holidays in places you’ve only dreamed of, Condé Nast Traveller magazine will take you there. 
Plus our regular features: 
Word of Mouth: What’s hot and happening around the world
The Experts: The world’s top travel specialists and writers help you with your travel queries
Great Journeys: By road, train or boat, we’ll inspire you to discover places on and off the beaten track
Wining & Dining: Savour a taste of the world with features on the best wine cuisines and top restaurants
Short Breaks: Escape and unwind with our insider guides to great long-weekend and city-break destinations
Where to stay: New resorts, charming hotels, boutique B&Bs and spas abroad and at home
Luxury on a Budget: We share our money-saving tips so you can get even better value for your well-earned holidays
Truth in Travel
Condé Nast Traveller magazine is the authority in travel and has a “no freebies no press trips” policy and reports on how places really are. 
Digital purchase options available: 
A single issue for £3.99
A 1-month subscription for £3.99

bluejetty:00185294:ios.summary:
Die KiKA-Player App ist die kostenlose Mediathek vom Kinderkanal von ARD und ZDF und bietet Kinderserien, Kinderfilme und Videos für Kinder – zum Anschauen auch offline gespeicherter Videos und zum Streamen.
LIEBLINGSVIDEOS 
Dein Kind hat
bluejetty:00185294:ios.description:
Die KiKA-Player App ist die kostenlose Mediathek vom Kinderkanal von ARD und ZDF und bietet Kinderserien, Kinderfilme und Videos für Kinder – zum Anschauen auch offline gespeicherter Videos und zum Streamen.
LIEBLINGSVIDEOS 
Dein Kind hat Schloss Einstein oder Die Pfefferkörner verpasst, weil es noch in der Schule war? Du hast Unser Sandmännchen nachts gesucht, weil der Nachwuchs nicht schlafen kann? Im KiKA-Player findest du ganz unkompliziert viele Sendungen von KiKA. Egal, ob deine Kinder Fans von Märchen und Filmen, Feuerwehrmann Sam, Robin Hood, Löwenzahn oder den Schlümpfen sind – bei uns ist für jeden etwas dabei. Schau doch einfach mal rein und klick dich durch! 
MEINE OFFLINE VIDEOS
Du bist unterwegs mit deinen Kindern und hast weder WLAN noch ausreichend mobile Daten, um die neuen Folgen der Lieblingsserie anzuschauen? Unsere Offline-Funktion macht es möglich! Speicher ganz einfach vorher Videos in deinem Offline-Bereich. So können Kinder mit der KiKA-Player App jederzeit und überall auf dem iPhone oder iPad unser Kinderprogramm schauen – egal ob zuhause oder unterwegs. 
MEIN PROFIL - MEIN BEREICH 
Das jüngere Kind mag besonders KiKANiNCHEN, Super Wings und Shaun das Schaf, das ältere Geschwisterkind möchte aber lieber die Wissensformate und Serien für Ältere wie die Checker Welt, logo!, PUR+, die WGs oder Find me in Paris auschecken? Dann wird dich diese Nachricht freuen: Jeder kann sein eigenes Profil anlegen und seine Lieblingsvideos im Mag-ich-Bereich merken, angefangene Videos im Weitergucken-Bereich später schauen oder für die Offline-Nutzung speichern. Ob Herzchen-Bär, Zyklop , Einhorn oder Hase – jedes Kind kann einen eigenen Avatar auswählen und die App für sich individuell gestalten. 
VIDEOS AUF DEN FERNSEHER STREAMEN 
iPad oder iPhone ist dir zu klein? Du möchtest lieber gemeinsam als Familie oder mit Freunden Lieblingsserien oder Filme schauen? Mit Chromecast und AirPlay kannst du die Videos auf den großen Bildschirm streamen. Außerdem gibt es den KiKA-Player auch als HbbTV-Angebot am Smart-TV. So bringst du das Kinderprogramm direkt in dein Wohnzimmer. 
INFORMATIONEN FÜR ELTERN 
Die familienfreundliche KiKA-Player App ist geschützt und altersgerecht. Es werden nur Kinderfilme und Kinderserien angezeigt, die auch wirklich für Kinder angemessen sind. Anhand der Altersangabe im Profil werden ebenfalls nur altersgerechte Videos empfohlen. Im Erwachsenenbereich finden Eltern weitere Funktionen, um das Angebot noch individueller für ihre Kinder zu gestalten. Es ist möglich, die Anzeige von Videos in der gesamten App auf Filme und Serien für Vorschulkinder zu beschränken. Außerdem lässt sich die verfügbare Videozeit mit dem App-Wecker einstellen. Das öffentlich-rechtliche Kinderprogramm bleibt wie gewohnt kostenlos, gewaltfrei und ohne Werbung. 
APP-DETAILS UND FUNKTIONEN AUF EINEN BLICK 
- einfaches und intuitives Design 
- individuelle Profile einrichten 
- Lieblingsvideos, Serien und Filme herzen
- angefangene Videos später weiterschauen
- Videos für die Offline-Nutzung speichern
- neue Videos in der KiKA-Player App entdecken 
- altersgerechte Videoangebote einstellen 
- App-Wecker stellen, um die Videozeit der Kinder zu begrenzen 
KONTAKTIERE UNS 
Wir freuen uns immer, von dir zu hören! Wünschst du dir eine weitere Funktion? Läuft etwas nicht wie erwartet? Der KiKA möchte die App auf einem hohen inhaltlichen und technischen Niveau weiterentwickeln. Feedback – Lob, Kritik, Ideen oder auch das Melden von Problemen – hilft uns dabei. Also lass gerne dein Feedback da, bewerte unsere App oder schreibe uns eine Nachricht an kika@kika.de. 
ÜBER UNS 
KiKA ist ein Gemeinschaftsangebot der ARD-Landesrundfunkanstalten und des ZDF. Seit 1997 bietet KiKA werbefreien und zielgruppenorientierten Content für Kinder von drei bis 13 Jahren.

-Community: Join a thriving community of surfers. Buy and sell with confidence, knowing you're part of a network that shares your passion for surfing.
-Secure messaging: Engage in secure conversations within the app. While all transactions take place off the app, Boardal's in-app messaging ensures a safe and convenient way for users to communicate and coordinate transactions.
Whether you're in the market for a new surfboard or looking to declutter your garage, Boardal is the go-to destination for surfers seeking quality, variety, and community.

bluejetty:00065994:ios.summary:

Play Gin Rummy wit
bluejetty:00065994:ios.description:
Welcome to most classic, interesting and special Gin Rummy!
Gin Rummy is a world-wide popular card game for 2 players, the objective of which is to form melds and reach an agreed number of points before the opponent does.
Play Gin Rummy with millions of real players around the world. You will be fascinated by the smooth gameplay, distinctive graphic and personalized features, which will bring you excellent gaming pleasure.
Join us to experience all the classic gin rummy and variations with customized gaming backgrounds. 
Unique Features:
Free Bonus: Earn Free Coins through numerous ways. Sign-in bonus, friend bonus, video bonus, online time bonus, level-up bonus, it’s more than you can imagine! 
Collections: Accomplish mystery collections of diverse themes with a lot of fun! Earn it either from friends or winning the game.
Customized Suit: Unlocked Customized suit including scenes, decks, and special gin & undercut effects. Play differently from others!
Social Functions: Connect with Facebook friends to play together and send gifts & collections to each other. Spread out the fortune and double your happiness.
Tutorial: If you are new to Gin Rummy, don’t worry! Tutorial can help you to get the game started easily. Just follow the steps and you will be familiar with the gameplay! 
Auto-sort: Arrange your cards and minimize the deadwood automatically for you! It’s a great helper to WIN BIG. 
Multiple Game Modes
Quick Start: Match opponent automatically and get into the play of classic Knock & Gin quickly.
Classic: Under this category, Knock & Gin, Straight Gin and Oklahoma Gin are included. You can set your own bet to match the opponent. Whoever reaches the chosen points first will win!
Quick Straight Gin: Play one game of Straight Gin for fast wins! Select the point value to decide your final winnings!
Private: Create a private table to challenge your friends! All game modes are available here.
Training: Improve your skills through training system. No internet connection required!
More tables such as Tournament will come along in the near future to enrich the game.
Basic Rules of Gin Rummy
Gin rummy is played with a standard 52-card pack of cards. The ranking from high to low is King, Queen, Jack, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, Ace.
Form the cards into sets of 3 or 4 cards sharing the same rank OR runs of 3 or more cards in sequence of the same suit.
In standard gin, only a player with 10 or fewer points of deadwood may knock. Knocking with 0 point of deadwood is known as going Gin.
If you initiate the Knock and score fewer points than the opponent, you win! If you score more points, the Undercut occurs and the opponent wins! 
How to play Variations
Classic Knock & Gin Rummy: It follows the basic rules of class gin rummy mentioned above.
Straight Gin Rummy: The feature of Straight Gin is that knocking is not allowed. Players are required to play until one of them can go gin. 
Oklahoma Gin Gummy: The value of the first face-up card is used to determine the maximum count at which players can knock. If the card is a spade, the hand will count double. 
Experience the unique features and enjoy a variety of game modes in Gin Rummy for extreme funs! Download now to show us your luck and skills.
Enjoying the game? Rate and review Gin Rummy if you find it attractive and amazing. Feel free to contact us as well via email or in-game support! Any suggestion or feedback will help us a lot for further game improvement and optimization. 
Please be noted that this game doesn’t offer real money gambling or an opportunity to win real money or prizes. The coins you win or lose have no real cash value.

bluejetty:00149425:ios.description:
The National Grid mobile app makes it easier to securely manage your account from anywhere. 
Set up biometrics so you can access your account quickly and securely. With biometrics, you can sign in without having to enter your username and password again. 
Once you’re signed in, you can easily:
• View essential account and billing information
• Enroll in paperless billing
• View and download a PDF of your current bill
• Schedule a payment in-app or via Speedpay
• Find nearby payment locations
• Report a power outage or gas emergency

We’ve also made it easier to report power outages and gas emergencies — with our mobile app, you’ve got access to emergency support right at your fingertips.

bluejetty:00175513:ios.description:
This is an exciting puzzle game where the player needs to solve different challenges by rotating the rings to find the gap.
FEATURES: 
 - The simple and addictive gameplay is suitable for players of all ages.
 - Multiple difficulty levels and level designs ensure the game's challenge and entertainment.
 - Each level has unique goals and rules, keeping players engaged with a sense of novelty.
 - Beautiful graphics and immersive sound effects provide an engaging gaming experience.
 - A lot of mechanics to master: D ring, S ring, or even exploding obstacles.
HOW TO PLAY:
 - Players need to rotate the ring by touching the screen to align it perfectly with the gap.
- The circle will display various colors or patterns that need to be aligned with the center target within a given time.
- Each successful match increases the score and unlocks the next, more challenging level.
- Pay attention to the time limit, try to complete the matches within the designated time, and avoid incorrect moves.
This game offers fun and challenges while enhancing spatial cognition and reaction speed. Whether during leisure time or while traveling, you can enjoy this addictive game.

bluejetty:00040389:ios.description:
Sticky Note Widget is a memo app built for widgets. Write a note, then put it straight onto your Home Screen.
UNLIMITED WIDGETS
Turn as many notes as you like into widgets. A shopping list, something you need to remember, today's plan — just glance at your Home Screen.
LOCK SCREEN TOO
Supports Lock Screen widgets (inline and rectangular), plus an iOS 18 Control Center control to open the app instantly.
STYLE EVERY NOTE
• Free choice of background, text and side-stripe colors
• Gradient backgrounds
• Text size 10 to 50, plus bold
• 5 fonts, including a handwriting style
• 20 icons
• Use your own photo as the background
HANDY EXTRAS
• Capture text with your camera and drop it into a note
• Summarize or bullet-point a note with Apple Intelligence (iOS 26 on supported devices)
• Back up and restore via iCloud
• Drag and drop to reorder, swipe to delete
GETTING STARTED
1. Tap + to create a note
2. Long-press the Home Screen, tap +, and choose Sticky Note Widget
3. Long-press the widget and choose Edit Widget to pick which note it shows
If a widget doesn't refresh, use "Update widgets" in Settings.
Free to use, supported by ads. A monthly plan removes all ads.
Terms of Use (EULA):

Whether you’re trying to clean your iPhone or organize your gallery, this smart app helps yo
bluejetty:00099713:ios.description:
iCleaner is your all-in-one iPhone cleaner — scan photos and videos to clean, swipe photos to clean, media compression and duplicate contact merge.
Whether you’re trying to clean your iPhone or organize your gallery, this smart app helps you do it fast, safe. It’s an iPhone cleaner app that works entirely on your device.
Smart AI Cleanup storage – One-Tap clean
Scan your album with AI to detect, then choose what you don't want.
Easily clean:
●Similar photos & videos
●Blurred photos & Screenshots
●Duplicate photos & videos
Detect and group similar photos and videos. We automatically highlight the best result in each group making it easy for you to review. Choose what you want to clean and tap once. A quick way to free up your storage.
Swipe to Clean Photos
Use swipe clean photos to quickly sort your memories:
●Swipe left to clean photos (sent to a built-in trash folder)
●Swipe right to keep important ones
●Organized by month/year for faster decision-making
●You can batch clean from the trash later.
Say goodbye to photo overload with this smart swipe to clean photos experience.
Photo & Video Compression
●Free up space with our powerful photo AI compressor.
●Reduce file size of images or videos.
●Maintain high quality while reducing storage usage.
Contact Manager
Organize your address book in seconds:
●Merge duplicate contacts.
●Back up your contacts with one tap and restore them instantly when needed.
●View all your contacts and easily select unwanted entries to clean.
iCleaner Pro
Pro subscription provides flexible subscription plans to suit your needs
●Yearly Subscription
●Weekly Subscription
All subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period. You can manage your subscriptions and disable auto-renewal through your Apple ID Account Settings.
Please note: if you purchase a subscription, any remaining time from a free trial will be forfeited. Free trials are exclusively available to new users who have not previously subscribed to that plan. Each Apple ID is eligible for one free trial.
If you have subscribed before and reinstalled the app, use the [Restore] option to regain access to your existing subscription.
Permissions
●Media permissions:
We need to obtain authorization from your photo album
1.Used to identify duplicate similar photos

bluejetty:00152075:ios.description:
Unleash the Rhythm in Music Hop: Rhythm & Ball Game!
Are you ready to drop the beat? Music Hop is the addictive new music game that challenges your reflexes and rhythm. Control the jumping ball, hop across glowing tiles, and immerse yourself in a world of incredible sounds and visual aesthetics.
Gameplay You’ll Love:
• Tap & Hold to charge your jump
• Drag to aim your landing
• Release to hop on the next tile, stay in rhythm to score high!
• Miss a beat and your ball will fall, but the music never stops!
Your goal is simple: stay on the tiles, follow the rhythm, and feel the music flow through every move.
Puzzle Mode:
+ A compact 2D puzzle-platformer built around the same shared-damage rule.
+ Move, dash, and wall-jump through handcrafted levels where every robot and trap is a risk decision.
+ Attacking clears your path but costs your own health; sometimes “saving” another robot is the move, sometimes it loses you the level.
Why You’ll Love Music Hop:
+ A mix of music, rhythm, and skill that feels instantly rewarding
+ Constantly updated with new trending songs and special events
+ Designed for quick, satisfying play sessions 
+ Stunning themes, effects
Become the Rhythm Master! Every jump you make keeps the beat alive. Whether you’re relaxing with calm piano or getting hyped with EDM, Music Hop: Rhythm & Ball Game makes rhythm come alive right under your fingertips.
So put on your headphones, tap to the rhythm, and jump into the music today in Music Hop: Rhythm & Ball Game

YoYa World is a super fun dollhouse app! Here
bluejetty:00131481:ios.description:
Welcome to YoYa: busy life world! Here you can explore fantastic real world locations, interact with massive items and build unique stories with your digital characters!
INTRODUCING YoYa WORLD
YoYa World is a super fun dollhouse app! Here you can dress up your characters, put them in cute costumes and accessories ~ you can also create your story! Doing styling, dressing, sleeping, eating, and playing is not a problem in YoYa's world!
YoYa encourages all besties to explore the world of YoYa in their own way. Tap or drag characters and props in different places, and you may be able to harvest different kinds of surprises! The unique aesthetic design can help you inspire inspiration and create your own story. Unlocking the world scene, you will have the opportunity to visit various locations in YoYa World~ In the city center, suburbs, ports and islands, you will have a variety of novel experiences!
EXPLORING ALL DIFFERENT LOCATIONS
My Home: Do you remember playing dollhouse game pretending as parents and taking care of toddlers? At my home, you can design your family members, arrange them with various daily activities: cook dinners, play with sisters, take showers for bedtime stories and so much more!
Shopping Mall: 3 Floors of shopping mall where you can do grocery shopping, visit pet store, play video arcade and go to movies! You can shop everything you need for daily uses or for travelling!
Hair Salon: Ready for a big make over? Go visit the hair shop to pick yourself up a colorful hair dye! Cut, curl, trim, and choose hair accessories you like!
Beauty Shop: How does a face transformation sound like? Here you can make up with your own style by using face transformation machines. Don’t forget to enjoy afternoon tea time with cupcakes and more!
Fashion Store: Style yourself boldly! Dress up, mix each separate clothing and accessories as you like! Fancy dresses and accessories for different occasions are awaits. A variety of new products added regularly！
Hospital: Experience the thrill of a busy medical center at YoYa Hospital! Welcome the newborn baby to this world, treat the patient, and perform an intense operation! 
Central Park: Find more new friends in Central Park! At the character creation station, create your own character. You can choose from hundreds of styles of facial features, shapes and decorations!
YoYa: BUSY LIFE WORLD FEATURES
-Lots of customization options! Change clothes, hair styles and expressions!
-Experience exciting puzzles or DIY your own adventures
-Explore the Downtown, the Country, the Port, the Islands and many more locations
-Enjoy free gifts EVERYDAY
-Fully responsive items
-Aesthetic real world locations & Unique characters
-Play offline, no WiFi or data required.
FREE GIFTS EVERY DAY
Miniatures, fidget toys, the latest fashion dress and festival gifts! Check back everyday and discover exclusive surprise gifts beyond your imagination！Download now for free！
Discover More Fun with YoYa: Busy Life World!
· Subscribe to our YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/c/YoYaBusyLifeWorld
· Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/yoya_busylifeworld

bluejetty:00143947:ios.name: Skins Farm - голда и скины
bluejetty:00143947:ios.summary:
We are excited to introduce Skins.Farm, an app designed to allow you to easily and quickly get gold. Our team developed this application with the aim of helping players enhance their gaming inventory without the need to spend real money.
T
bluejetty:00143947:ios.description:
We are excited to introduce Skins.Farm, an app designed to allow you to easily and quickly get gold. Our team developed this application with the aim of helping players enhance their gaming inventory without the need to spend real money.
To get gold, you simply need to complete various simple tasks and engaging mini-games available within the app.
Skins.Farm is a captivating mobile application for iOS users, offering free skins and savings on purchases by completing a variety of tasks and playing entertaining mini-games.
How can you get free gold?
We offer the following mini-games and tasks that you can complete to earn free gold:
• Daily Bonus - don't forget to collect daily gifts by visiting our app every day!
• "Quiz" Mini-Game - a fun test of your knowledge where you earn rewards for correct answers.
• "Reaction Training" Mini-Game - an exciting challenge that tests your gaming precision and reaction (also known as "aim training").
• Partner Tasks - a variety of tasks provided by our partners.
In Skins.Farm, the primary way to earn free gold is through partner tasks, known as "offers." The list of available tasks is constantly updated, and users are rewarded for their completion within 15 minutes, though in rare cases it may take up to 24 hours.
The referral program in Skins.Farm allows you to earn additional gold by inviting friends to the app. For each friend who starts playing the mini-games, you earn free gold.
Free Skins and Their Withdrawal
In our mobile app, you have access to over 600 items from the game, ranging from the most affordable to the rarest and most expensive skins, and we always keep up with new updates.
The choice is vast, and every user will find something suitable for themselves.
Withdrawing Skins
Accumulated enough gold in your Skins.Farm balance? It's time to withdraw gold!
To start the withdrawal, select the appropriate item from our store and press to withdraw it.
Follow the instructions for withdrawing the item in the mobile app.
How does the withdrawal to the game work?
Unfortunately, exchanges (trades) are not yet implemented in the game, and withdrawal is carried out through the in-game market.
For this, you need to list a cheap item on the Market at a price corresponding to its value in our mobile app.
Listed the item? You just need to wait a bit for the moderators to purchase your item at a favorable price, which typically takes from 15 to 30 minutes, and in rare cases up to 24 hours.
Skins.Farm provides users with a convenient and safe way to withdraw skins, making the game even more exciting and interesting.
Technical Support
Technical support is available for assistance with the use of the Skins Farm app, operating from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM.
We are always ready to help with any technical questions and resolve issues.
The Skins Farm app is not affiliated with or related to Standoff 2. All information in the app is provided for informational purposes only.
Conclusion
In conclusion, our Skins Farm app offers a unique opportunity for players to acquire skins without needing to spend real money. Thanks to a wide range of tasks and mini-games, as well as daily bonuses and partner programs, users have the chance to earn free gold and exchange it for in-game skins.

bluejetty:00142907:ios.name: MyRogers (Shaw)
bluejetty:00142907:ios.summary: Get the most out of your products and services with the MyRogers (Shaw) app. Whether you’re on the go or at home, you can manage every aspect of your account on your smartphone. From paying your bills to chatting with support, you can do it
bluejetty:00142907:ios.description:
Get the most out of your products and services with the MyRogers (Shaw) app. Whether you’re on the go or at home, you can manage every aspect of your account on your smartphone. From paying your bills to chatting with support, you can do it all with MyRogers (Shaw).
Restrictions
• The MyRogers (Shaw) app requires a valid Username.
• Two-step verification is required.
• Accessible only to residential accounts.
• Does not support My Shaw Direct accounts or My Shaw Business accounts at this time.
Features
Billing Made Simple
• Manage billing and payments for all your services in one place, including auto-payments and eBills.
• Pay your bill in app, and save payment details for future payments.
• Convenient and fast way to handle your bill; signing up for eBill is easy, or viewing your bill in app.
• Need a couple more days to make your payment? Now submit a payment extension request directly within the app.
Live-agent support chat
• The fastest way to connect with the support you need and chat with a real representative right in the app
Monitor your data usage
• Keep an eye on your data and your limits with an easy-to-read visual snapshot of your data usage.
TV Subscription Management
• Quickly access your channel list for your TV subscription and theme packs
• Manage the devices that can use the Rogers Xfinity App for on-the-go access to your TV subscription.
Access Voicemail for personal home phone
• Easily access voicemail messages left to your personal home phone through the app. You can listen to, archive and manage your voicemail messages on the go.
Support Library
• How do you program your remote? Tips on improving your WiFi network? Access a curated list of the most popular product and troubleshooting guides from our support community.
Notifications
• Receive chat notifications easily while multi-tasking between apps and change your billing preferences.
Functions
• Using your Network access permissions, the MyRogers (Shaw) app will:
• View connection information and see available Wi-Fi connections to enable the app to connect to the Wi-Fi network.
• Detect the network state, read the device status, detect running apps, view app history and identity to implement network preference.
Submitting a payment extension request, the MyRogers (Shaw)app will:
• Send you an email confirmation.

bluejetty:00131209:ios.name: Farm Jam: Animal Escape Game
bluejetty:00131209:ios.summary: Meet FARM JAM, a funny puzzle farm game and a brilliant mix of a farming simulator, traffic jam and an escape parking game. You’ve just bought a ticket for a farm animals sightseeing… Take your seats in the car, lads, we’re going to the Old
bluejetty:00131209:ios.description:
Meet FARM JAM, a funny puzzle farm game and a brilliant mix of a farming simulator, traffic jam and an escape parking game. You’ve just bought a ticket for a farm animals sightseeing… Take your seats in the car, lads, we’re going to the Old Fred's farmland.
FARM ADVENTURES
This farm is my life—I’ve lived here as long as I can remember. My parents got this klondike from their parents, and their parents got it from their parents... you get the idea, huh? This ranch has been mine for a long time. Some city bigwigs tried to buy it, but they couldn’t fool Old Fred! They laughed at me when I told them about strange things that happened in pigs animal farm...
‘CUTE’ FARM ANIMALS
You won't probably believe me, but I've seen some suspicious farm pig games and traffic escape... Tourists think these are just cute farm animals, but trust me — they’re not. That pig is up to something. His tricky games are just starting. Now the whole farm is a car jam! Cows in the way, chickens everywhere — like a crazy traffic run. Every level feels like a bus parking puzzle.
Think fast, solve smart — it’s more than just an escape game. Ready to join the chaos? 
SSH, KEEP THE NOISE DOWN
Hey, you! Don’t listen to old Fred — he has no clue about us. Yeah, I talk. Heard about the animal traffic jam on the farm? No? Well, it's like that traffic jam you got stuck in — too many animals, not enough space. You won’t leave us hanging, right? Good.
Don’t worry, we’ll do it just smoothly & easily: I have a plan for that. You’ll manage this country escape. No, put the phone aside – there's no need to make unnecessary calls. So here’s what’s waiting for you in FARM JAM.
SHOW TIME
You should send all animals to the right escape zone in the right sequence. Your main objective is to unblock and release all the animals from the farm’s paddock. Keep in mind that animals can move both backward and forward. FARM JAM will bring some intricate moments: all animals have different sizes. This prevents all the easy escape routes, so think carefully and don’t get caught by Fred. And remember, when the night is coming down, you should act faster. You need to free all the animals before dark to complete the country escape. Watch out for the obstacles. Electric fences, carts, hungry wolf, and old Fred are on the way to animal freedom. Think twice before the move.
FARM AREAS
The countryside is hiding loads of stories. It is hard to believe, but old Fred had quite a stormy youth. Ready to discover little reminders? Perfect! Open AREAS! Build up all corners of the farm and unveil the secrets. Complete the levels, earn stars, and create the best animal jam farm ever. Fred, his beloved Rose, and his faithful dog Bruno will lead you through the countryside journey. At the end of each area, there is an excellent surprise for you. Exciting, right?
BOOSTERS
HINT creates a couple in the stall when you get stuck. 
SHUFFLE mixes all animals and creates new moves.
CELL adds extra space in the stall.
REVIVE gives you another try on the level.
LAMP lights up the field on the levels with a timer.
TICKER adds more time to the levels with a timer.
FULL FARM FUN PACK
1. Peaceful countryside scenes of fields, farms, meadows, forests, and ranches await you.
2. Join the gang: humorous personalities in this casual farm game won’t just let you go – follow the rules, human, or else.
3. Form the queue: you should release those animals in a certain order. Otherwise, they’ll get stuck and fail the country escape.
4. Love is in the air on the farm. Match animals of the same color to make a pair.
5. Challenge yourself: evade the farmer and farmyard obstacles.
6. Farm Rush, Ace Race, Jungle Quest, Digging Madness, and other themed events to test your skills and earn rewards.
Ready to make the escape of the century? Let’s do that with FARM JAM.
Privacy Policy https://docs.appsyoulove.com/policies/privacy-policy
Terms of Use https://docs.appsyoulove.com/policies/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00023970:ios.description:
The official app from Spotify that helps creators grow, monetize, and manage their podcast or video show. The Spotify for Creators app (formerly known as Spotify for Podcasters) allows you to host and distribute your podcast for free, use powerful tools to reach and engage new audiences, get paid for your content, and stand out to over 600 million Spotify users. Spotify for Creators is where podcasters and video creators can make meaningful connections with fans and monetize their content. Hosted somewhere else? You can still use our mobile app to manage your show on the go.
Fans come to Spotify to discover new podcasts. Tap into this audience by using Spotify for Creators to upload your episodes, connect with your fans, and check out your Spotify podcast analytics. With Spotify for Creators, podcast and video creators can:
Grow your community and connect with loyal fans
- Like and reply to your favorite fan comments
- Get real-time feedback by creating polls on your episodes, and more
- Grow your podcast with detailed insights about your show and your audience, and understand where they discover your show through impression analytics
Track and manage your show
- Get notifications to keep up with your show's activity, including fan interactions, trending episodes, when you hit the charts and other key milestones
- Track the performance of your latest episode and get detailed audience insights
- Manage multiple shows in one place, and easily switch between all of your shows from one account
Customize your show on Spotify
- No matter what kind of podcast or video content you’re creating, you’ll get powerful tools to help your show stand out on Spotify and beyond
- Draft, manage, and publish content seamlessly, regardless of where you are hosted
- Customize how your show and episodes appear on Spotify
Get free hosting and RSS distribution
Host your podcast with Spotify for free
Manage your podcast RSS feed and ensure your podcast audio content is distributed to all major listening platforms
Monetize your content (available for creators hosting their content on Spotify for Creators in select markets)
For people wondering “how do you monetize a podcast?”, Spotify for Creators has flexible monetization options for audio and video creators, with subscriptions and the Spotify Partner Program (ads and premium video revenue)
Need help? We're here for you at https://support.spotify.com/us/creators/
You can also find us on…
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/spotifyforcreators/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/spotifyforcreators

In an age of artificial intelligence, Throw runs on human intelligence.

The questions AI can't — or shouldn't — answer. Answered by real people.

Throw a question to a community of real people, matched to you by experience — honest, anonymous, no judgment. The answers AI can't give, because it hasn't lived anything.

bluejetty:00016995:ios.description:
Loved by creative professionals and aspiring artists alike, Procreate is the leading creative application made for iPad.
Procreate has everything you need to create expressive sketches, rich paintings, gorgeous illustrations, and beautiful animations. Offering 100s of handmade brushes, a suite of industry-leading artistic tools, an advanced layer system, and the powerful Valkyrie graphics engine.
It’s a complete art studio you can take anywhere.
Highlights:
- High resolution canvases — up to 16k by 8k on compatible iPad Pros
- Beautifully intuitive interface made for iPad and Apple Pencil
- Revolutionary QuickShape feature for perfect shapes
- Smooth and responsive smudge sampling
- 3D Painting with Lighting Studio, exportable as models, images, or animations
- Powered by Valkyrie, the lightning-fast 64-bit painting engine
- Speed up your workflow with keyboard shortcuts
- Create art in stunning 64-bit color
- Continuous auto-save — never lose work again
Breakthrough brushes:
- Packed with hundreds of beautifully crafted brushes
- Organize your brushes into sets and libraries
- Add Metallic and Roughness for painting in 3D
- Brush Studio — with over 100 customizable settings
- Import and export custom Procreate brushes
- Import Adobe® Photoshop® brushes, and run them faster than Photoshop®
Full-featured layering system:
- Layer your art for precise control over details and composition
- Create Layer Masks and Clipping Masks for non-destructive editing
- Stay organized by combining layers into Groups
- Select multiple layers to move or Transform objects simultaneously
- Access over 25 layer blend modes for industry-grade compositing
Color without compromise:
- Fill your line work with ColorDrop and SwatchDrop
- Disc, Classic, Harmony, Value, and Palette color panels
- Import color profiles for color matching
- Assign Color Dynamics to any brush
Precision design tools:
- Add vector text to your illustrations
- Easily import all your favorite fonts
- Crop and resize your canvas for perfect composition
- Perspective, Isometric, 2D, and Symmetry visual guides
- Drawing Assist perfects your strokes in real time
- StreamLine and stabilization smooths strokes for beautiful calligraphy and expert inking
- Use Scribble to name layers, change settings, and create text
Accessibility features:
- Advanced stroke stabilization
- Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, and Feedback Sounds
- Assignable single-touch gestures
- Color naming
Animation and Page Assist
- Easy frame-by-frame animation with customizable onion skinning
- Create storyboards, GIFs, animatics, and simple animations
- Sketch page-by-page concepts or begin a comic with Page Assist
- Import, edit, and share PDFs
Dramatic finishing effects:
- Brush in image adjustments and effects with Apple Pencil
- Glitch, Chromatic Aberration, Bloom, Noise, and Halftone add new dimensions to your work
- Gaussian, Motion, and Perspective Blur filters create depth and movement
- Powerful image adjustments including Color Balance, Curves, HSB, and Gradient Map
- Bring your art to life with the fun, intuitive, and creative Warp, Symmetry, and Liquify Dynamics
Time-lapse replay
- Relive your creative journey with Procreate’s Time-lapse Replay
- Export your Time-lapse recording in 4K for high-quality video production
- Share a shorter 30-second Time-lapse on your socials
Import assets and share your creations:
- Import or export your art as Adobe® Photoshop® PSD files
- Import Adobe® ASE and ACO Color Palettes
- Import image files such as JPG, PNG, and TIFF
- Export your working files in layered .procreate or PSD file formats
- Share your art as TIFF, transparent PNG, multi-page PDF, web-ready JPEG, OBJ, USDZ, and animated GIFs, PNGs, and MP4s

listings.description:
Loved by creative professionals and aspiring artists alike, Procreate is the leading creative application made for iPad.

Procreate has everything you need to create expressive sketches, rich paintings, gorgeous illustrations, and beautiful animations. Offering 100s of handmade brushes, a suite of industry-leading artistic tools, an advanced layer system, and the powerful Valkyrie graphics engine.

It’s a complete art studio you can take anywhere.

Highlights:

- High resolution canvases — up to 16k by 8k on compatible iPad Pros
- Beautifully intuitive interface made for iPad and Apple Pencil
- Revolutionary QuickShape feature for perfect shapes
- Smooth and responsive smudge sampling
- 3D Painting with Lighting Studio, exportable as models, images, or animations
- Powered by Valkyrie, the lightning-fast 64-bit painting engine
- Speed up your workflow with keyboard shortcuts
- Create art in stunning 64-bit color
- Continuous auto-save — never lose work again

Breakthrough brushes:

- Packed with hundreds of beautifully crafted brushes
- Organize your brushes into sets and libraries
- Add Metallic and Roughness for painting in 3D
- Brush Studio — with over 100 customizable settings
- Import and export custom Procreate brushes
- Import Adobe® Photoshop® brushes, and run them faster than Photoshop®

Full-featured layering system:

- Layer your art for precise control over details and composition
- Create Layer Masks and Clipping Masks for non-destructive editing
- Stay organized by combining layers into Groups
- Select multiple layers to move or Transform objects simultaneously
- Access over 25 layer blend modes for industry-grade compositing

Color without compromise:

- Fill your line work with ColorDrop and SwatchDrop
- Disc, Classic, Harmony, Value, and Palette color panels
- Import color profiles for color matching
- Assign Color Dynamics to any brush

Precision design tools:

- Add vector text to your illustrations
- Easily import all your favorite fonts
- Crop and resize your canvas for perfect composition
- Perspective, Isometric, 2D, and Symmetry visual guides
- Drawing Assist perfects your strokes in real time
- StreamLine and stabilization smooths strokes for beautiful calligraphy and expert inking
- Use Scribble to name layers, change settings, and create text

Accessibility features:

- Advanced stroke stabilization
- Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, and Feedback Sounds
- Assignable single-touch gestures
- Color naming

Animation and Page Assist

- Easy frame-by-frame animation with customizable onion skinning
- Create storyboards, GIFs, animatics, and simple animations
- Sketch page-by-page concepts or begin a comic with Page Assist
- Import, edit, and share PDFs

Dramatic finishing effects:

- Brush in image adjustments and effects with Apple Pencil
- Glitch, Chromatic Aberration, Bloom, Noise, and Halftone add new dimensions to your work
- Gaussian, Motion, and Perspective Blur filters create depth and movement
- Powerful image adjustments including Color Balance, Curves, HSB, and Gradient Map
- Bring your art to life with the fun, intuitive, and creative Warp, Symmetry, and Liquify Dynamics

Time-lapse replay

- Relive your creative journey with Procreate’s Time-lapse Replay
- Export your Time-lapse recording in 4K for high-quality video production
- Share a shorter 30-second Time-lapse on your socials

Import assets and share your creations:

- Import or export your art as Adobe® Photoshop® PSD files
- Import Adobe® ASE and ACO Color Palettes
- Import image files such as JPG, PNG, and TIFF
- Export your working files in layered .procreate or PSD file formats
- Share your art as TIFF, transparent PNG, multi-page PDF, web-ready JPEG, OBJ, USDZ, and animated GIFs, PNGs, and MP4s

bluejetty:00044838:ios.name: NimNim Laundry & Dry Clean
bluejetty:00044838:ios.summary: NimNim is the premium, service-first laundry and dry-cleaning app built for busy city life. Schedule a pickup in seconds, choose pickup and delivery time windows that fit your day, and track your order from “Placed” to “Delivered” with real
bluejetty:00044838:ios.description:
NimNim is the premium, service-first laundry and dry-cleaning app built for busy city life. Schedule a pickup in seconds, choose pickup and delivery time windows that fit your day, and track your order from “Placed” to “Delivered” with real-time updates. Our signature advantage: Wash & Fold returned in 24 hours at no extra fee—delivered folded, sorted, and drawer-ready, with no last steps. Every order is designed around care and convenience, with clear communication, quality checks, and a concierge-style experience that keeps your wardrobe looking its best.
Customize every detail right in the app: add special notes and photos for dry cleaning, set laundered shirt preferences like starch and boxed vs. hanger returns, and personalize Wash & Fold settings (scented vs. unscented detergent, warm vs. cold wash, dry level, bleach and softener options). Beyond everyday laundry, NimNim handles more of your life in one place—household items like sheets, comforters, pillows, and duvets with transparent per-piece pricing, plus tailoring and alterations (hems, tapers, zipper replacements and more) and shoe care & repair, including sneaker cleaning and designer shoe services. Checkout is simple and transparent: review your cart, update details, apply coupons, and use wallet points before confirming.
NimNim currently offers pickup and delivery across select areas in Boston, NYC/Brooklyn, and Miami, with expanding coverage. Download NimNim and experience what laundry should feel like: fast, effortless, and genuinely service-driven—every single time.
HOW TO USE NIMNIM:
Open the app and choose the service you need (Laundry, Dry Cleaning, Shoe Repair, Alterations, and more)
Choose your pick-up and drop-off preferences and turnaround time
Place your order
Track your order’s progress via the app and get notified when it’s been picked up...and when it’s being delivered!
WHY USE NIMNIM?
*CONVENIENCE*
Pick up and drop off 7 days a week, at a time that suits your busy schedule best. With easy turnaround times as fast as 12 or 24 hrs.
*PROFESSIONAL*
All services provided via NimNim are carried out by professional local service providers with our white-glove service satisfaction guarantee.
*SIMPLE*
Just pick the service you need and place your order. That’s all there is to it!
*LOCAL*
All services provided via the NimNim app are local to you. Meaning when you order through NimNim, you’re also supporting local small business owners (who you might never know existed).
USE NIMNIM TO:
- Order laundry, dry cleaning, shoe repair, alterations and more
- Choose same-day delivery (12hr), day after delivery (24hr), or pick a time at your convenience, 7 days a week
- Door-to-door pick-up and drop-off, or leave in a foyer or lobby
- White-glove concierge service standards
- Swift and professional local service providers
- 100% satisfaction guarantee
ABOUT NIMNIM
Founded in 2010 by two brothers in Boston, NimNim was born out of the desire to unite local service businesses with the busy professionals, families, and businesses who struggled to find them.
Now, the NimNim app lets Boston locals order the lifestyle and concierge services they need to make their own busy lives run smoother… with the modern-day, instant convenience of door-to-door pick up and delivery. All at market-competitive prices.
Originally starting as a laundering and dry cleaning service, NimNim’s service network now combines tailors, cobblers, specialist cleaners, and more.
Download the app today to view the full services listing!

bluejetty:00023089:ios.description:
Passapp is the leading taxi-hiring service in Cambodia.
PassApp is a taxi booking service based in Phnom Penh, Cambodia. The application allows to book a cab, tuktuk, rickshaw with taximeter anytime we go for a flight to the airport or if we are running late for day job, or getting home late at night.. You are guaranteed to get there safely and always in time.
We provide transportation in Phnom Penh at affordable prices only. PassApp intends to work with professional local drivers, adhering to the highest industry standards. That is what makes us proud to be a leading cab service in Cambodia.
Hire taxi and get ride in Cambodia
PassApp is available 24/7. Our cab drivers use modern precise meter. Using the app you can hire:
TukTuk
Rickshaw
Cab
SUV
All you need to do is to pick your destination, choose a delivery point and submit payments after the trip is done. As simple as that! Using our service will help you book a taxi in a matter of seconds and get a fast go to any destination of your choice.
Book taxi easily
To use PassApp, you should have an active mobile phone number at hand. When your account is approved, you can mark your pick-up location and choose service type. Once you have done a booking, the app will let you know when taxi driver arrives. After the payment is done, you will get the invoice with your trip details automatically sent to your inbox.
PassApp rates
We provide local taxi service at low prices. All tuktuk, rickshaw and cabs are owned by professional drivers who provide taxi service independently.
Additional services
- Got a planned trip and need to go fast to the airport to be in time for your flight? No worries! With advanced booking feature, you can pre-order taxi to arrive there at any time.
- Rest assured you will always have access to fair estimates of your arrival time each time you grab a taxi. Our taximeter cab and tuk tuk in Phnom Penh are always at your disposal.
- Rate your drivers helping us improve the quality and comfort of passengers rides.
- Monitor the progress of your car on local map: from pickup location to delivery point.
- Leaving notes to drivers before your taxi ride. This is especially convenient if you order a car for someone else or travel with pet wanting to warn your driver about it in advance.
Technology
We go hand in hand with technology. That’s why PassApp Cambodia always uses up-to-date software to improve your lifestyle. Our 24/7 pass app allows to grab a ride anywhere fast and easily.
Follow us
Email passapptaxis@gmail.com
Hotline: 086 515121 or 017515121
Facebook: https://web.facebook.com/passapptaxis/
Contact us
Please do not hesitate to contact us, if you have any questions or concerns about our service. We are always glad to help and we are excited to hear what you have to say about us. This will help us dramatically to enhance our Passapp and bring it to the next level.
We go above and beyond in delivering excellent taxi service for all our clients. Being a leader on Cambodian market, PassApp taxi has surpassed its competition and become the leading Tuktuk & Rickshaw Booking App. So grab your chance to experience joy and comfort of everyday taxi trips with our best-in-class application.
