bluejetty:00074101:ios.description:
EasyQuit - Stop Smoking App helps you quit your smoking habit for good.
It has a quit smoking slowly mode that works flawlessly, scientific health statistics, money saved by quitting smoking, personal diary, motivational badges and many more features.
---- Motivational Health Section ----
- Countdown timer to watch all aspects of your health improve as a result of your great decision to stop this bad habit of smoking.
---- Stop Smoking Slowly Mode ----
- You cant quit smoking now because the nicotine dependance is too strong? no problem!
Our EasyQuit Stop Smoking app has an entire "Slow Mode" to help you quit the habit of smoking.
Our app will create a customised quitting plan for you that works flawlessly and make you smoke free with no pain or stress.
---- Money Statistics ----
- Watch your pockets grow and see how much money you saved by not smoking any cigarettes.
- Set a nice treat for yourself let the app help you see how long until you reach it. This will motivate you and help you stay smoke free.
---- Cravings & Trigger Statistics ----
- Pie Chart showing you the breakdown of your top triggers to help you eliminate your cravings fasters (Pro Version).
---- Memory Game ----
- Have an urge to smoke a cigarette? Let EasyQuit help you by providing a cool game of Memory with beautiful icons to pass the scientifically proven 3 minute mark & beat your urge to smoke a cigarette.
---- Badges ----
- Earn up to 62 different badges as rewards and use them as a motivational tool. They can also help you stay strong against the nicotine addiction if you share your progress with your friends through the screenshot option provided by EasyQuit.
---- Themes ----
- Personalize EasyQuit by choosing any of the 28 beautiful themes provided.
---- Amazing Widgets ----
- Our quit smoking app offers you two widgets full of statistic, showing your current progress of quitting smoking.
The widgets show the time you have been smoke free, the money you saved by quitting, total progress of the scientific health statistics, the personal treat progress and the cigarettes passed since you quit smoking (pro version).
---- High Level of Privacy ----
- No log in, no collection or selling of your sensitive data like email, password or contacts. Your data is saved locally on your phone.
---- Relapse Assistant ----
- Let the app help you decide your next step after a relapse by recommending a certain action based on your previous quitting data (Pro Version).
--- Diary ---
- Add your thoughts and moods daily to keep a clear head and remain strong during this journey (Pro Version).
---- Modern Design ----
- Modern & original design consistent with the modern design guidelines.
I hope my quit smoking app helps you become a non smoker forever and free you of this bad habit. So don't wait, quit now or use stop smoking slowly mode and let EasyQuit help you become a healthier and happier person :)

bluejetty:00125971:ios.description:
Get Stopmo Studio, the world’s easiest app to get you into stop motion moviemaking today!
All you need is an iPhone or iPad, a tripod, the right software, and a bit of creativity
With it’s easy to use interface Stopmo Studio lets you create beautiful movies like Wallace and Gromit or those groovy Lego shorts on YouTube.
It's simple to use, deceptively powerful and insanely fun to play with.
Stop Motion Studio is a powerful, full-featured stopmotion editor with a whole host of features:
• A simplistic, easy-to-use interface
• Overlay mode showing the differences between frames
• Animation guides to position animated objects more easily
• Copy, paste, cut, and insert frames at any position
• Interactive timeline so you never get lost, even if you have hundreds of frames
• Auto-save, so that you never lose your work
• Remote Bluetooth functionality so that you can capture frames without touching the screen
• Full camera control with automatic or manual white balance, focus and exposure and expert mode
**Share with friends and family:
• Save to your photo library or share to YouTube .
• Save all images for further processing.
**Learn to animate
• Watch the included tutorial videos.
• Read the comprehensive manual.
• Use the animation tips and tricks provided.
LIST OF FEATURES:
- Shoot using Expert Mode with simple gestures
- Simple camera settings for fast shooting

bluejetty:00145888:ios.description:
No diets, no transformation pictures and no counting calories ~ meet Nobs App, by online personal trainer Lucy Mountain.
Lucy was bored of humans being made to feel like they need to follow restrictive meal plans and unsustainable workout plans in order to be doing ‘fitness’.
So she called bs on it ~ and took it basics. Nobs App was born. Join the family.
Workouts you'll actually enjoy:
Science-based 12 week programs designed to build strength, muscle tone and confidence.
Whether you’re new to the gym or have been around the block/squat rack - or prefer to train at home with dumbbells or just a backpack, we got you.
Oh, and there’s no burpees.
Gym Machine Tutorials:
Gym anxiety isn't simply resolved by knowing what to do in the gym, it's knowing how to do it. Our database of 10 videos teach you how to use gym machines and equipment.
Videos include how to set up a squat rack, how to set up for the hip thrust, using a cable machine, adjusting a gym bench plus much more.
Recipes, not meal plans:
Calorie counting is a tool but it’s not for everyone. Instead, our nobs-chef has whipped up a batch of easy, no fuss recipes for your body and soul.
With over 150+ creations, bookmark your faves to save for later. With options for vegans, pesci and meaty nobs.
Daily pep-talks:
Personalised affirmations without the cringe to help you stop being such a d*ck to yourself.
Health is not just physical, mental health matters. Over time by practising your pep-talks, your internal self critic will suddenly become less mouthy.
Graduate and unlock levels
New levels for you to unlock - no 12-week transformations here, your body is not a 'before' or 'after'.
Create and maintain a weekly routine that you LUV by completing all workouts from a core guide and leveling up!
Subscription
Nobs is free to download and offers the following subscriptions plans to access all the features and content above:
- Monthly £11.99
- Quarterly £31.99
- Yearly £119.99
Your subscription will work across your devices and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in Account Settings within iTunes after purchase. Once purchased, no refunds will be provided for any unused portion of the term.
Terms and Conditions - https://nobsapp.co.uk/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00032986:ios.summary:
在山水画卷中享受明朝水乡日常。
椰岛游戏匠心制作古风模拟经营游戏《江南百景图》，带你重回大明，建造自己的水乡桃源，享受晴耕雨读的闲暇时光。
你将成为城市的设计师，描绘蓝图、兴造建筑、规划布局，经营赚钱。同时安排居民起居工作，写意世间百态，或者带领大家奇遇探险……
这里，就是你的世外桃源、绿野仙踪。
【画中故事】
昔时，吴中才子文徵明偶然在古董摊觅得一卷残画，以为是前朝遗作，遂带回家修补。却发现此画既无起点，也无终点，大明江南风景尽可绘入其间，并且画人人活，画物物生。
bluejetty:00032986:ios.description:
在山水画卷中享受明朝水乡日常。
椰岛游戏匠心制作古风模拟经营游戏《江南百景图》，带你重回大明，建造自己的水乡桃源，享受晴耕雨读的闲暇时光。
你将成为城市的设计师，描绘蓝图、兴造建筑、规划布局，经营赚钱。同时安排居民起居工作，写意世间百态，或者带领大家奇遇探险……
这里，就是你的世外桃源、绿野仙踪。
【画中故事】
昔时，吴中才子文徵明偶然在古董摊觅得一卷残画，以为是前朝遗作，遂带回家修补。却发现此画既无起点，也无终点，大明江南风景尽可绘入其间，并且画人人活，画物物生。
于是方知此画乃女娲遗物。是以余生数十年，醉心图卷创作，并命名为《江南百景图》。至其灯尽人枯，尚未能绘制江南全貌及历史人物全图。
文徵明意识到所剩时日不多，便命吴门画生妥善保管此画，自己则化作画灵守护图卷世界。
从此，图卷便成为吴门秘宝，百位大家竞绘画其上，添得万水千山，画得生灵百种。
然万历年间，礼部尚书董其昌利用自己的影响力，强行夺走此画，并藏于书楼。万历四十四年，民抄董宦，一把大火将董家珍藏连同雕梁画栋付之一炬……
画灵文徵明被滚烫的浓烟惊醒，见绘卷中城市烈火熊熊，久久不能熄灭。大火持续了三日三夜，烧得卷中城镇一片灰烬。
望着满目疮痍的应天府废墟，衡山居士文徵明再次提起手中紫毫，邀请你一起一砖一瓦、一笔一画，重绘江南昔日繁华。
【游戏特色】
--明朝江南复刻
你看见的，就是明朝。

bluejetty:00126007:ios.description:
Alhamdulillah
Experience the complete Qur’an recitation of the renowned Egyptian reciter Sheikh Abdul Basit Abdul Samad (رحمه الله), combined with essential Islamic tools designed to support your daily worship and help you stay connected to the Qur’an wherever you are.
Audio Features
• Full Qur’an Recitation — Listen to the complete Qur’an in the distinctive and beautiful voice of Sheikh Abdul Basit Abdul Samad.
• Offline & Online Listening — Listen to downloaded surahs offline or stream the Qur’an online in high quality whenever you have an internet connection.
• Flexible Downloads — Download only the surahs you want to keep available offline. Remove downloaded surahs whenever you need to free up storage space.
Islamic Tools
• Prayer Times — Get accurate prayer times based on your location, with adhan notifications to help you stay consistent with your daily prayers.
• Adhkar — Access morning, evening, and daily adhkar to help you remember Allah throughout your day.
Optimized for a Better Experience
• Lightweight App — A smaller, faster app designed to minimize storage usage while keeping the Qur’an easily accessible.
• Smooth Navigation — Move easily between surahs, browse the Qur’an, and manage your listening experience with a clean and simple interface.
• High-Quality Audio — Enjoy clear Qur’an recitation while having the flexibility to choose between streaming and offline listening.
• Ads Supported — The app is supported by advertisements, with an option available to remove ads for a more comfortable experience.
Why This Version?
Earlier versions of the app could require more than 2GB of storage when the complete Qur’an audio was downloaded. This version has been optimized to give you much greater flexibility while keeping the app lightweight.
You can now:
• Listen online without downloading the entire Qur’an
• Download only the surahs you need
• Listen offline whenever you want
• Remove downloaded audio at any time
• Save valuable storage space on your device
• Enjoy prayer times, adhan notifications, and adhkar in the same app
Whether you are listening to the Qur’an, memorizing its verses, reflecting upon its meanings, or simply looking for a peaceful recitation during your day, this app makes the recitation of Sheikh Abdul Basit Abdul Samad easily accessible wherever you go.
May Allah have mercy upon Sheikh Abdul Basit Abdul Samad, accept his efforts in serving the Qur’an, and make the Qur’an a source of guidance, peace, and blessing for us all.
Privacy Policy: https://www.ahmadnakore.com/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00070906:ios.name: Adventure Games: for Kids
bluejetty:00070906:ios.summary: Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading,
bluejetty:00070906:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
Enter a fairy land rich in adventures! The game encourages kids to explore a play-world inhabited by cute creatures and discover tons of activities and videos hidden behind every corner. Kids can build curious objects, dance or swim with friends and end the day celebrating in front of a bonfire. All this while letting their imagination run free.
Game features:
- Build lamps, flowers or musical instruments
- Endless activities: farm your greens, cook or set up a concert
- Animated educational tasks
- Learn how to trace letters or numbers
- Explore fun videos
- Safe game without ads
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

Have questions, suggestions, or just want to say hello? We'd love to hear from you! Connect with us on social media or drop us a line at help@tix.id

We're excited that Easter is just around the corner and we're sure that you are too. Get in the mood for Easter with this wonderful match 3 game! Play over hundreds of addictive levels with many challenges. You will experience the adventure with Easter Swap in Kingdoms of colorful eggs, cute rabbits, iron lily flowers, chocolates and other cute Easter elements. Swap these cute elements to clear your way and dig into your own Easter adventures. 
Easter Swap MAIN FEATURES:
●Create Crazy BOMBS by matching four or more elements and blast the Easter Garden!

●Match elements and collect all kinds of elements to win the level before you run out of moves.

*Flower – Feed the flower pot with Easter elements to bloom the fragrant flowers and smell the springs air.
Wish you a Happy Easter! And Easter Swap will keep you engaged until long after Easter!
Download the Easter Swap now and enjoy your beautiful and amazing Easter adventure!

bluejetty:00160122:ios.summary:
Double Deck Pinochle card game classic • Solo and Multiplayer • Smart bots • Thousands of people to play with • Play online with friends • Interactive tutorial • Free and no signup required!
Play Double Deck Pincochle to your heart's conte
bluejetty:00160122:ios.description:
Double Deck Pinochle card game classic • Solo and Multiplayer • Smart bots • Thousands of people to play with • Play online with friends • Interactive tutorial • Free and no signup required!
Play Double Deck Pincochle to your heart's content with the official Double Deck Pincochle card game app from World of Card Games. Pair up with people by joining one of our tables, play by yourself against our bots, or create a private table and invite your friends and family to play. Our game is free to play and no signup is required.
Double Deck Pinochle is a 4-player game where the players are split into 2 teams of 2 players. The goal of the game is to reach 500 points first. Points are earned through melding and trick-taking. Kings, Aces and 10s are each worth 1 point in a trick, and the last trick has a bonus of 2 points. Each team must score no less than 20 points in both melds and tricks to avoid penalties.
At the start of the game, each player is dealt 20 cards, and the trump suit is determined by having each player bid. The highest bidder chooses the trump suit and must have a marriage (King and Queen) in that particular suit. Tricks are played in clockwise order, with players needing to play higher-ranking cards if possible.
We're always open to suggestions, so feel free to reach out to us at https://worldofcardgames.com/double-deck-pinochle with suggestions for improvements.
=== FEATURES:
=== Play against the computer using our bots
If you're new to a game, playing against others can feel intimidating. We always suggest playing against the computer before playing against other people. Our intelligent bots should be challenging enough, even for experienced players.
=== Play against other people online
We have a great community of card players. People are generally really nice to each other, and you can always find an open table to join. Just click List of Tables to find a table to your liking.
=== Play against friends or family at a private table
Meeting fellow card game enthusiasts online is nice, but nothing beats a game against friends or family. Start a private table and let your friends know about the table name to get them to join.
=== Ranked games and global leaderboards
If you're serious about your card games or have a competitive streak, ranked games are for you. These games are reserved for more series players and will only be accessible to you once you've signed up and played 10 games. Ranked players have a chance to end up on the daily leaderboard.
=== Custom design and avatars
Change the background and card design to something that suits you better. With 160+ different avatars, you're sure to be able to find one to your liking.
=== Join ongoing games and chat with other players
Click List of Tables to join an ongoing game. There are always live players at the site, so you're sure to find someone to play with. You can even chat with other players once you've joined a game, but remember to be friendly!
=== Detailed statistics and hand histories
Sign up to the site to be able to see detailed statistics. You can even save your hand history so you have a chance to analyze them later on!

bluejetty:00069027:ios.description:
Word Mind is a modern and engaging puzzle game. Play every day to sharpen your mind and improve your vocabulary.
Immerse yourself in this beautiful and addictive brain teaser to relax and unwind.
Can you think outside the box and find the hidden answer? This is a simple yet challenging daily exercise that will keep you coming back!
If you enjoy logic puzzles, spelling challenges, or anagrams, you will love this experience. Word Mind requires you to deduce the correct letters and spell your way to victory. Challenge yourself today!
HOW TO PLAY
• Type your guess and check the letters.
• You have 6 tries to find the correct answer.
• Every color will show how close you were.
• Green means the letter is in the correct spot.
• Yellow means the letter is in the puzzle, but in the wrong spot.
• Enjoy fun and addictive daily challenges.
FEATURES
• Easy to pick up and play.
• Daily brain teasers!
• Track and share your results with friends!
• Great exercise for your vocabulary and spelling.
• NO WIFI? NO PROBLEM! Play offline anywhere.
• 100% FREE to play!
• Play in your own language.

bluejetty:00045626:ios.name: HomeSense for HomeKit
bluejetty:00045626:ios.summary: HomeSense turns your iPhone or iPad into a command center for your automated home. HomeSense supports Caséta Wireless, Lutron RadioRA 2, Lutron RadioRA 3, Lutron HomeWorks QS, Philips Hue Personal Wireless Lighting, Sonos speakers, Honeywel
bluejetty:00045626:ios.description:
HomeSense turns your iPhone or iPad into a command center for your automated home. HomeSense supports Caséta Wireless, Lutron RadioRA 2, Lutron RadioRA 3, Lutron HomeWorks QS, Philips Hue Personal Wireless Lighting, Sonos speakers, Honeywell Lyric Thermostat and HomeKit, providing seamless integration between these systems. See the state of your connected devices, rooms, and convenient summary of your whole home, and control lights, fans, shades, thermostats, edit schedule and more. With Notification Center widget, favorites, home and room scenes, HomeSense is flexible, convenient and easy to use.
HomeSense for HomeKit supports the following types of HomeKit accessories: outlets, switches, lights, fans, shades, blinds, thermostats, door locks, garage door openers, faucets, cameras, and sensors. Control and editing for other systems is available via main HomeSense app or separate purchase.
Common Features
- See and control lights, ceiling fans, shades, blinds and thermostats from the application.
- Home overview shows the state of every room and makes it easy to see what rooms have lights or fans on.
- Add often used controls or scenes to the Favorites. Any light, fan, shade, or even individual keypad button can be added to Favorites to appear on a separate screen. Tap to toggle, or tap and hold to open the detail view.
- Create your own home and room scenes that can combine devices from different systems.
- Turn off all lights and fans in a room with a single gesture - just choose “All Off” action on the room.
- Set up additional actions for a room to be recalled quickly from actions menu.
- Organize your home: manage rooms, rename controls and keypad buttons, hide unwanted devices.
- Today widget lets you access selected controls or scenes without launching the app.
- Change switch type - choose if switch controls an outlet, light or fan.
- Adjust device defaults - set default brightness, fade-in and fade-out time for dimmers, set default speed for fans.
- iCloud sync keeps your home configuration up-to-date on all of your devices.
Caséta Wireless Features
- View and edit Pico button programming and scheduled events.
Lutron RadioRA 2 and HomeWorks QS Features
- View and edit keypad button programming, scheduled events and thermostat schedules.
- Change schedule and energy saving (“Green”) mode.
Philips Hue Features
- View and edit scheduled events, including events relative to sunrise or sunset.
HomeKit Features
- Supported devices include outlets, switches, lights, fans, shades, blinds, thermostats, door locks, garage door openers, faucets, and sensors.
- Scheduled events support both weekly events, as well as time triggers with repeat intervals, from 5 minutes up to one month.
Sonos Features
- Play, pause, and control volume.
- Select a playlist or a station to play from your Sonos favorites.
- Group speakers to play music to more than one rooms.
Requirements
- For Caséta Wireless, Smart Bridge or Smart Bridge Pro connected to home WiFi network.
- For Lutron, professionally installed system connected to home WiFi network.
- For Philips Hue, Philips Hue lights with bridge connected to home WiFi network.
- For Lyric, Lyric Round Wi-Fi Thermostat, Lyric T5 or Lyric T6 Pro Wi-Fi Thermostat with working Internet connection.
Trademarks
Lutron, HomeWorks, RadioRA are trademarks of Lutron Electronics Co., Inc registered in the US and other countries.
Caséta, RadioRA 2, RadioRA 3, GRAFIK RA are trademarks of Lutron Electronics Co., Inc.
Lyric, Lyric Round are trademarks of Honeywell International Inc.
PHILIPS is a registered trademark of Koninklijke Philips N.V.
Sonos and Sonos product names are either trademarks or registered trademarks of Sonos, Inc.

bluejetty:00103144:android.summary:
Multi-LanguageLaban Dictionary: English Vietnamese, French Vietnamese, Japanese Vietnamese, Technical dictionary, Bussiness dictionary. Offline, Free, audio Pronunciation
Laban Dictionary is an offline, ads-free English Vietnamese, Vietnam
bluejetty:00103144:android.description:
Multi-LanguageLaban Dictionary: English Vietnamese, French Vietnamese, Japanese Vietnamese, Technical dictionary, Bussiness dictionary. Offline, Free, audio Pronunciation
Laban Dictionary is an offline, ads-free English Vietnamese, Vietnamese English, English English dictionary program, with clean and very easy to use UI. The program supports look up by speaking (English and Vietnamese speech to text, powered by Google Voice Input).
Laban Dictionary is a very helpful tool for learning English, especially for students preparing for TOEFL, TOEIC, and IELTS examinations.
The English Vietnamese Dictionary is licensed from the Vietnam Institute of Linguistics. This large, famous dictionary by prof. Le Kha Ke was awarded National Prize in science study in 2005. The dictionary has more than 300,000 words, phrases, and meanings, together with more than 120,000 examples.
The Vietnamese English dictionary has more than 35,000 most-frequently used words and phrases.
Key features:
- Dictionary store: Multi Language (English, French, Japanese), Business and Technical.
- English Vietnamese dictionary has more than 300,000 words and phrases, including pronunciation audio.
- Vietnamese English dictionary has more than 35,000 word entries.
- English English dictionary with more than 300,000 word entries can be downloaded on demand.
- Approximate look-up.
- Easy to use tab UI, which allows you to quickly swipe between sections, and look up word in just one tap.
- History tab lists words recently looked up.
- Favourite tab lists your favourite words.
- Cross look-up by taping and holding a word in word entry.
- Supports word look-up from other programs (e.g. browsers), through "Share Text" feature.
- Irregular verb table.
- Allows you to share word entry to your Facebook, Google Plus friends.
Note on Android permissions:
Laban Dictionary needs permissions to read from and write to external storage to download some additional dictionaries on demand, to save users' history of looked-up words and to save favorite words.

Let's ride.

Play Italian Pinochle ! 
A popular italian card game having something in common with Rummies and Burraco.
- Two teams with two player each, you and your team-mate will have to make more points than your adversaries.
- The game play is divided in two sides, in one your team melds, in the other your opponents melds. 
- You can play only in your side and eventually take jokers from your adversaries melds. 
- A special kind of joker named Pinella (2 of clubs and spades) can be placed and taken from your melds only by you and your team-mate
- A special discard pile letting you to take from any cards to the top of it
The free version is full featured but with advertisements, by purchasing the full version you will turn off ads.

- offline and online games
- detailed helps 
- great support for your questions and suggestions
- and more, enjoy!!! 
---------------------------------------------------------------
For your suggestions feel free to contact technical support, we will glad to help you 
If you'll enjoy using 'Italian Pinochle' please take a minute to leave a nice review: it really helps

bluejetty:00115355:ios.description:
Banter — AI Language Partners That Remember Your Journey
Learn to speak English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Chinese (Mandarin), Korean, or Italian through real conversations that build over time.
Join tens of thousands of language learners using Banter to practice speaking with an AI conversation partner who actually remembers you — your interests, your goals, and your progress.
No scripted lessons. No resets. Just real speaking practice that evolves with every conversation.
Start Speaking From Day 1
With Banter, you don't study a language — you speak it.
- Talk about your day in your target language
- Practice real-life scenarios: travel, work, casual conversation
- Switch topics naturally mid-conversation
- Build speaking confidence without fear of judgment
The AI Language Partner That Actually Remembers You
What makes Banter different from other language learning apps? Memory.
Your AI conversation partner remembers:
- Every conversation you've had together
- Words and phrases you struggle with
- Your interests, goals, and preferred learning style
- Topics you want to explore
When you mention your upcoming trip to Seoul, they'll ask how it went when you return. Every conversation becomes more personal, more engaging, and more effective at building fluency.
Multiple AI Partners — Different Personalities, Same Language
Choose from AI conversation partners with unique personalities, backstories, and communication styles.
Practice casual small talk with a friendly local. Debate current events with a curious intellectual. Get travel tips from a globetrotter. Work on business language with a professional mentor.
Available in 8 Languages:
English • Spanish • French • German • Japanese • Chinese (Mandarin) • Korean • Italian
Smart Feedback That Doesn't Interrupt Your Flow
Speak freely and naturally. Get personalized help exactly when you need it.
- Ask "How would a native say this?" during any conversation
- Get gentle corrections with natural alternatives
- Tap any message for native pronunciation
- Learn vocabulary and grammar in context, not isolation
- Receive detailed feedback on fluency, grammar, vocab, and engagement
Build Real-World Fluency Through Conversation
Banter helps you develop the skills you actually need to speak confidently:
- Overcome speaking anxiety and think less, speak more
- Practice anytime, anywhere — no scheduling tutors
- Learn phrases you'll actually use in real life
- Improve pronunciation, grammar, and fluency naturally 
- Build lasting confidence for travel, work, and daily conversation
- Progress at your own pace, from beginner to advanced
Whether you're preparing for a trip abroad, advancing your career, connecting with family, or pursuing language mastery — Banter gives you unlimited speaking practice with an AI that grows with you.
How Banter Works:
STEP 1: Choose your AI conversation partner and language
STEP 2: Start talking about anything — your day, your interests, real-life scenarios
STEP 3: Get instant feedback and corrections when you want them
STEP 4: Watch your AI partner remember your journey and conversations deepen over time

bluejetty:00071768:ios.description:
Every parent knows the feeling — lying awake at night, wondering if your baby is okay.
Babysense was built to answer that question before you even have to ask it.
Connect your Babysense smart devices and manage everything from one calm, clear dashboard.
— BABYSENSE TOUCH — SMART BABY CAMERA —
Our flagship baby camera — built for parents who want to see, hear, and soothe their baby from anywhere.
- Crystal-clear live video streaming to your phone or dedicated touchscreen parent monitor
- Cry, sound, and movement detection with instant alerts
- Built-in lullabies and soothing sounds, played directly from the camera
- Soft night light — no separate device needed
- Picture-in-Picture (PiP) to monitor while using your phone normally
- Scan Mode — automatically cycles between multiple cameras
- Remote pan, tilt, and zoom control
— BABYSENSE CONNECT — MOTION & SLEEP MONITOR —
Under-the-mattress sensor. Nothing worn by your baby. Ever.
- Continuously monitors your baby's breathing movement throughout the night
- Immediate alarm if unusual movement patterns are detected
- Live motion graph and real-time movement data
- Full sleep tracker history — daily, weekly, and monthly summaries
- Tracks total sleep time, time in crib, and awake periods automatically
- Non-contact monitoring — nothing attached to your newborn or infant
— BABYSENSE DREAMER — SLEEP SOUNDS & NIGHT LIGHT —
Build the perfect sleep environment — quietly, from the other room.
- White noise, lullabies, and calming sleep sounds
- Adjustable night light with full color control
- Custom Ambience combinations: sound + light + volume in one setting
- Schedules and timers to automate your baby's sleep routine
- Child lock to prevent accidental changes
— WHY PARENTS CHOOSE BABYSENSE —
Designed to alert only when it truly matters
Baby camera, motion monitor, and sleep tracker in one app
Works with a dedicated parent touchscreen monitor — no phone required
Under-mattress sensor — nothing attached to your baby
Night light and lullabies built directly into the baby camera
Built specifically for newborns, infants, and babies.
Sleep is not a luxury — it's health. For your baby, and for you.
Download Babysense and get the peace of mind every parent deserves.

bluejetty:00092858:ios.description:

bluejetty:00084006:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in a world where vibrant blocks come to life, challenging your wit and reflexes. Bloxie offers a fresh take on the block-matching concept, providing players with an engaging and addictive experience. The game mechanics are easy to grasp, making it accessible for players of all ages, while the increasing complexity ensures a satisfying challenge for seasoned puzzle enthusiasts.
Unleash Your Inner Puzzler:
Bloxie is not just a block-matching game; it's an experience that engages your mind and tests your strategic prowess. Dive into a world of endless possibilities as you match and clear colored blocks on the board. The goal is simple: master the skill of filling rows or columns, earn points and advance through the levels.
With intuitive controls, you can effortlessly move and strategically place the blocks to create satisfying combinations. As you progress, the challenge intensifies, pushing you to think several steps ahead. Bloxie rewards players for consecutive successful moves with a dynamic combo system. The combo system not only adds a layer of strategy but also encourages players to think several moves ahead to maximize their score potential. Whether you're a casual player or a seasoned puzzler, Bloxie offers an experience that's easy to pick up yet hard to put down.
You can play the game as follows;
- As colored blocks descend onto the board, place them strategically to form complete rows or columns.
- String together multiple successful placements to activate combos and earn bonus points.
- Plan ahead, think quickly, and execute your moves with precision to achieve the highest scores. 
- Watch as the blocks cascade down the board, forming mesmerizing patterns that keep you hooked from the first move to the final triumph.
Strategize, Match, Conquer:
Bloxie ensures that players are constantly challenged by progressively increasing difficulty levels. Whether you're a casual player looking for a relaxing gaming session or a hardcore enthusiast seeking a mental workout, Bloxie caters to all skill levels. The evolving challenges keep the game fresh and exciting, ensuring hours of entertainment.
Develop your own unique playstyle as you discover advanced strategies to outsmart the ever-evolving challenges. Bloxie keeps you on your toes with a diverse range of levels and environments. Each level introduces new challenges, layouts, and block types, ensuring that the gameplay remains fresh and exciting. 
Bloxie is poised to become a staple in all stores. Are you ready to unleash your puzzle-solving prowess and become a Bloxie master? 
The challenges await!
Download Bloxie now and unleash your inner puzzler in this captivating block-matching extravaganza!

bluejetty:00082150:ios.description:
Bling Financial and PlayDay Studios bring you a brain blasting classic that keeps your mind sharp and your crypto wallet stacked! Combining entertainment, cognitive stimulation, and crypto elements isn’t easy, but Bitcoin Sudoku brings you all that and more. 
Sudoku has been a puzzle sensation for decades, you’ve heard the name, now learn to play! Sudoku is a logic-based puzzle game and requires no math despite popular misconceptions. Our Bitcoin-themed version of Sudoku helps you learn to play using an award-winning step-by-step fail-proof tutorial. With progressive levels of difficulty, you can go from novice to expert in no time. You can earn Bling Points in-app if you log into your Bling account. 
If you already consider yourself a sudoku enthusiast, then challenge yourself with our “expert” level puzzles. Set against Bitcoin-themed backgrounds, Bitcoin Sudoku also features a sleek classic design with multiple color schemes that will help enhance concentration. With thousands of puzzles, 4 levels of difficulty, and sleek design, Bitcoin Sudoku is fun for everyone. 
Bitcoin Sudoku features number-themed confetti, multi-color themes, and an auto-correct option that never lets you lose. Bitcoin Sudoku’s user-friendly design promotes focus and tranquility while providing unique levels of brain stimulation. 
How To Play: Complete a 9x9 grid using numbers 1-9. Each grid has 9 “boxes” (made up of 3 x 3 cells). Fill in every cell making sure that each row, column, and box are filled in using the numbers 1-9, without repeating any numbers within the row, column or box. Sounds complicated, but it’s very simple. 
Add Bitcoin Sudoku to your library of games to start learning and earning! 
Featuring: 
Award Winning Tutorial 
Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert Levels 
Different Color Themes 
Sleek Design 
Explosive Number Confetti 
Save Game & Progress 
Hints, Undo, and Erase Capabilities 
Take Notes 
Our No-Mistake system lets you win every time!

bluejetty:00043516:ios.name: Apexmove
bluejetty:00043516:ios.summary: Apexmove, a smartwatch companion app independently developed by KOSPET, is designed to help you gain a broader picture of your workout data and physical recovery, create training plans and programs, and explore the outdoors. You can also vi
bluejetty:00043516:ios.description:
Apexmove, a smartwatch companion app independently developed by KOSPET, is designed to help you gain a broader picture of your workout data and physical recovery, create training plans and programs, and explore the outdoors. You can also visit the app to download offline maps, third-party apps, and more.
Key features include:
Status: Manage activity data such as steps, distance, and calories burned, health data like heart rate and blood oxygen, and all-day sleep and fitness-related data.
Workout: Save and review your workout records and training data summary.
Explore: Import and edit routes, sync them to your watch with one tap, and start navigation.
Device: Manage your device settings and download third-party apps, offline maps, and more.
My: Manage app settings and your personal profile, and contact customer service for technical and more support.
To support features such as GPS tracking, BT calling, SMS notifications, and WhatsApp notifications, the Apexmove app requires access to permissions including GPS, BT, Phone, and Camera. These permissions are used only for device pairing, data synchronization, workout tracking, message notifications, and other related features. Your personal information will not be disclosed.
The Apexmove app utilizes Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Cloud.ru cloud servers. Depending on your location, your data will be stored at the nearest available server node. The collection and use of user data strictly comply with applicable local laws and regulations.
The Apexmove app integrates with third-party applications like Google Fit, Apple Health, Samsung Health, and Strava to sync data such as heart rate, blood oxygen, and workout records.

bluejetty:00015689:ios.summary:
SharkSmart WA is Western Australia’s official source of shark activity information. It also includes beach safety features such as Surf Life Saving WA patrolled beaches and weather forecast, to help you plan your trip to the beach.
The app
bluejetty:00015689:ios.description:
SharkSmart WA is Western Australia’s official source of shark activity information. It also includes beach safety features such as Surf Life Saving WA patrolled beaches and weather forecast, to help you plan your trip to the beach.
The app will help you switch on your Sea Sense by providing near real-time information of shark activity including current alerts and warnings. Select your favourite coastal locations and use notifications to receive relevant updates as they happen.
SharkSmart WA Features:
Map
Filter and display shark activity and beach safety features including the locations of shark monitoring receivers, beach enclosures, and Beach Emergency Numbers (BEN) signage. Explore and save your favourite coastal locations to stay up to date of recent shark activity.
Updates
Stay informed of shark activity, including current alerts and warnings. Information is prioritised into ‘Nearby’, ‘Your Favourites’ and ‘Other Locations’, giving you the most relevant information first.
Report
Using location services, the app can provide you with information about your current coastal location. Use the details provided and the quick call link to report shark sightings or whale carcasses (which are known to attract sharks) to Water Police as soon as possible.
Information within the SharkSmart WA app is designed to help you make an informed decision about your water use and take personal responsibility for your safety. You can also follow our Sea Sense tips at https://www.sharksmart.com.au/staying-safe/ and discover more about our shark mitigation strategies by visiting https://www.sharksmart.com.au/

bluejetty:00083986:ios.name: Swamp Attack 2
bluejetty:00083986:ios.summary: Our friend Slow Joe is just sittin’ on his porch, minding his own business, when a swarm of mutant ‘gators attack! Good job he’s got access to firearms, but he’s going to need a whole lot of help and a whole lot of ammo this time around...
bluejetty:00083986:ios.description:
Our friend Slow Joe is just sittin’ on his porch, minding his own business, when a swarm of mutant ‘gators attack! Good job he’s got access to firearms, but he’s going to need a whole lot of help and a whole lot of ammo this time around...
DEFEND JOE’S SWAMP!
These monsters mean business and they’re racing straight towards Joe’s cabin in this awesome tower defense game. First they’re coming for the swamp, then the entire world, so show no mercy and kick them OFF your private property!
SHOOT THE MONSTERS!
Evil crocs, grizzly gators, bloodthirsty beavers and rabid rats. Are they mutants? Zombies? All we know is they’re deadly! And they’ll do more than destroy the plants if they get close, so load up your gun and get shooting!
CHOOSE YOUR WEAPONS
Shotguns, rayguns, rockets, bombs, grenades… practice your aim and your archery skills with an extensive range of weapons. Some guns are effective on small, quick monsters while others are better on big, slow beasts! Upgrade your guns as you go to kick up a monster storm.
MEET JOE’S FAMILY
Slow Joe ain’t the sharpest tack in the box and he’s going to need help defending his swamp! Meet flamethrowing cousin Welder, armed and dangerous Uncle Hairy and the not-so-sweet Grandma Mau. Combine lethal weapons with lethal family members for the best attack.
EXPLORE NEW LEVELS & WORLDS
Start off in the Deep South and play levels to progress to the Siberian swamps of China and Russia. Different monsters lurk in different regions, and you’ll need strong tactics to defeat some of these zombies, so get ready to fight in this tower defense game!
Swamp Attack 2 is an action-packed attack and defense game filled with guns, monsters and zombies. Players who like shooting games, gun games, archery games, monster games, tower defense games, racing games, funny games and crazy characters will enjoy this game, too!
Please note, we do not process all the data disclosed on the label for users under the age of digital consent. For more information, please check our Privacy Policy.

bluejetty:00131061:ios.name: American Airlines
bluejetty:00131061:ios.summary: With the American Airlines app, you’re covered with the information you need exactly when you need it. Curious about traffic to the airport? Need a mobile boarding pass? Wondering where the closest Admirals Club® lounge is? All of this info
bluejetty:00131061:ios.description:
With the American Airlines app, you’re covered with the information you need exactly when you need it. Curious about traffic to the airport? Need a mobile boarding pass? Wondering where the closest Admirals Club® lounge is? All of this info and more is available at your fingertips.
- Live Activities: Track your flight in real-time right from your Lock Screen, Dynamic Island and your Apple Watch's Smart Stack. 
- Lock Screen & Home Screen widgets: See your next trip's details with our dynamic widgets.
- Personalized home screen: See your next trip, AAdvantage® status, miles and Loyalty Points.
- Booking: Book your next trip along with our hotel, car, cruise and vacation partners right from the app.
- Mobile boarding pass: Check in for your trip and retrieve your mobile boarding pass. No need to print, and it’s updated along the way.
- Interactive terminal maps: Navigating airports is a breeze with our interactive terminal maps. Find the closest Admirals Club® lounge or get directions to your connecting gate. 
- AAdvantage® account details: Review all the details of your AAdvantage® account right from your account dashboard. Not an AAdvantage® member? Sign up today.
- Seat selection: Choose or change your seat within the app. Just pick the one you’d like and change it on the spot. 
- Track your bag: Know exactly where your bag is from the time it leaves your hands to when you extend the handle at your destination. 
- Save your trip: Your recently viewed trips are automatically saved in the app so you can easily grab the details for your next flight in seconds.
- Quick interactions: The American app utilizes Haptic Touch and is Apple watch compatible, giving you quick access to the most important info. 
- Wi-Fi access in the air: Don’t forget, on flights with Wi-Fi you can use the American app and aa.com at no cost. 
There’s a new group of flyers out there – The World’s Greatest Flyers. They know that having the right travel tools makes for a great experience.
The sky’s the limit with the American Airlines sticker pack! Let friends and family know that you’re traveling, headed to the Admirals Club® lounge to take it easy before taking off, snapping photos at 30,000 feet or that you’ve arrived.
Contact Us: 800-222-2377

bluejetty:00088461:ios.description:
Monitor Your Energy, Every Day with BodyState!
BodyState gives you a daily energy score from 1 to 100, combining your most important fitness metrics into a single, clear signal. Whether your goal is to manage stress, plan workouts, or simply feel better, BodyState helps you make smarter choices in tune with your body.
Key features:
- Personalized Energy Score: Track your body’s condition with a single score, powered by sleep quality, HRV, resting heart rate, and recent physical exertion. No guesswork, just real insights.
- Sleep & Recovery Tracking: Discover how restful your sleep truly was and how well your body recovered overnight.
- Stress Insights via HRV & Resting Heart Rate: Monitor your stress level over time and stay ahead of burnout.
- Acute Training Load (ATL): See the impact of recent physical activity on your body. Know when to push harder and when to pull back.
- Know What’s Normal for You: BodyState doesn’t rely on generic health data. Instead, it learns your personal baseline over time to give context-specific insights. Understand how today's numbers compare to your standard.
- All-in-One Dashboard: Get your energy, stress, sleep, and training signals all in one intuitive view.
- Effortless Syncing: Works seamlessly with Apple Health to gather the metrics you already track, no extra setup needed.
How It Works:
1. Sync with Apple Health to pull in key health metrics.
2. Get your daily score and see how each input affects your energy.
3. Check f you’re balanced, depleted, or primed for performance.
4. Track trends over time and adjust your habits.
This App is intended for general wellness and information purposes only. BodyState does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult healthcare professionals for medical guidance.

- Your subscription will renew automatically, unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

- When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.

bluejetty:00044325:android.description:
Welcome to Bird Paradise! 🌟 Embark on a delightful adventure with our pigeon in this bird caring simulation game. Explore the skies and experience the joy of feeding and playing with various birds like Jay, Eagle, Parrot, and more! 🕊️🌈
🐦 Different birds breeds characters: Jay, Eagle, Raven, Francolin, Kiwi, Ibis, Parrot, Falcon, Owl, Duck, Puffin, Chicken, Hawk, chick, Flamingo, hummingbird.
What's it like to be a pigeon? Find out as you immerse yourself in this incredibly addictive game. Take on the role of a caretaker as you rescue birds and nurture them in your very own Bird Land Paradise. 🌴🌟
If you love animals and birds, this game is for you! Adopt a pet bird and watch them flourish under your care. 🐤💕
Key features:
🌟 Save and care for various bird species
🐦 Pet rescue: Help birds in need and be their hero
🌴 Adopt a pet: Bring home your favorite bird breeds
🎮 Play with birds: Engage in fun activities with your feathered friends
🐤 Exciting bird simulation game with over 200 levels to explore
🌟 Stunning 2D graphics that bring Bird Paradise to life
🕊️ Challenge other players with the arcade mechanism
🌴 Call to install: Dive into the world of pigeon games and bird games now!
Join the adventure in Pigeon Pop: Bird Life Pet Shop and make every day a delightful celebration of winged wonders! 🎉🐦
Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of Bird Land Paradise and become the ultimate bird caretaker! Care for a variety of bird species including majestic eagles, colorful parrots, and adorable chicks. With over 200 levels to explore, the excitement never ends!
In this bird simulation game, you'll experience the thrill of rescuing birds in need and nurturing them back to health. Whether it's feeding hungry chicks or soothing a sleepy owl, your compassionate care will make a difference in the lives of these feathered friends.
But the fun doesn't stop there! Challenge yourself with arcade-style gameplay and compete against other players to see who can care for the most birds. With stunning 2D graphics and immersive gameplay, Pigeon Pop: Bird Life Pet Shop will transport you to a world of wonder and excitement.
So why wait? Download Pigeon Pop: Bird Life Pet Shop now and embark on an unforgettable adventure in the skies! 🌟🐦

bluejetty:00068875:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00068875:ios.description:
Showcase your business or organization with a custom-branded app!
Welcome to Onespot, the app builder loved by thousands of businesses, organizations, and communities around the world—from 1-person companies to 60,000-person towns.
Onespot is a mobile app builder that lets you make a custom-branded app for your business, organization, school, event, club, faith-based group, law firm, real estate company, lawn care service, neighborhood, soccer team, or any other type of community you're a part of.
And it's so easy, you can do it right from your phone!
Get started with a free trial and subscribe in the app for full service.
Learn more at onespotapps.com
———
MAKE AN APP IN MINUTES
Build a mobile app with our drag-and-drop app builder and Onespot AI.
Your small business? Your organization? There's now an app for that!
You worked hard to build your business/organization. It deserves its own mobile app.
Organize all your organization's information into one spot: Your existing web pages, booking links, calendars, contacts, forms, schedules, social media, etc.
And you don't need to write a single line of code.
Onespot is intuitive and simple to use. Just drag and drop items on your phone—text, buttons, images, and more.
Okay, you can't build an app in your sleep (yet). But you *can* build an app from your bed.
Adding screens and content to your app is as easy as jotting down notes on your phone. Onespot is a multi-platform service, so you can use it on your phone, computer, tablet, or any other device with an internet connection (check out www.1spot.app).
It's like Wix, Squarespace, Webflow, Canva, or Universe, but for mobile apps.
———
ENGAGE YOUR CUSTOMERS & MEMBERS
A custom-branded app helps you increase your online presence and stay better connected with your members and customers.
People are overwhelmed with the inundation of emails they get daily. Skip their inbox and alert them directly with targeted push notifications.
Send powerful, targeted communications as easily as you send text messages.
Instantly message any of your members with one-on-one chat, perfect for customer support and more.
Inform and engage your members with banner messages and instant notifications, targeted to any segment of your community.
Create group chats and activity feeds to unlock the power of your organization's community network.
———
DELIGHT YOUR COMMUNITY
Your members are each unique. Don't make them use an app that treats them all the same.
With Onespot, every user can completely customize their own experience, so they can easily access whatever they care about most. For example, one customer might care about your company's social media feeds, while another might care about the latest discounts you offer.
With Onespot, your members can also choose which groups they're in (completely configurable by you) and which notification they want to receive. Help your community members be informed & engaged by giving them easy access to whatever they value most.
Take a few minutes to try out Onespot and join the tens of thousands of members we've delighted already!
———
HAVE FUN
It's like FlutterFlow, but with no code. It's like Appy Pie, Adalo, or Thunkable, but mobile-first. It's like Notion, but for making mobile apps.
In other words, it's a seriously fun app builder.
———
To contact the developers directly, email team@seabirdapps.com.
By using this app, you agree to Apple's standard Terms of Use (End User License Agreement):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula
You also agree to Onespot's terms of service and privacy policy:
- onespotapps.com/terms
- onespotapps.com/privacy
Additional notes: Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payments will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and you can manage app subscriptions in your iTunes Account settings. Prices vary.

bluejetty:00026028:ios.description:
The Bird Side of Life
1. Live Stream: Real-time Bird Visitor Tracking 
- View the device's live feed anytime, anywhere to track birds or animals visiting your backyard.
2. Moment Auto-Capture: Automatically Record Wonderful Moments
- The device automatically records short video clips when it detects birds or other creatures, saving key moments without manual operation. You can view these directly within the app.
3. Categorized Collection: Manage Wonderful Clips by Bird Species
- Sort videos by bird species based on recognition results or your manual selection, allowing you to easily find, manage, and browse your collected video content.
4. Community Sharing: Explore Other Users' Fascinating Observations
- Share or browse wonderful content of bird visits with users worldwide. Enjoy an immersive video stream experience that supports Browse by bird species, expanding your birdwatching horizons.
5. Bird Nesting & Hatching Process Tracking (for Birdhouse Devices)
- Automatically identify and record the complete process of birds from nest building, laying eggs, hatching, to fledging. The process is automatically archived by stages, allowing you to browse the entire lifecycle on a timeline. Finally, a merged video is generated, fully presenting the precious process of nesting and raising young.
6. Cloud Services (Optional Paid Premium Features)
- AI Recognition Cloud Service: When enabled, it supports more intelligent video analysis and content organization, including:
 * Accurate Identification: 6000+ bird/animal identification, accurately recognizing species like birds, squirrels, and other visiting animals in your device's footage.
 * Highlights: Automatically generates daily highlights, selecting the most exciting moments of the day.
 * Monthly/Annual Recap: The system organizes and generates monthly and annual highlight video compilations for easy review and saving.
 * Birdfy Data: Records bird visit times, frequency, and species, generating data reports.
 * Smart Moment List Filtering: Supports quick filtering of interesting bird videos by recognition results, improving Browse efficiency.
- MVR Cloud Service
 * Standard recording is 20 seconds. Subscribing provides longer moment recording times (30 seconds+) and longer moment preservation times.
- Collection Cloud Service
 * Standard users have only 5GB of collection memory. Subscribing increases collection memory to 20GB+.

bluejetty:00061150:ios.name: Babelio, ma bibliothèque
bluejetty:00061150:ios.summary:
Choisissez votre prochaine lecture grâce aux millions de critiques publiées par les autres lecteurs
Créez et gérez votre bibliothèque en quelques minutes en scannant le code-barre de vos livres
Découvrez et partagez avec d'autres passionnés
bluejetty:00061150:ios.description:
Choisissez votre prochaine lecture grâce aux millions de critiques publiées par les autres lecteurs
Créez et gérez votre bibliothèque en quelques minutes en scannant le code-barre de vos livres
Découvrez et partagez avec d'autres passionnés de livres
Babelio est la première communauté de lecteurs francophones. Chaque jour des milliers de critiques, extraits ou notes de livres sont ajoutés par les membres du réseau social, et dans tous les genres. Que vous cherchiez à découvrir un livre.
La première base de données bibliographiques pour les lecteurs francophones
Que vous cherchiez à en savoir plus sur un titre vu en librairie, ou donc vous avez déjà entendu parler, des millions de livres sont référencés sur Babelio : vous n’avez qu’à chercher un titre, un auteur, un ISBN, pour découvrir la fiche du livre correspondant ainsi que toute l’information sur ce titre, ses différentes éditions, la note attribuée par les lecteurs … Et pour aller au plus simple vous pouvez directement scanner le code-barres au dos du livre pour le retrouver
Un outil pour classer ses livres et gérer sa bibliothèque
Vous pouvez construire votre propre bibliothèque en ajoutant les livres et en les classant : le classement des livres lus, à lire, notés, critiqués, et le pense-bête vous permettent d’organiser vos lectures passées, présentes et à venir. Classez votre bibliothèque grâce à l’ajout d’étiquettes, de tags et de statuts pertinents. Vous pouvez par ailleurs vous fixer des objectifs de lecture pour l’année ou voir votre avancement en notant la date de début et de fin de lecture.
Donner son avis, parmi les 2 millions de critiques de livres
Publiez vos critiques et notez les livres. Déjà 2 millions de critiques témoignent de l’avis des lecteurs et vous pouvez les découvrir sans dévoiler l’intrigue grâce à la gestion des spoilers. Qui sont les lecteurs qui se cachent derrière ce nombre de « j’aime » sur mes critiques ou citations ? Pour le savoir, cliquez sur le nombre de “J’aime”. Vous pouvez également sauvegarder votre critique en brouillon si vous êtes interrompu durant sa rédaction.
Découvrir l’actualité et recevoir des recommandations de lecture personnalisées
Interviews, listes, quizz, livres du moment, rencontres, prochaines parutions … : retrouvez toute l’actualité du livre et de Babelio pour ne rien manquer, dans tous les genres littéraires ! Littérature
Et recevez tous les jours des recommandations de lecture personnalisées.
Partager avec d’autres passionnés de lecture
Avec plus d’un million de membres inscrits sur Babelio, il y a de quoi partager avec l’ensemble des lecteurs pour faire de nouvelles découvertes de lectures, apprécier des critiques, fouiller dans les favoris, et échanger avec des lecteurs aux mêmes goûts que l’on peut retrouver grâce aux badges.
Si vous avez la moindre question, ou si vous souhaitez nous suggérer des améliorations, écrivez nous ici : https://babelio.freshdesk.com/support/tickets/new

bluejetty:00159560:ios.name: Peery Park Rides
bluejetty:00159560:ios.summary:
Peery Park Rides is a new way to get around Peery Park and parts of Sunnyvale. We’re a ridesharing service that’s smart, easy, and reliable.
With a few taps, book a ride in the app and our technology will pair you with other people headed
bluejetty:00159560:ios.description:
Peery Park Rides is a new way to get around Peery Park and parts of Sunnyvale. We’re a ridesharing service that’s smart, easy, and reliable.
With a few taps, book a ride in the app and our technology will pair you with other people headed your way.
HOW IT WORKS:
- Book a ride by setting your pickup and dropoff addresses, and indicating if you’re riding with any additional passengers. 
- You will be given an estimated time when the vehicle will arrive upon booking your trip and on which nearby block you should meet your driver. The estimated arrival time of the driver will be automatically updated as your vehicle makes its way to meet you.
- When your driver arrives, please promptly board the vehicle.
- There may be others on board, or you may make a few additional stops along the way! You can track your ride and share your status in real-time trip from the app. 
SHARING YOUR TRIP:
Our algorithm matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience of a private ride with the efficiency and reliability of a public one.
FLEXIBLE BOOKING.
Book a ride in our app right when you want it.
RELIABLE:
Track your ride as the driver is on their way to you, and while you’re on the vehicle too. 
OUR VEHICLES:
Peery Park Rides is wheelchair accessible! Simply toggle on “Wheelchair accessibility” in the “Account” tab of your app! When you request a ride, you’ll be matched with a wheelchair accessible vehicle. 
Questions? Reach out at support-peeryparkrides@ridewithvia.com.
Loving your experience so far? Give us a 5-star rating.

bluejetty:00119073:ios.name: Business Plan for Startups
bluejetty:00119073:ios.summary: If you are new to entrepreneurship this app is especially helpful. I have written a free reference book/app explaining how to start a small business. If you decide to start, I have prepared business plan and budget templates ready to fill o
bluejetty:00119073:ios.description:
If you are new to entrepreneurship this app is especially helpful. I have written a free reference book/app explaining how to start a small business. If you decide to start, I have prepared business plan and budget templates ready to fill out and use. The templates you have to purchase at reasonable price in the app. 
I have made the app as less complicated as possible so you can find the courage to get started. Execution is the most important skill to possess when it comes to entrepreneurship.
THE AUTHOR
I have spent 25 years as entrepreneur and entrepreneurship consultant and talked to thousands of entrepreneurs. This experience I have used to develop this this app. I believe it will give you the courage and understanding to start your own business. I am convinced that starting a small business releases energy and set one free to create value for one self and others. 
Good luck in your new venture.
-------------
My business plan app can both educate you to be an entrepreneur and help you write a business plan. You can write your business plan directly on your device while commuting. Or you can download business plan templates and email them to your computer and work from home.
In this app you will find everything you need to create a professional business plan:
- 100 of the best business plan and startup articles - free
- 1 online business plan editor - in app purchase
- 3 business plan examples & 3 startup budget templates - in app purchase
- 1 business plan template - in app purchase
- Access to additional content, if you need more inspiration for your business plan.- in app purchase
WHY DOWNLOAD THIS BUSINESS PLAN APP
Even though you are skilled in your line of work you might not be skilled in doing business. This business plan app is a step-by-step guide that takes the mystery and confusion out of starting a business. The app helps you by covering the 9 main issues you must overcome to run a successful business. Each issue is explained by 6-10 text articles and examples.
EXCELLENT FOR HOME BUSINESS AND ONLINE BUSINESS
I provide advice, help, templates and best practice on topics such as business concept, personal resources, product/service, market description, sales and marketing, organizing, business development, budgets, financing, and much more.
The app has business plan examples for different types of startups, including a software company, a sports cafe and a graphic design company.
How to create a business plan for your business or startup with this business plan app:
1. Read and learn from the articles and business plan examples on your iOS device.
2. Buy the business plan editor and write your own business plan when commuting or sitting on the loo (:-)
3. "Start Today - Not Tomorrow" - templates you can email out of the app.
4. Answer the questions in the business plan template.
5. Fill in figures in the budget templates.
Congratulations, you now have your own business plan and you have made it yourself!
Additionally, we hope you will find that our business plan app:
- is easy to use and follow
- gives tools to validate your business idea
- is written in plain understandable language
- covers all the business essentials you need to create a business plan and start a business
- provides budget and marketing plan templates
- provides a business plan template
- gives access to three completed business plan examples
- works offline
- Home business
- Online business
May your new company give you joy and a steady income

bluejetty:00143762:ios.summary:
Your thoughts deserve a safe space.

bluejetty:00143762:ios.description:
Your thoughts deserve a safe space.
DrawerJournal is a private diary and mindfulness journal that lets you capture your thoughts, feelings, and daily moments — right when they happen. No cloud uploads, no sign-ups. Just you and your words, stored safely on your device.
Ever wanted to write something down but forgot it hours later? With DrawerJournal, you can jot down thoughts in seconds, building a personal timeline of your day. It’s journaling made effortless.
Write in the moment, then look back days later. Even on days when “nothing happened,” you might be surprised to find how much was actually on your mind. That quiet self-reflection is where real growth begins.
Here’s what makes DrawerJournal special:
DrawerJournal is a completely offline journal in a beautiful timeline format. Your entries never leave your device — there are no servers, no accounts, and no way for anyone else to read your private reflections. Write freely with photos, and keep it simple. We designed it so that anyone can start journaling in under a minute.
Whether you use it as a daily diary, a gratitude notebook, a mood tracker, or a quick memo pad — DrawerJournal adapts to your life. Give it a try.
Features:
• Timeline Notes with Photos & Audio
Each entry is timestamped automatically, creating a chronological flow of your day. Attach photos and voice memos to bring your memories to life. Write during your commute, lunch break, or quiet moments before bed. Your posts line up like a personal feed — a safe, private timeline just for you.
• Organize with Labels
Use labels (tags) to group entries by theme across any date. Family moments, health tracking, travel memories, work reflections — categorize anything and revisit it effortlessly. Create, edit, and assign labels anytime. Build a system that fits your life.
• Voice Recording
Capture sounds along with your writing. Record the ambient music of a café, rain on a window, or fireworks in the distance. Listening back transports you to that exact moment. You can even keep a voice diary before sleep — no bright screen needed. You can also keep entries by voice.
• Privacy Lock
This is your space, and yours alone. Lock the app with Face ID, Touch ID, or a passcode. Even if your phone is lost, your journal stays private. All data is stored locally — nothing goes online, ever. Write without holding back. Unlock your thoughts in a space no one else can see.
• Powerful Search
Find any entry instantly by keyword. Jump back to a memory from months ago or locate an important note in seconds. Never worry about losing track of something you wrote. View your entries by date and time to notice patterns in your thoughts and growth over time.
• Beautiful Customization
Choose from multiple fonts, adjust text size, and pick a theme color that feels right. Dark mode keeps things comfortable at night. Set a personal background image to make your journal truly yours. A simple diary becomes something special with just a small touch of personality.
DrawerJournal can be your daily diary, a mindful writing space, a gratitude journal, a scrapbook of memories, or simply a place to think out loud. We kept the design minimal on purpose — so you can focus on what matters: your thoughts.
We built DrawerJournal hoping to hear, “This is exactly the app I was looking for.” We hope it becomes a quiet, meaningful part of your everyday life.

listings.name: DrawerJournal: Private Journal
listings.description:
A private journal that feels like texting yourself.
Jot down a thought, add a photo, or record a voice memo in seconds. Every entry is time-stamped, so your day reads like a timeline.
Lock your journal with Face ID, Touch ID, or a passcode. Stored on this device. Never sent to us. We can't read it. No account needed.

No blank page to fill. Write one line when something happens: on the bus, at lunch, at 2 a.m. Then scroll back and find the small moments you'd otherwise forget.

QUICK POSTS ON A TIMELINE
• Write as many entries a day as you like
• Time stamps are added for you, and you can change the date and time anytime

PHOTOS, VOICE, AND VIDEO
• Up to 6 photos per entry
• Record a voice memo with any entry
• The Media tab shows the photos, videos, and voice memos from all your entries in one grid
• Short video clips with Premium

FIND ANYTHING AGAIN
• Tags group entries across dates
• Calendar view to jump to any day
• Search every entry, with matches highlighted
• Memories brings back entries from the past

LOCK AND PRIVACY
• Lock the app with a 4-digit passcode, Face ID, or Touch ID
• Your entries are stored on this device. They're never sent to us, and we can't read them
• No account, no sign-up
• Back up and restore your journal as a ZIP file
• Want your journal on more than one device? Turn on iCloud sync (Premium) and your entries are kept in your own iCloud

APPLE WATCH AND WIDGETS
• Post from your wrist with voice dictation on Apple Watch, plus complications
• Home Screen widgets for today and today's entries
• Available on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with Apple silicon

MAKE IT YOURS
• A selection of free themes and fonts
• Entry text gets larger when you increase your device's text size
• Share a day as an image

PREMIUM (OPTIONAL)
Everything above is free unless it's marked Premium. The free version shows ads. Premium is an optional paid upgrade, available as a subscription or a one-time purchase. It adds:
• Video clips up to 15 seconds each, up to 3 a day: record or choose from your library, then trim (photos and videos share the 6 slots per entry)
• iCloud sync between iPhone, iPad, and Mac (iOS 17 or later)
• Print your journal or save it as a PDF
• Export entries as text (TXT)
• Detailed statistics
• All 31 themes, handpicked fonts, and premium app icons
• More widgets: photo, one-line, and tag widgets
• Drawer mode on iPad and Mac, with your tags side by side as columns
• Choose the quality of attached photos, videos, and voice memos
• All Memories cards (the free version shows 2), a filter for untagged entries, and the option to hide entries in shared images
• No ads

WHY "DRAWER"?
In Japanese, the app is called 引き出し日記, "drawer diary": a drawer to keep your thoughts in. It's popular in Japan and Korea. Open the drawer, drop in a line, close it.

bluejetty:00161478:ios.description:
Calmer nights start with DozZy.
Sleep sounds, lullabies, Night Guard, sleep tracking and a soft night light - made for babies and tired parents.
DozZy helps you build a peaceful bedtime rhythm from the first months through early childhood. Choose soothing sleep sounds, record mom's or dad's voice, mix sounds, track naps and let Night Guard start calming audio when your baby cries.
With DozZy you can:
- Play white, brown and pink noise, rain, nature, household sounds, transport sounds and lullabies.
- Record parent voices, shhh sounds, soft humming or your own lullaby, then play them alone or over another sound.
- Turn on Night Guard so the app can listen for crying and play the chosen calming sound.
- Mix sounds like rain with shhh, lullaby with white noise, or ocean with heartbeat.
- Track naps and night sleep in a simple sleep diary.
- See estimated next nap windows based on your baby's sleep history.

bluejetty:00184600:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00184600:ios.description:
Get in on the real-time GPS action happening in YOUR neighborhood!! Do you have what it takes to be the Capo of your city?
“…the GPS element sets this game apart” – The Times of London: RATED 4/5 Stars
“a trailblazer” – The Guardian: RATED top 10 free iPad game
RATED A- – The Onion A.V. Club
Turf Wars is the massively multiplayer online game where you claim and defend your favorite real-world places from other mobsters. Stake your claim on your neighborhood, your favorite bar or restaurant, your school or workplace – the city is yours for the taking!
Start off as a lowly street punk and rise through the ranks to become the biggest mobster in your area! Run realistic missions, fight local mobsters, seize territory, and deal with the cops to gain more influence and take over your city.
FEATURES:
– Control REAL territory in your city and around the world!
– Build and defend your turf using dozens of realistic weapons and upgrades.
– Capture other player’s turf and make it your OWN!
– Make other players to pay you protection money for their turf’s “safety”
– Send messages to your friends, enemies, and mob members.
– Deal with local law enforcement as you grow your empire
– Invite your friends to build the most powerful mob in your city!
– View worldwide and local high rollers
– Free updates!
– Works on iPhone, iPad, and iPod Touch
– Fight and take over other players’ turf for your chance to become the Capo of your city!
This app utilizes data from OpenStreetMap (https://www.openstreetmap.org) when using the “OpenStreetMap” geocoder option. All data © OpenStreetMap contributors.
IMPORTANT:
Your device must be running OS 15.0 or higher and be connected to the Internet to play. For best results, Location Services should be enabled on your device.

bluejetty:00128561:ios.summary: Welcome to Solitaire Story: Ava's Manor, a free relaxing solitaire and story game where every level helps continue the storyline. Play solitaire levels, participate in merge events, restore the manor, unlock rooms, and follow Ava's journey
bluejetty:00128561:ios.description:
Welcome to Solitaire Story: Ava's Manor, a free relaxing solitaire and story game where every level helps continue the storyline. Play solitaire levels, participate in merge events, restore the manor, unlock rooms, and follow Ava's journey through mystery and romance.
Ava is an author struggling to write her next mystery novel when she inherits her great uncle’s manor. But the manor is hiding more than dusty furniture. As you restore each room, you'll uncover mysterious clues, reveal long-kept secrets, and follow Ava's story as she finds new love and rediscovers her passion for writing. Every solitaire level unravels more of the mystery and reveals the truth hidden within the walls of Blackwood Manor.
Complete card puzzles to earn rewards, choose furniture, uncover hidden secrets, and keep the story moving. Play solitaire levels offline, anytime.
Features:
• PLAY SOLITAIRE LEVELS — Complete relaxing card puzzles and progress through Ava's story. Challenge yourself with levels of varying difficulty, unlock power-ups, and keep the story moving.
• RENOVATE AND DECORATE — Restore rooms, gardens, and hidden corners of the manor. Choose from a wide range of furniture styles as you uncover each new space.
• UNCOVER THE MYSTERY ROMANCE — Find clues, reveal secrets, and follow Ava's journey. Mystery and romance unfold with every level you complete.
• PLAY MERGE CONTENT — Take on merge challenges to earn rewards and make progress in special events.
• RELAX AND PROGRESS — Enjoy a blend of free solitaire gameplay, story progression, and manor design at your own pace.
If you enjoy solitaire, tripeaks, klondike, pyramid, mahjong, or puzzle games, Ava's Manor is your next obsession. Love story games and merge challenges? You'll feel right at home.
Join the community on Facebook: facebook.com/AvasManor

- 매일 약 1만 개 이상의 신상품 업데이트
- 믿을 수 있는 2천만 개의 구매 후기
[지그재그가 새로워졌어요]
- 발견: 지금 뜨는 트렌드부터 직잭러들의 코디와 큐레이션까지, 매일 새로운 이야기가 업데이트되고 있어요.
- 전문관: 디자이너, 캐주얼, 스포츠, 이너웨어와 뷰티, 라이프까지. 더 다양해진 브랜드를 편하게 둘러볼 수 있어요.
[지그재그는 이런 게 좋아요]
- 스토어 랭킹: 9천 개가 넘는 스토어를 한 눈에 볼 수 있어, 빠르게 트렌드를 파악할 수 있어요.
- 직진 배송: 마음에 드는 옷을 바로 입을 수 있도록, 어디서든 주문 당일 혹은 다음날 받아볼 수 있어요.
- 검색: 색상과 가격, 내게 맞는 기장과 소재까지. 정교한 필터 검색으로 한 번에 원하는 아이템을 찾을 수 있어요.
- 찜과 즐겨찾기: 마음에 드는 아이템은 찜으로, 더 알고 싶은 스토어는 즐겨찾기로. 좋아하는 것을 모아, 한눈에 볼 수 있어요.
지그재그 서비스에 필요한 접근 권한에 대해 안내드립니다.
선택적 접근 권한은 스마트폰 설정에서 자유롭게 허용/거부가 가능합니다.
지그재그 앱은 원활한 사용 목적 이외에 다른 용도로는 절대 사용하지 않으니 안심하세요.
[필수적 접근 권한]
정보통신망법 개정에 따라 지그재그는 서비스에 꼭 필요한 항목만 필수 접근하고 있습니다.
- 기기 및 앱 기록: 기기 식별 및 앱 상태(버전) 확인을 위해 필요한 권한입니다.
[선택적 접근 권한]
해당 기능을 사용하실 때 접근 권한 요청을 드리며, 각 접근 권한에 대해 허용하지 않아도 해당 기능 외 지그재그 서비스 이용이 가능합니다.
- 사진/카메라, 파일 및 폴더 : 구매 상품에 대한 포토리뷰 작성, 이미지 검색, 채팅 문의, 공유리워드 정산정보 등록 시 파일 첨부, 공유리워드 MY ZIP 배경화면 등록, 1:1 문의하기, 톡라운지 글쓰기, 리뷰 프로필 설정 시 파일 및 앨범에서 파일 첨부 또는 카메라 촬영을 통한 사진 첨부를 위해 필요한 권한입니다.
- 알림 : 이용자에게 주문, 배송, 혜택 등의 내용을 전달하기 위해 필요한 권한입니다.
- 선택적 접근 권한 동의 상태는 '휴대전화 설정 > 지그재그' 메뉴에서 설정할 수 있습니다.
[기타 안내]
- 지그재그 앱에서 진행되는 이벤트는 Apple과 관련이 없습니다.
- 화면 내에는 생성형 AI를 일부 사용한 이미지/동영상이 포함되어 있습니다.
[지그재그 고객센터]
E-mail : support@zigzag.kr
Kakao ID : 지그재그
고객센터 : 1670-8050
