bluejetty:00071382:ios.name: Multifly: Multiplication Games
bluejetty:00071382:ios.summary:
"Multifly proves that math is anything but boring" -Techzle
Multifly is a fun learning game for kids that helps kids visualize, practice and learn multiplication and division concepts. It also strengthens their multiplication skills by int
bluejetty:00071382:ios.description:
"Multifly proves that math is anything but boring" -Techzle
Multifly is a fun learning game for kids that helps kids visualize, practice and learn multiplication and division concepts. It also strengthens their multiplication skills by introducing them to 7 different strategies for multiplying numbers. Help your child learn and practice multiplication concepts in a really fun way so that they fall in love with Math. 
This one-of-a-kind Math game has no worksheets or flashcards - it is a real game, tells a captivating story and as your child solves puzzles to move the story forward, they get visually introduced to different Math concepts and learn multiplication. 
The wonderful mix of fun and learning in this fun math game makes kids fall in love with multiplication and no longer have to mindlessly mug up the multiplication tables. Kids will learn the times tables along with the concepts of multiplication. After learning the strategies, the game also has levels for multiplication practice. 
This math learning game is suitable for 2nd grade, 3rd grade, and 4th grade kids. 
Multifly helps kids with the transition from additive to multiplicative thinking with different multiplication learning strategies. This math educational game helps improve math facts with a strategic approach to learning. 
These strategies are - 
• Visualizing Multiplication through arrays
• Relation between Multiplication and Division
• Understanding Multiplication as repeated addition:
More strategies such as Turn-around facts, Adding a group, Subtracting a group, rounding up and compensating, halving and doubling, decomposing into known facts, and breaking down a factor to smaller factors will come soon in new levels.
So overall, instead of rote-learning multiplication times tables, your child will learn basic concepts as well as advanced multiplication strategies in this fun game.
Current multiplication games for kids are mostly in flashcard format and do not help with understanding concepts. Multifly teaches kids multiplication concepts and also helps with practice in proper story and game format. This is the only elementary grade math game that teaches multiplication facts in story and game format.
In a nutshell, Multifly has the following overall features: 
• Solve 50+ innovative physics puzzles involving a rolling monster, mystery blocks, shape-shifting portals and powerful springs.
• Get fluent in multiplication by mastering the 7+ multiplication strategies based on the best current pedagogical approaches.
• Learn multiplication and division through exciting puzzles instead of rote learning
• Experience a thrilling and immersive story which inspires your kid to never give up.
• Collect exciting rewards on successful mastery of Math concepts.
• Play in a safe, digital environment.
• Aligned to the Common Core learning standards and other curricula.
Download and start playing Multifly and see your kid progress with multiplication.
Teachers: 
‘Multifly*’ is based on the following Common Core concepts: (2.OA.C.4) (3.OA.A.1) (3.OA.A.2) (3.OA.A.3) (3.OA.A.4) (3.OA.B.5) (3.OA.B.6) (3.OA.C.7) (4.OA.A.1) (4.OA.A.2) (4.OA.A.3)
Subscription info:
- Multifly can be purchased as part of a makkajai annual subscription.
- Makkajai subscriptions are auto-renewable and annual at $59.99/yr
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase
- Cancellation will not go into effect until the end of the monthly billing cycle
For support, questions or comments, write to us at: support@makkajai.com
Our privacy policy can be found at: http://www.makkajai.com/privacy-policy
Our terms of use can be found at: http://www.makkajai.com/terms

bluejetty:00097624:ios.description:
Welcome to the ultimate merge puzzle adventure - merge, cook and design restaurants, cafes, mansion!
Dive into a world of flavors, fun, and fast-paced cooking in this addictively satisfying merge 2 game where you combine delicious ingredients, unlock exciting dishes, and build your dream kitchen empire.
Merge sushi, dough, cheese, and hundreds of other cooking items to complete long order chains, serve happy customers, and unlock new food-themed zones. From sizzling street snacks to gourmet desserts, every merge brings you one step closer to becoming the ultimate food master!
Key Features:
Merge to Cook
Combine cooking tools, ingredients, and dishes in a rich and rewarding merge 2 puzzle system. Discover hundreds of items as you craft everything from burgers to cupcakes!
LiveOps Events All Week Long
Stay engaged with exciting time-limited events like:
Dog Rescue Mission – Merge to collect treats, build dog houses, and help adorable pups find their forever homes!
Food Truck Races – Compete against other players to serve the most orders in high-speed cooking races across themed maps!
Mega Orders Challenge – Take on long, challenging orders that test your merge strategy and reward you with epic loot!
Beautiful Graphics & Juicy Animations
Every item is crafted with love - from the glossy cheese to bubbling soup pots. Watch your kitchen world come alive with stunning visuals and mouth-watering detail.
Build & Expand Your Culinary Empire
Decorate and upgrade your cooking zones with stylish appliances, cozy interiors, and quirky characters. Unlock new kitchens like the Pasta Corner, Dessert Diner, or Sushi Street as you progress!
Casual Fun, Deep Strategy
Easy to play, hard to master! Plan your merges carefully to maximize space, combo potential, and reward bonuses.
Merge Food, Merge Tools, Merge Everything
From spatulas to smoothies, discover endless combinations in a satisfying and addictive merge game experience that rewards clever thinking and creativity.
Engaging Meta Progression
Level up chefs, unlock powerful boosters, and track your journey across dozens of tasty levels and areas. There's always a new goal to reach and a new flavor to discover!
Whether you’re in the mood for fast-food frenzy or a relaxing cooking session, this merge puzzle game offers endless fun with a flavorful twist. Perfect for fans of merge food games, merge cooking, and merge 2 puzzle games with satisfying gameplay and exciting events.
Get ready to merge, cook, rescue, and race - all in one delicious game!

- Never miss a prayer again.
This powerful and beautifully simple Muslim prayer times app automatically calculates accurate Salah (Namaz) times based on your current location - so you can pray on time anywhere in the world without checking charts or timetables.
Using advanced GPS and location services, the app instantly detects your city and provides precise Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha prayer times, along with customizable Azan (Athan) alarms and reminders.
No setup. No manual input. Just open the app and your daily prayer schedule is ready.
Whether you're at home, traveling, at work, or abroad, your Islamic prayer timetable automatically updates wherever you go.
Perfect for Ramadan, Umrah, Hajj, travel, or everyday Muslim life.

• Built-in Islamic (Hijri) calendar & date
• Manual Hijri date adjustment
• 12/24-hour time format options
• Lightweight, fast, and battery-friendly
• Share the app easily via Twitter or email
- Perfect For
• Daily prayers
• Ramadan schedules
• Travelers & frequent flyers
• Students & professionals
• Anyone looking for a reliable - Islamic prayer companion
Download now and stay connected to your prayers - anytime, anywhere.
Your complete Salah, Azan & Islamic time companion in one simple app.

Write one line a day and watch a whole year of your life fill your calendar.
My Daily Memo is a month calendar where every day holds one short memo. Each day shows the start of its memo right in the calendar, tinted in one of four shades, so your weeks make sense at a glance: what happened, what's coming up, what you want to remember. Write today in ten seconds, find any day in seconds, and let the calendar remember for you.
FREE
• One memo for every day, shown right in the month view
• Four color shades to mark your days
• Search across every memo you've written
• Public holidays for 15 countries
• Lunar dates
• Start your week on Sunday or Monday
MY DAILY MEMO PRO
• Color themes, plus My Color to mix your own
• Reminders on any day, with an optional Time Sensitive alert
• iCloud Backup: restore your memos on a new iPhone or after reinstalling

bluejetty:00178167:ios.summary:

MOTIF STUDIO CREATES YOUR PHOTO PROJECTS INSTANTLY
Motif Studio is our next-generation AI-enhanced photo bo
bluejetty:00178167:ios.description:
Turn your photos into beautifully designed photo books, cards, calendars, and memo books — start today, ready to print in minutes.
MOTIF STUDIO CREATES YOUR PHOTO PROJECTS INSTANTLY
Motif Studio is our next-generation AI-enhanced photo book experience. Motif Studio automatically recommends your very best photos using AI to analyze image resolution, focus, clarity, and to find people and faces. 
Our Autoflow feature flows the curated collection into a photo book, calendar, memo book or card, sequencing your images chronologically, selecting the best page layouts, and correctly positioning faces in frames. You can, of course, also build your book by hand if you prefer.
MAGICAL FEATURES
- Motif Studio finds the narrative in your photo collection and build chapters, title pages, and captions around it
- Traces your trip's route into gorgeous, editable map pages
- Recognizes the people in your photos, name them once, find them in every project
- Gives your whole project a coordinated designer look in one click, with Themes
- You can make any change with a simple typed or spoken request to your design assistant
Prefer to build by hand? Studio's editor puts every tool within easy reach, and your project view is 100% true to print.
MOTIF STUDIO vs. MOTIF CLASSIC
Already using the Motif iOS app? That experience, Motif Classic is still there, and isn't going anywhere. It's a native way to build a photo book using the images already in your Apple Photos libray: Motif analyzes your library, flows your best shots into 80+ beautiful layouts, and lets you personalize with themes, colors, and text.
Motif Studio is a richer and dramatically more powerful app for AI-authored storytelling, trip maps, people recognition, and a design assistant you can talk to. Motif Studio works across your devices, so you can access your Motif Studio projects on Mac, the web, iPhone, and iPad.
QUALITY YOU CAN TRUST 
Every project starts with premium, carefully sourced materials designed to look beautiful and last.
Our layflat books feature double-thick, pearl-textured archival paper and a matte-laminated hardcover for a refined, lasting finish. Hardcover and softcover books are printed on smooth 100# text paper for vibrant color and a luxurious feel, then finished with a satin UV coating for added protection against scuffs and wear.
Cards come in your choice of classic matte or premium glossy stock. Memo Books use the same premium papers in a compact, everyday size made to carry and enjoy.
GLOBAL AND SUSTAINABLE
Motif delivers to 163 countries across the globe and supports 14 different currencies to make payment simple for everyone.
Our products are manufactured in the USA, UK, Germany, and Australia, helping us serve customers around the world.
And you can share your favorite moments with a happy heart knowing we're deeply committed to using sustainable, durable materials. We constantly strive to minimize our carbon footprint.
CHECK OUT OUR PRODUCTS
- Photo Books: layflat albums, classic hardcovers, and modern softcovers
- Photo Wall Calendars: 12-24 months, in every supported language, with local holidays included
- Photo Desk Calendars: 12 months in 7" x 5" cards that sit in an elegant wood block.
- Photo Cards: Flat or folded. Great for invitations, thank you notes, or greeting cards!
- Memo Books: a compact, everyday way to keep photos and notes together. Sold in 3-packs
HAPPINESS GUARANTEED
If you're not thrilled with your Motif project, we'll reprint it or refund you. 100% guaranteed.

bluejetty:00026687:ios.description:
Route is the premier package tracker for all of your online orders. Join over 50 Million people who have tracked their orders with Route. Route connects with millions of online stores and over 600 shipping carriers worldwide, including Amazon, FedEx, UPS, USPS, DHL, and more. Get shipping notifications that give you real-time status updates on any delivery! 
NEVER MISS A DELIVERY
The Route App brings package tracking and delivery to life. No more wondering where your package is—has it been shipped? Is it stuck in transit? Delivered? Now you can visually track your package’s journey from checkout to doorstep, review previous online orders and handle delivery issues (lost, stolen, damaged) all in one app.
“Shopping made simpler” - HYPEBEAST
“Your go-to package tracker” - NBC News
WHY YOU’LL LOVE ROUTE
Track all your packages in one place - Stop searching for tracking numbers in your inbox. Track every order automatically by connecting your emails to Route. 
Visual Tracking™- Hate searching for tracking numbers? Us too. Route seamlessly connects to every online order and makes package tracking a breeze.
Real-time push notifications - Route syncs in real-time with shipping carriers like FedEx, UPS and USPS to provide shipping updates that keep you informed from the minute you checkout until your package arrives safely on your doorstep.
Curated Product Discovery - Find the next brand you’ll fall in love with. No more knock-offs. Buy direct from brands you trust.
Follow Your Favorite Brands - Never miss a product drop.
One-click Order Resolution - Your package never showed up? Damaged? We got you. File a claim in one click from one of our 11,000+ merchant partners and let Route handle the rest.
Universal order history - Gone are the days of digging through emails to find old online purchases. Route automatically stores and organizes every order (including Amazon) for quick review and reorders.
Unrivaled privacy - Don’t worry, the Route Bot pulls only the necessary information to track your packages, and never shares it.
WHAT OTHER SHOPPERS ARE SAYING
GAME CHANGER
“100% a must have for anyone who shops online”
INCREDIBLE!
“I love not having to sift through emails to find tracking info. This app is amazing!”
PEACE OF MIND
“Super convenient to have an app to track all packages from different sources. No more stress over missed deliveries.”
Questions? Contact us at feedback@route.com.

It provides turn-by-turn voice and visual instructions, automatic rerouting, speed l
bluejetty:00034903:ios.description:
RTA Smart Drive is an on-board route planning, exploration and navigation app that does not require a mobile internet connection to search and navigate.
It provides turn-by-turn voice and visual instructions, automatic rerouting, speed limit alerts, and displays POIs along the route. 
Live Traffic lets you know where there is traffic, road works and accidents and reroutes your trip automatically. Instantly view real time traffic info and adjusted travel times on multiple saved routes.
Salient Features:
- 2D/3D mode allows realistic view of the map
- 7 levels of POI display 
- 3D Landmarks in UAE
- Selection for Automatic, Day or Night modes that switch color schemes for day or night time driving
- Locations of Metro, Tram, Bus and Marine Stations for Dubai
- Parking zones for Dubai
- Regular Map Updates
- User interface in Arabic and English
- Voice navigation in Arabic and English
- Intuitive search across the local Library of POIs
- Search nearby places on Facebook and Foursquare
- Live traffic information including road works and accidents
- Report traffic incidents
- Store your personal routes and places locally
- Share your favorite places and routes with your family and friends via sms, email, face book and WhatsApp 
- Planning a route – app suggests upto three drive routes and a pedestrian route if possible
- Avoid Tolling and unpaved road
- Simulate your drive
- Speed Limit alerts while driving
- POI along the route
Note: Continued use of any GPS application running in the background can significantly decrease battery life. We strongly suggest using a charger while using the app in your car.

bluejetty:00145995:ios.name: Torn PDA
bluejetty:00145995:ios.summary:
Torn PDA has been developed as an assistant for players of Torn City (www.torn.com). 
It was conceived to enhance the experience of playing Torn from a mobile platform, and other already existing applications, such as YATA, have been a gre
bluejetty:00145995:ios.description:
Torn PDA has been developed as an assistant for players of Torn City (www.torn.com). 
It was conceived to enhance the experience of playing Torn from a mobile platform, and other already existing applications, such as YATA, have been a great influence.
* Profile page with shortcuts to you preferred sections, access to basic status data, recent events, cooldowns and net-worth calculation. You can also manually activate notifications so that you don't waste any energy, nerve, or miss any cooldown expiry.
* Check your travel status and configure notifications just before you arrive. No more forgetting and being mugged abroad. Also, configure the notification shown so that it is safe to use even at work or in other public environments.
* Have a look at foreign stocks directly in the Travel section. Filter and sort items at your convenience, including profit based on item capacity. Also, by using the in-app browser, you are contributing by sending stock data automatically to the shared database!
* User scripts support.
* YATA mobile interface: new sections (e.g. Awards) that constitute the first official YATA mobile interface. Data comes straight from your YATA account.
* Ability to fill max items on arrival to destination, based on current capacity and money available. Then, use the quick home return button in the top bar to make your stay quicker and safer.
* Quick crimes option when you visit the crimes section. Just set up your preferred crimes and they'll appear in the top bar.
* Quick Items: browse to the items section in Torn with the full browser and add your prefer items for a quick access later on.
* Trade calculator with total price calculation for cash, items and shares, plus the ability to copy total figures for a quick trading. If you are a professional trader, you can also synchronize with Torn Trader and the Arson Warehouse.
* Automatic city items finder in the map.
* Automatic alerts for travel, energy, nerve, hospitalization, drugs, racing, messages, events, trades and stocks.
* Torn chat: options to highlight your name or hide the chat completely if you wish.
* Follow your faction's chain live from the app, with instant energy updates. Use the chain watcher feature to avoid surprises.
* Create your own target list, adding your own comments and many other details. Import and export your targets to/from YATA. While chaining, automatically skip targets that can't be attacked (hospitalised/jailed or in a different country). Get optimal targets directly from Torn Attack Central, included in the Chaining section. Chaining has never been easier.
* Have a look at your last few attacks, with simple statistics so that you can decide when/who to add to your common chaining targets.
* Export targets as a backup or share them with other players.
* When in hospital, send Nuclear Central Hospital a revive request by clicking a button.
* Create a friends list, with quick access to in-game messaging, trading and other important details. Also, add note to your friends' profiles. Backup functionality included.
* Activate alerts for NPC loot.
* Dark mode.

bluejetty:00140678:ios.summary: Embark on an epic monster training journey in Monster Masters RPG Quest, the ultimate creature collection game where strategy meets adventure. Discover a vast world filled with mysterious pocket creatures, powerful dragons, and legendary mo
bluejetty:00140678:ios.description:
Embark on an epic monster training journey in Monster Masters RPG Quest, the ultimate creature collection game where strategy meets adventure. Discover a vast world filled with mysterious pocket creatures, powerful dragons, and legendary monsters waiting to be tamed.
As a top monster tamer, your mission is to catch, train, and evolve your team to become the champion of the global battle arena. Whether you enjoy deep strategy RPG mechanics or the thrill of collecting rare pets, this game offers an unparalleled mobile experience.
COLLECT AND TRAIN UNIQUE MONSTERS Explore diverse environments to find and capture hundreds of unique creatures. Each monster possesses distinct abilities and elemental powers. Use your skills to train them, boost their stats, and unlock their true potential through advanced evolution systems. Build a balanced team of fire, water, nature, and dark monsters to counter any opponent.
EPIC RPG STRATEGY BATTLES Test your tactics in intense turn based combat. Every move counts in the battle arena where you must outsmart rival tamers. Master the elemental strengths and weaknesses to dominate your enemies. Plan your strategy, choose the right skills, and lead your monster squad to victory in challenging dungeon raids and boss fights.
EVOLVE INTO A LEGENDARY MASTER Watch your pets transform through multiple stages of evolution. As they grow stronger, they unlock devastating new attacks and legendary forms. Collect rare evolution materials and special items to accelerate your team growth and reach the top of the leaderboards.
GLOBAL PVP ARENA AND QUESTS Enter the PvP arena and duel against players from around the world in real time matches. Prove your skills as the greatest summoner and climb the ranks to earn exclusive rewards. Beyond the arena, engage in daily quests, seasonal events, and a deep story mode that takes you across mystical lands.
KEY FEATURES
Hundreds of monsters to collect, train, and evolve.
Strategic turn based RPG combat system.
Massive open world with challenging quests and hidden secrets.
Competitive PvP arena for real time monster duels.
Daily rewards and special events for dedicated tamers.
High quality graphics and immersive sound design.
Join the adventure today in Monster Masters RPG Quest. Catch your first monster, start your training, and claim your place as the ultimate monster master in this definitive RPG experience.

Quem é a War
bluejetty:00022877:ios.description:
Investir toma tempo, mas não precisa ser o seu. Aqui você investe sem complexidade em carteiras administradas, com estratégias consistentes para aumentar o seu patrimônio, orientadas por nossos especialistas e pela tecnologia.
Quem é a Warren?
A Warren é uma corretora de investimentos e gestora de recursos, com abordagem wealth management.
Como seu dinheiro é investido?
Seu dinheiro é investido em carteiras de acordo com seus objetivos. Nossos especialistas, junto à tecnologia, sugerem os melhores investimentos para você, sempre respeitando o seu perfil de investidor.
É seguro investir com a Warren?
A Warren é credenciada e fiscalizada pelas três maiores instituições do mercado financeiro: o Banco Central, a CVM e a Anbima.
Onde fica o seu dinheiro?
Ele fica investido nos produtos financeiros selecionados e administrados pela Warren, sob custódia do Banco Santander e outras instituições também regulamentadas.
Quanto custa investir?
Você nos remunera com uma taxa fixa sobre a gestão do seu patrimônio, entre 0,9% e 0,7% ao ano — quanto mais dinheiro investido, menos você paga.
Quanto preciso para começar a investir?
O primeiro aporte é de no mínimo R$ 100,00. Depois, você escolhe o valor e a frequência que deseja investir.
Invista sem complexidade com a Warren e alcance seus objetivos financeiros.
Comece agora!
Note regarding Age Rating / Advertising: Please note that this app DOES NOT display any third-party advertising to users. The advertising identifier APIs and SDKs included in the project (like Facebook and advertising_id) are used exclusively for internal purposes: marketing attribution, analytics, and fraud prevention.

bluejetty:00186378:ios.description:
Nearpod: Interactive Lessons That Engage Every Student   
Nearpod helps K–12 teachers create engaging, student-centered learning experiences that drive participation and deepen understanding. Whether you're teaching math, science, ELA, or any other subject, Nearpod gives you the tools to bring your lessons to life.  Use interactive features like polls, quizzes, and virtual reality to spark curiosity and keep students involved. Monitor progress with real-time formative assessments and adjust instruction based on instant feedback. With flexible teaching modes, you can lead live lessons or assign student-paced activities that fit your classroom flow.
Why Teachers Love Nearpod:   
Interactive slides, videos, and activities that promote active learning  
Real-time insights to support data-informed instruction   
Seamless integration with Google Slides, YouTube, and your LMS  
Access to 22,000+ standards-aligned lessons and resources   
Tools for differentiation and student voice     
Nearpod works with the platforms you already use and adapts to your teaching style. Whether you're enhancing your curriculum or building lessons from scratch, Nearpod helps you deliver instruction that sticks.
How Nearpod works:
1. Learning experiences are created by teachers from scratch, uploading slides, with AI (on tablet or web), or selected from a catalogue of over 22,000 experiences found in the Nearpod Library.  
2. Students join synchronous learning experiences led by their teachers or learn at their own pace. 
3. Students actively engage in interactive media, formative assessments, and activities such as videos, quizzes, polls, 3D objects, virtual reality, drawing tools, and more.
4. Teachers receive immediate insights into student learning, allowing them to provide feedback, correct misconceptions, and adjust instruction.  5. Students are introduced to content through dynamic multimedia that includes VR Field trips, 3D objects, PhET simulations, BBC videos and more. 
 To make your technology integration as seamless as possible, Nearpod has partnered with:
Apple
Google
Microsoft
Canvas
Schoology
Brightspace by D2L
Blackboard
Moodle
Clever
ClassLink
 What teachers are saying:
 "Nearpod provides me and my teachers with an excellent tool for engaging students. Activities and the different functions offer opportunities for differentiation and collection of assessment data. Nearpod is a game changer for teachers and students." - Matthew M., Assistant Principal
 "Nearpod gives teachers a wonderful superpower. It allows us to see the answer every students would give to every question we ask in class and allows students to feel more comfortable taking risks with their learning and growth." - Ann K., Instructional Coach
  Nearpod consistently gets me 90-100% engagement by keeping students active in their learning while helping build a stronger learning environment. - Amanda D., High school teacher  
SUBSCRIBING IN-APP:
- Subscribe to Nearpod Gold Edition annually ($159.99). You will be charged in your local currency at the prevailing exchange rate as defined by the App Store.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.
- Privacy policy: nearpod.com/privacy-policy
- Terms of use: nearpod.com/terms-conditions
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
Download Nearpod now and sign up for a FREE account or log in to start experiencing the magic of Nearpod!

bluejetty:00030970:ios.description:
It's Election Day in My City and everyone is excited! Who will win and who shall lose, only you get to decide. Everyone wants to be the new mayor for My City - who will you vote for? Sit in the Mayor's office, visit the city hall and explore all rooms, rollout your Election Day posters and take care of your city. Everything is possible in this new My City game!
Game features:
* 8 new locations to discover, sit in the Mayor's Office, visit the Voting Area, help your candidate in the Campaign Room and even pass new rules in the Council Room.
* Hold election for your favourite character, who will become the new Mayor and who will lose?
* 20 Characters you can move between our games, More games means more characters to play with!
* Solve puzzles and discover hidden locations all around the My City : Election Day!
Over 100 million kids have played our games world wide!
Creative Games Kids Love to Play
Think of this game as a fully interactive dollhouse in which you can touch and interact with almost every object you see. With fun characters and highly detailed locations, kids can role-play by creating and playing out their own stories.
Easy enough for a 5-year old to play with, exciting enough for a 12-year old to enjoy!
- Play as you want, stress-free games, Extremely high playability.
- Kids Safe. No 3rd party Ads and IAP. Pay once and get free updates forever.
- Connects with other My City games: All My City games connect together allowing kids to share characters between our games.
More Games, More Story Options, More Fun.
Age group 4-12: 
Easy enough for 4 year olds to play and super exciting for 12 year to enjoy.
Play Together: 
We support multi touch so kids can play together with friends and family on the same screen!
We love making children games, if you like what we do and want to send us ideas and suggestions for our next games of My City you can do so here:
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames

Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/mytowngames
Love our games? Leave us a nice review on the app store, we read them all!
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get Privacy-related information at: https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00178095:ios.description:
Barometer and Altimeter is a simple application for measuring atmospheric pressure and altitude.
The application uses:
- built-in GPS,
- built-in pressure sensor / barometer (if the device does not have a barometric sensor, application retrieves atmospheric pressure data via the Internet from the nearest meteorological station),
- automatic altitude and atmospheric pressure calibration algorithm, based on data from local meteorological stations.
Barometer and Altimeter features:
- accurate height measurement above sea level (from GPS and other sensors),
- accurate measurement of barometric pressure (if the device is equipped in pressure sensor and check data available online)
- GPS coordinates, name of location, country
- information and current weather data from your local weather station (if available).
- outside temperature,
- wind speed,
- visibility,
- humidity, hygrometer (if device is equipped with appropriate sensors).
Exemplary uses of a barometer or altimeter tracker:
- health and medical - by monitoring the atmosferic pressure, you can be prepared for pressure jumps, headaches, migraine and malaise,
- for fishermen and anglers who fishing and sailing - monitoring the atmospheric pressure and weather you can increase the chances for good fishing,
- sportsmen and tourists,
- for determining, predicting and checking weather, air temperature, wind speed,
- to check the location,
- for pilots for check pressure and altitude,
- sailors, seamans and surfers can check the wind.
Using this barometer tracker is simpler than using an aneroid or mercury barometer. Our Barometer and Altimeter tracker is easy to use, simple and handy.
Warning! Some portable devices (tablets, phones, smartphones) do not have a built-in pressure sensor. On these devices, the measurements may be less accurate as they will be based on data from the local meteorological stations.
We are constantly developing this app, if you see something that can be improved send us on help@examobile.pl. If you like this app, rate it for 5 stars.
Enjoy and have a good time with this app!

bluejetty:00085913:ios.description:
Mealligram is the new go-to app to help you keep track of your daily meals and fitness with just the help of your camera! 
Research has found that 78% of people who consistently keep track their meals succeeded in losing weight, so we've made it easy to log all your meals with the help of our suite of fitness tools. Just take a picture of what you're eating, log it on Mealligram, and start achieving your weight-loss goals today! 
1. Keep track of your progress 
- App will automatically record your meal times based on your pictures.
- Record your exercise and body changes easily by connecting the app to your Health data. 
- If you forgot to take a picture, you can use emojis to record you meal.
2. Assess your diet habits and observe your changes 
- Keep up with your diet at your own pace. 
- Check your meal time and meal score in your calendar to assess your diet habits.
- Your meals, body condition, exercise logs... all at one place! You can also check your progress using graphs. 
3. Stay healthy with people who share the same goal
- If it's hard to do it alone, start with people who have the same goal as you.
- Share your records with your groups in real-time and motivate each other.
- Finish the survival challenge and get a gift. 
We are updating the features you need as quickly as possible. 
If you want to give us feedback, please contact us at mealligram.app@gmail.com
Please leave us a review if you enjoy using Mealligram!
--

- Health(HealthKit)
Health access is required to indicate the number of steps and exercises.

bluejetty:00071798:ios.description:
Every color. Every holiday. Every occasion. Controlled by the most intelligent smart outdoor lighting app ever built for permanent outdoor lighting.
BlueHopper app is the smart control platform powering every BlueHopper permanent outdoor lighting system — the app that sits behind your rooflines, fences, landscape, and pool cage lights, giving you complete, real-time control over color, scenes, schedules, and security from your phone, your voice, or a pre-set automation. Exclusive to BlueHopper's permanent outdoor lighting ecosystem. Available free with every installation.
 For Homeowners
 App-controlled permanent Christmas lights and year-round lighting — change colors, set schedules, celebrate every occasion with a single tap. No reinstall, no ladders, no effort.
For Businesses & Municipalities
 Brand-consistent and celebration-ready. Outdoor lighting control across one location or fifty. Push holiday scenes, manage zones, schedule seasonal lighting — centrally, instantly, from any device.
Everything You Need to Control Your Permanent Outdoor Lighting — In One App
Talk to Your Lights - Say the word — your permanent outdoor lighting responds instantly. Any command, any fixture, any scene. Hands-free, every time.
One-Click Scenes - The world's first one-click holiday scene system for permanent outdoor lighting. Christmas, Halloween, 4th of July, New Year's — one tap transforms your entire exterior.
Schedules & Automation - Program your permanent Christmas lights to activate at dusk, switch holiday presets on specific dates, and return to warm white at dawn — fully automated, zero manual input.
Effects & Presets - Hundreds of built-in lighting effects — smooth fades, chase sequences, sparkle effects, and synchronized holiday animations across your full permanent outdoor lighting in seconds.
RGBW Sliders & White Tuning: 16 million+ RGBW colors at your fingertips. Dial in exact shades with precision sliders and white-temperature tuning — from warm amber to cool white to vibrant holiday red.
Lighting Blueprint: Upload a photo of your property to ee exactly how your permanent outdoor lighting will look before committing — the only app that does this.
Security Lighting - Perfect for homeowners and owners of commercial spaces like restaurants and car dealerships seeking both robust security and aesthetic appeal
Marketing Assets - Access a full library of product videos, brochures, email templates, and sales collateral. Everything you need to pitch, close, and upsell permanent outdoor lighting installs, right from the app.
Everything You Need to Control Your Permanent Outdoor Lighting — In One App
Need more information?
Website: www.bluehopper.com
Email: connect@bluehopper.com

bluejetty:00132051:ios.description:
Try the best app for monitoring your stress, activity, sleep, and health!
Your Apple Watch tracks multiple heart data during the day when you just wear your Apple Watch. Stress Monitor App is designed especially for Apple Watch users. The App processes your heart data and shows your current stress and capacity to perform at your mental, emotional, and physical best. 
As our stress and performance are influenced by various factors, such as daily activity and sleep, it is very easy to track in the App what and to what extent influenced your performance, stress, and health. 
YOUR BODY FEEDBACK SCORE, HRV, RESTING HEART RATE
Stress, recovery, and fitness level show up in your body’s signals. Stress Monitor App takes into account your direct body signals, such as Heart Rate Variability and Resting Heart Rate and shows your current capacity to perform at your mental, emotional, and physical best. 
Analyze your body signals and find out what is positive and what negatively affects your stress, performance, and general well-being. 
PERSONAL RECOMMENDATIONS FOR BETTER WELL-BEING
Each measurement comes with a recommendation and explanation of your current mental, emotional, and physical state based on your data.
APPLE WATCH ECG MEASUREMENTS SUPPORT
Besides background measurements that are tracked when you just wear your Apple Watch, you can do quick stress checks using your built-in ECG App or Breathe App. 
PERSONAL WEEKLY HIGHLIGHTS
Stress Monitor App analyzes your weekly data and shares the most important trends and findings on your stress, health, and well-being. 
YOUR DAILY STRESS HEAT-MAP
Check your background stress data on the heat-map calendar. On the heat-map, it’s easy to assess more stressful and less stressful days, weeks, or months.
TRACK YOUR SLEEP AND ACTIVITY
Our App analyzes your today’s and 2-weeks sleep and activity trends to determine their impact on your stress and performance. 
ADD HOW YOU FEEL TODAY
Add your emotions and mood to your day, including tense, worried or anxious moments, and analyze how they correlate with your stress and other data.
APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
Stress Monitor App processes the information that your Apple Watch saved to Apple Health. The App requires providing access to Apple Health to read your health and activity data. Based on your health data and using advanced algorithms, Stress Monitor calculates your scores. 
You need to have an Apple Watch to use the app.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
Stress Monitor is free to download. Should you choose to upgrade to Stress Monitor Premium, we offer monthly and annual auto-renewing subscription options. Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period. Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in your Apple Account settings after purchase. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
Read more about our terms and conditions here:
Terms of use: https://www.stress-radar.app/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://www.stress-radar.app/privacy-policy
IMPORTANT
Stress Monitor App doesn’t provide any medical advice or diagnosis and could be used for informational purposes only. The Stress Monitor App results are estimates only.
Please, seek a doctor’s advice in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions.
CONTACTS
Our team highly values the feedback from our users. We respond as quickly as possible and take your suggestions into account when planning the next releases. Don’t hesitate to contact us at dev@activeace.app if you have any questions, concerns, or suggestions.

bluejetty:00016158:ios.description:
Be there even when you're not. The CBS Sports App is everything a sports fan needs in one place. Get personalized alerts for your favorite teams, players and leagues, follow every play with GameTracker, stream live games from CBS and Paramount+, and stay on top of the biggest news in sports. With the CBS Sports App, you can watch the NFL on CBS, UEFA Champions League, Big Ten football and basketball, the Masters, and more via your TV provider or Paramount+ subscription.
All sports. One app. With the CBS Sports App, you'll get:
- The fastest scores and breaking news across every major league, so you're always the first to know
- GameTrackers for the games you can't watch: play-by-play, win probability, drive charts, box scores and the latest betting odds
- An experience built around your fandom: your teams front and center on every screen, alerts for what you actually care about, and the ability to see what you want and hide what you don't
- Live chat with fans who care as much as you do, so you never watch alone
- Personalized news, instant highlights and reactions from your favorite teams, leagues and athletes
- Live CBS and Paramount+ events including NFL on CBS, UEFA Champions League and Europa League, the Masters, Big Ten football and basketball, PGA Championship, Serie A, EFL, NWSL, PGA Tour, WNBA and more*
- CBS Sports HQ, a free 24/7 sports channel with news, highlights, live analysis and onsite coverage from the biggest sports events
- CBS Sports Golazo Network, a free 24/7 soccer channel with live matches, exclusive studio shows like Morning Footy, news, highlights, documentaries and more
- A 24/7 stream of CBS Sports Network, the cable home of CBS Sports*
- Expert picks and betting analysis from SportsLine insiders
- Free-to-play games all year: March Madness and UEFA Champions League brackets, weekly football picks and UFC Pick'em for every numbered event. Compete with friends. Win prizes.
Fans live here. All sports, one app. Free to download.
*Available via login with a participating TV provider and/or Paramount+ subscription.
Please note: The CBS Sports app features Nielsen's proprietary measurement software which contributes to market research, like Nielsen's TV Ratings. Please see https://www.nielsen.com/digitalprivacy for more information

Paramount Privacy Policy: https://privacy.paramount.com/policy
Minors' Privacy Policy: https://privacy.paramount.com/en/childrens
Your Privacy Choices: https://privacy.paramount.com/app-donotsell
California Notice: https://privacy.paramount.com/en/policy#additional-information-us-states

bluejetty:00120193:ios.summary: Turn screen time into learning time! Hooked on Phonics has been trusted by parents for over 35 years to provide engaging, educational content for kids. Our app uses cutting-edge research and guidance from top educators to teach essential sk
bluejetty:00120193:ios.description:
Turn screen time into learning time! Hooked on Phonics has been trusted by parents for over 35 years to provide engaging, educational content for kids. Our app uses cutting-edge research and guidance from top educators to teach essential skills. Tailored to support preschool, kindergarten, 1st grade, and 2nd grade learners, our adaptive program targets where each child needs practice. This gives parents real-time progress insights!
Learn across different subjects with Hooked on Math and Hooked on Spelling included within our Hooked on Phonics app. Kids can learn, gain rewards, and strengthen early skills that align with your family’s educational goals. 
Hooked on Phonics helps children (ages 3-8) learn across reading, math, and spelling with::
• 1000+ educational activities designed for preschool, kindergarten, and early grade levels
• 100+ ebook library with stories to complement every reading lesson
• Multi-device compatibility – keep learning consistent across devices
• Three customizable learner profiles to track individual progress
Children can:
• Gain confidence through interactive learning activities
* Earn virtual rewards like cosmetic items for your avatar
• Practice reading in our extensive ebook library
• Easily resume learning on any device, any time
WHAT YOU GET WHEN YOU DOWNLOAD:
Hooked on Phonics offers a 7-day free trial of the entire program, including: reading, math, and spelling content. Experience your child’s excitement as they read their first book or solve their first math problem!
Terms of use:
- Hooked on Phonics provides a 7-day free trial, which upon completion, becomes a monthly subscription charged by the Apple App Store.
- Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user by going to the “Subscriptions” section in the App store after purchase.
https://hookedonphonics.com/terms-of-service/
Practice Packs Mailed Home:
Catapult your child's progress by purchasing Practice Packs as an add-on to your App (available on our website). The workbooks, storybooks, and celebration stickers work in tandem with the App to help children develop a deeper understanding of literacy (and mathematics!) concepts. Built by educational experts and reinforced with feedback from our customers, the Practice Pack program includes 5 Pre-reader, and 15 Learn to Read packs that include workbooks, stickers, storybooks, and in the first Pre-reader pack, flashcards that are sent to the home, monthly. Subscribers can customize how often they receive these shipments through their account dashboard to tailor the pacing to each family’s needs. Created in conjunction with the App, the Practice Packs allow children to engage in different modalities of learning, review the skills they’ve gained in the App, and practice hands-on skills—like writing and tracing—that are best mastered in a non-digital environment. The result is an immersive program of learning experiences that keeps kids highly engaged in learning to read.
Start your child on the path to becoming a confident lifelong learner, and download Hooked on Phonics now!

Our app is designed with your family’s safety and peace of mind in mind. Built for transparency and mutual trust, the app requires explicit user consent before use and cannot be installed secretly. 
Keep Your Lo
bluejetty:00115500:ios.description:
Stay Connected & Protected
Our app is designed with your family’s safety and peace of mind in mind. Built for transparency and mutual trust, the app requires explicit user consent before use and cannot be installed secretly. 
Keep Your Loved Ones Close — Wherever They Are
Whether you're at home or miles apart, Our app helps you stay connected to your family 24/7 with the most reliable, accurate, and user-friendly GPS tracking technology.
The app shows your family members' real-time locations on a private map only visible within your group, allowing you to know where everyone is—without constant texting or calling.
Key Features:
Live Location Sharing
See your family members’ current positions on a private, secure map within the app.
Smart Notifications
Get alerts when loved ones arrive at or leave saved places like home, school, or work.
Battery Status Sharing
Know your family’s phone battery levels, so you can remind them to charge.
Phone Locator
Track lost or stolen devices using the app’s GPS finder.
Proximity Alerts
Receive automatic notifications when a family member is nearby.
No More ""Where Are You?"" Messages
Save time and reduce worry—no need to keep checking in manually.
Custom Places & Alerts
Set up personalized “Places” like school, gym, or grandma’s house. When someone in your family enters or leaves those zones, you’ll get an instant notification.
Subscription Details:
Payment is charged to your iTunes account at purchase confirmation.
Subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the current period’s end.
Manage your subscription or turn off auto-renewal in your Apple ID settings.
Cancellation during an active subscription period is not permitted.
Whether you're ensuring your child gets home safely or simply staying close with loved ones, Our App offers a simple, secure, and smart solution to stay connected—anytime, anywhere.
Contact us: patrickcollins98522@icloud.com
Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1gcSOWaC8icMWO3npi7m0EuIwzsYOzdlVd7j5VIpzfzE/edit?usp=sharing
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00057129:android.description:
Match 22 is relaxing while challenging puzzle game about matching colors. Improve your IQ and exercise your brain.
Different discs will show up and you have to rotate them to match colors with adjacent discs. During the game flow, you will face vast levels that will test your IQ and make your brain work out! 
Match 22 was made to render that strange, yet universal satisfaction that produces order as an elegant, brain challenging and relaxing game, always handily waiting in your phone for when your little itch craves for a little reward :)
Basically, Match 22 combines the best from IQ testing and brain training games to bring you a more simple and enjoyable experience. With the relaxing minimalist graphics, you won't even notice you are working to achieve perfection! Well, maybe a little :P
-------- MAIN FEATURES --------
- Tap the discs to rotate and match colors: Tap, tap, tap!
- Flow free through all the 500 levels available
- Beautiful minimal design with relaxing music
- 12 vibrant themes for a customized experience
- Runs smoothly over a wide variety of devices
- Use solver to complete those difficult levels
- Train your brain & improve your visual-spatial ability while playing!
#HINT: You can upgrade to Match 22 Premium to get rid of ads and have access to all the content this game has to offer :D
If you have a little OCD inside you, you may enjoy playing Match 22 :)
-------- MORE INFO --------
My name is Abhinav and I am the creator of Match 22. I want to know what you think! Love it? Please let me know. Like it not so much? Please let me know as well. I want to make Match 22 even better and your suggestions are part of that.
Email for support/suggestions at support@zerologicgames.com
Follow on Twitter! https://twitter.com/ZeroLogicGames
Like on Facebook: https://facebook.com/ZeroLogicGames
Privacy Policy: http://zerologicgames.com/privacy/privacy-policy-match22.html
Made with ♥ and lots of code

 · View and save your monthly statements
 · Find branches and ATMs near you

Marine Box is the most complete Reef Aquarium manager on the App Store for beginners and advanced aquarists alike! Ditch your notepad and paper and manage your aquarium on your iPod Touch, iPhone and iPad. 
This app features:
- New to reef aquariums? Basics of reef aquarium keeping covered. Aquarium recipes to help you start your new aquarium right. Great for the whole family to learn and manage your reef aquarium!
- Unlimited aquarium tracking. 
- Automatic calculation of the volume of your aquarium based on your aquarium dimensions.
- Track all your reef aquarium parameters including temp, alkalinity, pH, trace elements and more.
- Dashboard section to see all your parameters in graphs.
- Schedule reminders for your reef aquarium maintenance and water parameter testing both in the app as well as your calendar. Get notification reminders when things are due on your iPhone and Apple Watch!
- See graphs of all of your parameters within each parameter section.
- Share your data with anyone!
- Record all your livestock.
- Visually track your aquarium, livestock growth, effects of resins, etc with Snapshots
- Timeline to see all of your activities and maintenance of your reef aquarium that was done.
- Calculators to calculate dosing of common supplements, medications/treatment regimens and more.
- Calculate your dosing supplements. Included manufacturers are: Aquarium Systems Reef Evolution, B-Ionic, C-balance, Kent, Randy's recipe, Seachem, Warner Marine, Columbo Reef Care, Continuum Reef, Tropic Marine. Even baking soda, aragonite, anhydrous CaCl, Epsom Salt are covered. Don't see your favorite supplement? Email use at support@jcrsoftware.com. We will add it with the next update to the app in 1-2 weeks. 
- Track your livestock food.
- Metric (cm, L), UK units and U.S. units (Inches, gallons)
- Keep your data synced with all your devices on the same iTunes account seamlessly.
-Share you data with others in your family or friends.
- AppleWatch app shows your aquarium parameters and you can add parameter values in your AppleWatch which will sync with your App on other devices.
This is the best and most complete reef aquarium management app for both the beginner and the advanced aquarist.
Get Marine Box Today!
This app is updated regularly. Check us out at: www.jcrsoftware.com.
If you want your favorite supplement on the calculator section please email us at: support@jcrsoftware.com
If you are having issues, concerns or suggestions please email us at: support@jcrsoftware.com

bluejetty:00089273:ios.description:
LYNX by CATS makes it easier than ever to move around Baker, LA — with a few taps, book a ride using the app and we’ll pair you with others headed your way. 
How does LYNX by CATS work?
- LYNX is an on-demand travel concept that takes multiple passengers heading in the same direction and books them into a shared vehicle. Using the app, input your address and we’ll match you with a vehicle going your way. We’ll pick you up on a nearby corner and drop you off within a short walk of your chosen destination. Now for the clever bit; our algorithms provide journey times that are comparable to a taxi and much more convenient than other modes of travel, making on-demand transportation easier than ever before!
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our tech matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
AFFORDABLE.
Rides are priced comparable to public transport and you can add people to your bookings for even less.
Questions? Reach out to support-baker@ridewithvia.com
Loving your experience so far? Give us a 5-star rating. You’ll have our eternal gratitude.

bluejetty:00187934:ios.description:
Cardflow is index cards for your iPad! Write or sketch on a card with Apple Pencil, flip it over like the real thing, and lay out as many as you need on one big board.
There's no rigid structure, no forms to fill in. Just cards, a board, and your ideas, arranged in ways that make sense to you.
WE LOVE INDEX CARDS. We use them a lot. 
They are a versatile and surprisingly powerful tool for all kinds of tasks. From brainstorming or flash cards, to storyboarding and planning entire projects, they have a place in your workflow.
Cardflow captures the ease and flexibility of paper index cards and brings that experience to the iPad.
Jot down ideas or sketch diagrams on cards and arrange them on a large board.
Use cards to capture individual ideas, sketch diagrams, or type detailed notes.
Turbocharge your workflow today! Have all the fun of using index cards, without the forest-pulping guilt of paper.
Cardflow is perfect for:
+ Storyboards for videos or movies
+ Studying for an exam
+ Learning a new language
+ Writing the plot for a novel or book
+ Organizing weddings, parties, and other events
+ Corporate training
+ Project management
+ Agile, Scrum, and other methodologies
+ Group brainstorming
+ Writing your daily goals and to-dos
+ And much more!
TRY CARDFLOW FOR FREE!
To make it easy to see how well Cardflow fits into your workflow, we've decided to make the Standard Edition of Cardflow absolutely free. You can upgrade at any time to Cardflow+ for more features.
Thanks so much,
-- The App Makers @ Qrayon

Welcome to the world of Buffet Boss, the ultimate mobile game that puts you in the shoes of a restaurant entrepreneur.
With Buffet Boss, players can build an empire and rise to the top of the restaurant industry as they earn promotions and become the ultimate chef, bartender, and manager.
► UNLIMITED HOURS OF FUN
In Buffet Boss, players will have to manage their restaurant and make sure that their customers are happy by providing fast and efficient service. You'll have to learn how to cook a variety of dishes and become a master chef and bartender. 
As you earn promotions and become more successful, you'll have to deal with the challenges of running a busy restaurant like dealing with overcrowding and making sure that you have the right staff.
► BRING YOUR SKILLS TO TEST
The game offers a realistic simulator experience, allowing players to experience the challenges and rewards of the hospitality industry.
* Keep your staff working well and make sure you have fast service.
* Try to make your customers happy!
* Open new restaurants and serve even .more hungry customers.
* Upgrade your machines, bars, tables.
* Make investments and become the Buffet Boss!

bluejetty:00010713:android:0.description:
The official Google Calendar app helps you stay organized and plan your day with easy event creation, multiple calendars, customizable views, widgets, and tasks.
With Google Calendar, you can:
• Get events automatically added to your Calendar from Gmail, including flight, hotel, concert, and restaurant reservations.
• Go from using Calendar on your iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch to your computer without missing a beat when you’re logged into the same Google account.
• Consolidate and view Google Calendar events side-by-side with other calendars on your device, including Exchange and iCloud.
• Keep family, friends, and colleagues in the loop with shared calendars, so they can view, add, or modify events.
• Quickly switch between month, week, and day views.
• Stay on top of to-dos by creating and managing tasks alongside your events in Calendar.
• Personalize your Google Calendar with light or dark mode or by color-coding your events
• Always know what's next while on the go with Google Calendar on Apple Watch by customizing your watch face with Calendar complications or adding widgets.
Google Calendar is part of Google Workspace, allowing you and your team to easily connect, create, and collaborate across all your favorite Google tools. You can:
• Collaborate in a hybrid work environment by adding a Google Meet video call to an Calendar event
• Get access to professional booking pages to easily book clients and customers*.
• Schedule meetings with teammates by checking their availability or layering their calendars in a single view
• Add your working location to your calendar to make it easier for your teammates to schedule meetings with you*.
• Keep everyone on track for a meeting by attaching meeting notes, pre-read materials, and other documents directly to a calendar event.
• Use Google Calendar with confidence knowing it’s supported by Google’s enterprise-level privacy, user safety and data security.
* Requires a Google Workspace or Google One AI Premium subscription

apple-macos:1616608238.description:
Send invoices, book appointments, track expenses, and get paid; a free, all in one app built for freelancers and solopreneurs.

- Invoicing - branded invoices in seconds; record partial payments & instalments

Send Professional invoices
Solo lets you generate branded invoices in seconds. Bill by project, hourly rate, or fixed fee, and track their status in real time.
- Create Invoices – Free, Fast and Professionally
- Add your logo, customize, and send invoices via email or messages
- View which invoices are pending, paid, or overdue
- Send reminders and receive notifications
Track Expenses like a Pro
Keep your business finances under control. With Solo, you can log, categorize, and monitor all your expenses with zero complexity.
- Record expenses and add receipts
- Sort expenses into categories
- View a monthly or yearly summary to know exactly where your money goes
Accept Payments Online with Ease
Get paid faster through trusted payment providers. Zoho Solo integrates with Stripe, PayPal, and more.
- Add payment links directly into your invoices
- Track payment status
- Offer multiple payment options for convenience
Organize Your Day with Tasks & Events
Stay productive with built-in to-do lists and calendar scheduling. No more jumping between task apps.
- Create task lists for projects, clients, or daily work
- Set due dates and add reminders for follow ups
- Record the time spent on work and bill them
- Visualize your day in a clean, distraction-free view
Manage Your Business Contacts in One Place
- Store and organize your clients, partners, and vendors with ease.
- Add notes, tags, and contact details
- View their interaction history and invoice records
Be Ready for Tax Time
Solo let's you add taxes and automatically organizes your income and expense data, so when it's time to file taxes, you're already prepared.
*Taxation is currently available only for certain countries.
- Export reports with one tap
- Stay tax compliant with accurate record-keeping
Apple Exclusive Features
- Log tasks, contacts, or notes using Siri + Apple Intelligence
- Add tasks via Control Centre or Action Button
- Scan business cards into contacts with Capture Extension
- Share invoices instantly via iMessage
- Secure access with Face ID or Touch ID

Who is it for?

- Freelancers and creatives
- Coaches and consultants
- Handymen and local service pros
- Wellness practitioners and therapists
- Online sellers and content creators

- Data stored securely with Zoho’s trusted infrastructure
- Works seamlessly across iPhone and iPad (macOS support coming soon)

apple-macos:6770089893.description:
Side B is a clean and focused music album tracker for people who are always finding records they want to hear later.
Search for albums, save them to your Listen Later list, mark them as played, and keep your music discovery organized without feeds, likes, or unnecessary clutter.
Built around album artwork and a fast visual library, Side B helps you remember what to play next, explore an artist’s discography, and see what you still have left to hear.
Key features:
• Save albums to your Listen Later list
• Search by album or artist
• Find albums by audio
• Browse an artist’s discography
• See which albums you have played, saved, or still need to hear
• Import the albums included in a playlist using the Share button in Apple Music.
• Mark albums as played
• Browse pending and played albums
• View release year, genre, and album type
• Open albums in Spotify, Apple Music, or YouTube Music
• Filter and sort your library
• Create recap images to share
• Add home screen widgets for your next album
• Export a backup of your library
Side B Premium unlocks advanced stats, recap customization, premium widgets, app icons, themes, and iCloud sync.
Whether you are collecting recommendations from friends, saving albums from social media, exploring your favorite artists, or building your own listening archive, Side B keeps the experience simple, visual, and intentional.
No social feed. No distractions. Just the music you want to remember.

apple-itunes:6756314857.name: Unichat Messenger
apple-itunes:6756314857.description:
Unichat was born from a simple idea: reclaiming control over our communications to restore focus and productivity. Today, our messages are scattered across a multitude of apps—WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, and many others. This fragmentation scatters both our attention and our information, at the expense of efficiency.
Unichat solves this problem with an app that centralizes all your messages into a single, clean, secured, and distraction-free interface. You can reply without getting lost. But that’s not all: how many times have you just wanted to reply to a message on Instagram or TikTok... only to find yourself still scrolling 20 minutes later? Yeah... Unichat helps you cut out those distractions and focus on what matters most: your messages.
